jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer (m/w/d), Büro Salzburg (Industrietechnologe/-technologin - Datentechnik)
jobs.description: Wer wir sind - und warum: Wir gestalten die Industrie nicht von außen - sondern von innen. Seit fast zwei Jahrzehnten entwickeln wir bei CTS Lösungen für Unternehmen, die weltweit Prozesse sicherer, effizienter und nachhaltiger machen. Was uns verbindet, ist der Blick aufs Ganze. Wir denken Projekte immer als Gesamtsystem. Und begleiten unsere Kunden genau dort, wo es darauf ankommt: in der Praxis, im Umbau, im Detail. Als unabhängiger Komplettanbieter begleiten wir unsere Kunden von der ersten Planung bis zur langfristigen Optimierung - in der Fertigung ebenso wie in verfahrenstechnischen Anlagen, bei industrieller Dateninfrastruktur oder in Projekten der Energieversorgung. Unser Ziel: stabile, transparente und zukunftsfähige Industrieprozesse. Möglich gemacht durch Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen - und Technik, die genau dafür gemacht ist. Worauf es dabei ankommt? Auf Menschen, die mitdenken, mitgestalten und mit anpacken. So wie dich. Das kannst du bei uns bewegen: Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Optimierung unserer SPS-Software für Standardprodukte sowie Sonderlösungen in der Fertigungsautomatisierung Aktive Teamarbeit zur fortlaufenden Weiterentwicklung, Feinabstimmung und Wartung der SPS-Software Gestaltung und Implementierung neuer Standards sowie Entwicklung von Schnittstellen für verschiedene Anbindungen Du bringst dich aktiv ein und gestaltest auch die Weiterentwicklung des Teams mit   Was du für diese Aufgabe idealerweise mitbringst: fachliches Verständnis, eine sorgfältige Arbeitsweise - und Lust, gemeinsam Dinge voranzubringen. Und wenn du nicht alles davon erfüllst: Kein Problem. Bewirb dich trotzdem. Wir finden gemeinsam heraus, ob es passt - und zeigen dir, was du noch brauchst. Womit du bei uns punktest: Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik oder Mechatronik Hohe fachliche Kompetenz gepaart mit Teamgeist Leidenschaft für den Umgang mit neuen Technologien und solide Erfahrungen in der Entwicklung mit Siemens TIA Portal oder Beckhoff TwinCat 3 Kenntnisse in der Netzwerktechnik und idealerweise Erfahrung mit MQTT Eine praktische, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise Engagement, Flexibilität und Eigeninitiative Freude am Lernen und an der eigenen Weiterentwicklung Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Durchsetzungsfähigkeit Was du von uns erwarten kannst: Wir legen Wert auf Verlässlichkeit - auch als Arbeitgeber. Das zeigen wir nicht nur im Alltag, sondern auch mit den folgenden Angeboten: Innovative Projekte - individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten - flache Hierarchien Überdurchschnittliche Bezahlung Attraktive Sozialleistungen, z.B. private Unfallversicherung Home-Office Möglichkeit Flexible Arbeitszeiten Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag ,,Bring a Friend"- Bonus JobBike Firmenevents und Ausflüge Tolle Kollegen und Du-Mentalität Aus gesetzlichen Gründen sind wir verpflichtet darauf hinzuweisen, dass das kollektivvertragliche Mindestgehalt für diese Position bei monatlich EUR 4.000,00 brutto liegt. Unsere attraktiven Gehaltspakete orientieren sich jedoch an aktuellen Marktgehältern und liegen daher deutlich über dem angegebenen Mindestgehalt. Interesse geweckt?   Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Ansprechpartner für Bewerbung: Frau Esther Burchard - HR Manager

jobs.title: Senior Tech Lead DXP
jobs.description:
The DXP (Digital Experience Platform) team is delivering build (projects) and run (support) services for all Envaliorcustomer facing websites. Envalior is currently extending this team and is looking for an experienced Tech Lead engineer, who interacts with a diverse range of technical and non-technical stakeholders.

The Senior Tech Lead is a subject matter expert and trusted advisor within the IT Marketing & Sales domain. Youwill design & develop information solutions focused on our Customer Facing Web Applications in a to be setup Headless/ Composable IT architecture, to maximize business value combining existing and new technologies (like our CMS,eCommerce and our Product Catalog), focused on improving our Customer Experience and Monitization of customerinteraction. You will have a profound knowledge of frontend frameworks, plus adequate knowledge of its technologies,processes and interfaces in the domain.

As the Senior Tech Lead you will oversee the overall platform roadmap, from definition to delivery. You will workclosely with product owners, other software engineers and developers to make sure best practices are applied to ensure high standards in all areas. You possess great planning and presentation skills. You will shape the direction of functional and nonfunctional requirements to their fruition. As part of your role, you will provide leadership and mentoring to the rest of the team.

MAIN RESPONSIBILTIES

  • Focuses on the technology, code quality, and architecture, rarely handling administrative duties like performance reviews or HR budgets.
  • Architectural Decisions: Owns high-level system design, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Hands-on Development: Spends a significant portion of time overlooking & writing code, reviewing pull requests, and enforcing coding standards.
  • Technical Bridge: Translates business and product requirements into technical roadmaps with the product owner, acting as a liaison between management and developers.
  • Mentorship: Upskills team members, leads code reviews, and resolves technical disagreements
  • Develop reusable UI components using frameworks like React/Nuxt or Vue.js
  • Collaborate in a blended scrum team with internal and external developers
  • Integrate UX designs from Figma into front-end code
  • Optimize user experience across websites and portals
  • Contribute to the architecture of our Headless / MACH solutions
  • Document and maintain components in Storybook
  • Actively participate in sprint planning, reviews, and demos

Requirements

  • 5 years experience in an architectural role or CMS senior development role
  • Preferenced working experience in Contentstack CMS
  • Working experience in Headless / Composable / MACH architecture
  • Ability to guide architecture, design, development and operation discussions and decisions
  • Extensive development experience in Javascript and related development workflows, tools and storefronts (React & Vue.js, libraries & frameworks)
  • Proficiency with advanced Git workflows, code review processes and branch management
  • Focus areas with management knowledge:
    • Backend (CMS) software engineering
    • Frontend/UX engineering
    • Infrastructure design
    • Testing
  • Agile / Scrum way of working knowledge & experience

Benefits

WHY ENVALIOR?

Competitive Compensation:

Join us at Envalior and enjoy competitive compensation packages, inclusive of a global bonus program and performance bonuses, ensuring your hard work is recognized and rewarded.

Comprehensive Benefits:

Your well-being matters to us. At Envalior, we provide an array of benefits supporting your financial security, health, and overall well-being. This includes retirement plans, health programs, life insurance, and comprehensive medical care.

Work-Life Balance & Flexibility:

bližší informace o výši platu Vám sdělíme při osobním pohovoru,•    příplatek za vedení,•    osobní příplatek po zkušební době,•    čtvrtletní odměny,•    příspěvky z FKSP na stravování a na produkty spoření na stáří,•    zvýhodněnou zaměstnaneckou kartu na veřejnou dopravu v Ústeckém kraji,•    nástup možný ihned nebo podle dohody – na vhodného kolegu či kolegyni rádi počkáme.Naše hodnotyNaší prací je podpora lidí, aby žili životem podle svých představ.Věříme, že každý člověk má schopnost růst a rozvíjet se, když dostane správnou podporu a příležitost.Pokud to cítíte stejně, u nás se najdete. jobs.title: Group Business Controller
jobs.description: We don’t just build technology. We build hope for everyone dealing with Cancer.Elekta is shaping the standard of care, together with healthcare providers, by developing precision radiation medicine that brings advanced radiotherapy into routine clinical practice. Our solutions support consistent, efficient and personalized care, addressing evolving patient needs. Through adaptive radiotherapy, precision treatment delivery and integrated workflows, Elekta supports care teams across a range of clinical settings. Each year more than 2 million patients are treated using Elekta solutions across over 130 countries. Elekta is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, with over 4,000 employees and offices in more than 40 countries. The company is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. For more information, visit elekta.com.What You’ll Do At ElektaAs a Group Business Controller, you will play a central role in our Group Business Control function, helping provide senior management with clear, reliable financial insights that support informed decision-making.You will lead and coordinate group-wide planning and forecasting, analyse financial performance and key business drivers, and work closely with regions, business lines and the wider finance community. Through strong financial analysis and business partnering, you will help strengthen performance, improve the quality and consistency of reporting, and drive greater cost awareness across the Group.Responsibilities    Coordinate the Group budget and forecast cycles, including consolidation, challenging assumptions and explaining changes in outlook.    Analyse and quality assure Group financial performance against budget, forecast and prior periods, identifying key revenue, margin, expense and cash drivers.    Lead performance reviews with regions and business areas, agree follow-up actions and track progress.    Prepare concise financial reports, insights and decision material for senior management and the Board of Directors.    Develop Group performance measures, reporting definitions and processes to improve consistency and comparability across the business.    Act as a finance business partner to senior stakeholders, providing analysis on costs, strategic initiatives, risks and opportunities.    Support a reliable monthly close and contribute financial analysis and quality review to interim, annual and other external reporting.    Partner with Finance and IT to improve financial BI applications, data quality and reporting processes.What You’ll Bring    Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, industrial engineering or a similar field.    At least 5+ years of experience in financial analysis, business planning, forecasting and performance management.    Experience with financial reporting, consolidation, planning and BI systems.    Ability to translate complex financial information into clear, concise insights and decision material for senior stakeholders.    Strong stakeholder management and business partnering skills, with the ability to work effectively across regions, business lines and functions.    High attention to detail and sound financial judgement.    Ability to challenge assumptions constructively and turn financial analysis into practical recommendations.    A collaborative approach and the ability to build effective relationships across a global finance organisation.    Fluency in both English and Swedish is preferred.What You’ll Get    30 paid vacation days per year.    4 additional Elekta days off.    Defined contribution pension scheme.    Private Medical Insurance.    Lunch Benefit.    Contribution to wellness activities.    A collaborative office environment four days a week, working alongside talented colleagues in a supportive and engaging workplace.Application processWe look forward to receiving your application. Please submit your CV in English via the “Apply” button. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Sognepræst (kbf) i Ranum-Malle-Vilsted Pastorat, Vesthimmerlands Provsti, Viborg Stift - genopslag
jobs.description:
Stillingen som tjenestemandsansat sognepræst i Ranum-Malle-Vilsted Pastorat, Vesthimmerlands Provsti er ledig til besættelse den 1. februar 2027 eller snarest derefter.

Til stillingen er knyttet en forpligtelse som kirkebogsfører og begravelsesmyndighed.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling.

Som ny sognepræst får du et introduktionsforløb, hvor du får en mentor, der guider dig igennem i den første tid i embedet og sætter dig nærmere ind i de forskellige arbejdsopgaver, der er for en præst.

I embedsbeskrivelsen fra menighedsrådet kan du læse om sognet / pastoratet og hvilke tanker, menighedsrådet gør sig om det ledige embede. Embedsbeskrivelsen kan læses på Viborg Stifts hjemmeside www.viborgstift.dk og på stiftets sociale medier samt på Præsteforeningens hjemmeside.

Har du lyst til at læse mere om Ranum-Malle-Vilsted Pastorat og hvordan kirkelivet m.v. er i sognene / Pastoratet, kan du også orientere dig på Pastoratets hjemmeside: www.ranum-malle-vilsted.dk.

Stillingen er omfattet af Bekendtgørelse af lov om ansættelse i stillinger i folkekirken m.v. (LBK nr. 864 af 25/6/2013)

Stillingen aflønnes efter løngruppe 1 i aftale om aflønning af tjenestemandsansatte præster i folkekirken.

Ud over selve lønnen ydes et rådighedstillæg med et afrundet grundbeløb pr. 31. marts 2012 for en fuldtidsstilling på kr. 43.000,00 årligt. Ved deltidsansættelse vil der ske beregning af tillægget i forhold til ansættelseskvoten.

Stillingen er omfattet af reglerne om Ny Løn, hvorfor det er muligt at ønske en lønforhandling.

Der er knyttet tjenestebolig til stillingen. Tjenesteboligen ligger på adressen Solbakkevej 8A, 9680 Ranum.

Boligbidraget for tjenesteboligen excl. udgifter til el, vand og varme udgør på nuværende tidspunkt kr. 3832,00. Tjenesteboligen vil blive vurderet inden indflytning, og boligbidraget vil blive fastsat ud fra denne vurdering.

Det forudsættes, at ansøgere har kørekort til almindelig bil (B) og er villig til at bruge egen bil i jobbet.

Er du endnu ikke ordineret, bedes du sende kopi af eksamenspapirer og attest fra Pastoralseminariet sammen med din ansøgning.

Hvis du indstilles til stillingen, vil der blive indhentet børneattest.

Alle kvalificerede ansøgere uanset køn opfordres til at søge stillingen.

Er du interesseret i stillingen og ønsker at sende en ansøgning, bedes du kontakte både menighedsråd og provst for at aftale et tidspunkt for et besøg og en samtale, inden ansøgningsfristen udløber.

Er det første gang du søger embede, bedes du kontakte biskoppens sekretær for at aftale et tidspunkt for en samtale med biskop Henrik Stubkjær, ligeledes inden ansøgningsfristen udløber.

Ansøgningen skal stiles til Kirkeministeriet, men skal sendes til biskoppen over Viborg Stift pr. mail til: kmvib@km.dk. Ansøgningen skal være biskoppen i hænde senest opslagets udløbsdato kl. 15.00.

Kontaktoplysninger menighedsrådsformand Peter Greth Jensen, Ranum-Malle SognTelefon 4016 9911 ∙ E-mail: sigsgaarden@gmail.com

Kontaktoplysninger menighedsrådsformand Ingeborg Marie Holm Nielsen, Vilsted SognTelefon 20226896 ∙ E-mail: ingeborgpeer@gmail.com

Kontaktoplysninger provst Hanne Petersen, Vesthimmerlands Provsti: Telefon 2057 9909 ∙ E-mail: hpe@km.dk

Kontaktoplysninger Viborg StiftTelefon 8662 0911∙ E-mail: kmvib@km.dk                   

Kontaktoplysninger biskop Henrik Stubkjær,v/bispesekretær Mie Kirkegaard Mogensen:Telefon 8726 2170 ∙ E-mail: mikm@km.dk

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch und Französisch, idealerweise auch Schweizerdeutsch

 

What we offer

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About DeepJudge:

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.

Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.

 

About the role:
DeepJudge is a fast-growing venture-backed startup at the forefront of applying Artificial Intelligence in the legal domain. Founded by ex-Googlers and ETH PhDs, our mission is to help legal teams harness their collective knowledge so they can focus on the strategic aspects of their work. DeepJudge’s state-of-the-art knowledge retrieval system directs legal professionals to the internal insights that matter most, providing a strong foundation for AI-powered workflows. We’re headquartered in Zurich, with a team in the United States and Canada, and cater to clients all around the world.

We are looking for a thoughtful and strategic Product Marketing Manager to help shape how we communicate the value of AI-powered legal solutions to the market. As a subject matter expert on our products, you will craft compelling messaging, develop go-to-market strategies, and collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure our positioning resonates with customers.

This is an exciting opportunity for a marketer who is passionate about making complex technology approachable and valuable for legal professionals. You are a great fit for this role if you have a proven track record in B2B SaaS product marketing, a talent for crafting compelling messaging, and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally to drive product launches, customer adoption, and market success.


What you’ll be doing

  • Craft compelling messaging and positioning that articulates the value of DeepJudge to our core audiences, ensuring consistency across all touchpoints.

  • Lead the launch of new features and products, collaborating closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to ensure successful adoption and engagement.

  • Act as a proactive advocate for DeepJudge’s product by sharing product features, use cases, and insights across the company.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders in Product, Marketing, and Commercial teams to create effective enablement materials and ensure alignment with strategic goals.

  • Gather and synthesize customer and market insights to provide actionable feedback that informs product development and enhances product-market fit.

  • Translate data and findings into actionable insights that drive decisions and fuel impactful product and feature updates.

  • Collaborate with the Marketing team to support marketing campaigns for new product features and updates.

  • Create, monitor, and analyze product marketing performance metrics to guide strategic actions.

  • Use tools such as Hubspot, Figma, Webflow, Linear, and G Suite to manage projects, analyze data, and create content, with a focus on data-driven decision-making

What we are looking for

  • 3+ years of product marketing experience, in the B2B SaaS or technology space (legal tech strongly preferred but will consider experience within complex data/AI enterprise software space)

  • Overall 5-8 years of experience as product marketer, marketing solutions, product management or product strategy

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. Writing experience is important (share your portfolio or submit a writing sample with your application)

  • Comfortable with user data and have experience in industry and customer research

  • Translate data into actionable insights, ensuring decisions are grounded in evidence, not assumptions

  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment, managing multiple priorities with attention to detail

  • Analytical data-driven mindset, but orientation towards getting things done quickly and efficiently

  • Ideally, experience collaborating with Marketing on account-based and content strategies

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field

What you can look forward to

  • You will be able to take on full ownership of your projects and tasks from day 1

  • You will have a stake in shaping the future of a high-impact, high-growth deep-tech startup

  • Competitive compensation, flexible working arrangements

At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If this role excites you, but you feel you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a great fit.

jobs.title: Component Engineer
jobs.description:
For our client, we are looking for a Component Engineer. In this role, you will take ownership of component-related activities, working closely with product development, sourcing, quality, and manufacturing teams in a global environment.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

This is an excellent opportunity for an electronics professional who enjoys combining technical expertise with cross-functional collaboration and long-term product lifecycle management.

What we are looking for:
- B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Electronics Engineering or a related field
- Minimum 2 years of experience as an Electronics Designer, Component Engineer, or in a similar role

- Strong technical understanding of one or more of the following areas:
 Digital components (microprocessors, FPGAs, memories)
 Analog components (A/D converters, amplifiers, switches)
 Discrete components (transistors, diodes, resistors, capacitors)
 Electromechanical components (connectors, cables, cooling solutions)
 Transformers and magnetic components
 Optical components
 Display and touchscreen technologies

While the role covers a broad range of component technologies, the current focus is particularly on electromechanical and mechanical components, making experience from mechanical engineering, product design, or industrial hardware development valuable.

Preferred qualifications:
- Understanding of component quality, reliability, and lifecycle management
- Knowledge of electronic design tools and development processes
- Experience in mechanical engineering or product mechanics
- Familiarity with PCB and PCBA manufacturing technologies
- Ability to read and interpret schematics and PCB layouts
- Knowledge of IPC standards and related industry standards
- Understanding of IEC, ANSI, EMC, environmental requirements, and UL approval processes
- Familiarity with RoHS, REACH, and other material compliance regulations
- Experience with PLM systems
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have at least 2 years of experience in electronics design or component engineering?*
- Have you worked with electronic component selection, qualification, or lifecycle management?*
- Can you read and interpret electronic schematics and PCB layouts?*
- Do you have experience with PCB or PCBA manufacturing technologies?*
- Have you worked with IPC, IEC, ANSI, or UL standards?*
- Do you have experience using PLM systems?*
- Do you have hands-on experience with electromechanical or mechanical components such as connectors, cabling, cooling solutions, enclosures, or related industrial hardware?*

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role.

Location: Vaasa, Finland (hybrid)
Allocation: 100 %
Start date: Asap
Duration: Long term assignment 
Language: Fluent in English, Finnish is considered an advantage 

We offer you: We offer a versatile assignment where every day is different and interesting. We also offer a very competitive salary and good employee benefits.

Are you interested in becoming a part of our dynamic team? The position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found, so please be quick and submit your application! 

Please include your salary expectation in your application. For more information, contact Kimmo Kärsämä, tel. 050 412 7500, kimmo.karsama@lokki.fi

jobs.title: Uthyrare, säljare, affärsutvecklare
jobs.description: Konceptutvecklare & B2B-Säljare till Uthyres.euVill du driva och utveckla ett framgångsrikt boendekoncept mot storföretag, samtidigt som du optimerar vår verksamhet genom strategisk försäljning?Vi på Uthyres.eu befinner oss i en spännande expansionsfas. Just nu har vi ett 20-tal möblerade bostäder, har nära full beläggning och håller på att utveckla ytterligare ca 10 bostäder. Vårt strategiska mål är tydligt: vi lämnar korttidsuthyrning helt bakom oss för att enbart fokusera på långtidsavtal med storföretag och deras underentreprenörer. Vår absolut största målgrupp just nu är vindkraftsföretag och aktörer kopplade till vindkraftsindustrin.Vi söker nu en mångsidig nyckelperson som kan ta ett helhetsansvar för både vår kundtillväxt och vår interna resursoptimering.Om rollenI den här kombinerade rollen får du ett brett och affärsdrivande ansvarsområde:    B2B-Försäljning & Konceptutveckling: Du driver vårt boendekoncept framåt genom att identifiera och etablera kontakt med nya företagskunder samt fördjupa relationerna med våra befintliga samarbetspartners.    Avyttring & Resursoptimering: Du ansvarar för att sälja av fordon, fastigheter och maskiner som verksamheten inte längre använder, vilket frigör resurser för vår kärnverksamhet.    Operativt teamwork (valfritt men meriterande): Om du även vill och kan kavla upp ärmarna i vardagen finns stora möjligheter att arbeta fysiskt tillsammans med vårt lilla team. Det kan handla om allt från inredning, renovering och bygglovshantering till att ta emot gäster.Vem är du?Vi söker dig som är en affärsorienterad relationsbyggare med ett starkt driv. Du trivs med att ta egna initiativ och rör dig obehindrat mellan strategisk försäljning och praktisk problemlösning.Kvalifikationer och erfarenheter:    Erfarenhet av B2B-försäljning och avtalshantering.    Det är en stor fördel om du har ett etablerat nätverk och egna kundkontakter inom industrin eller liknande branscher.    Erfarenhet av att värdera och sälja av maskiner, fordon eller fastigheter är starkt meriterande.    En flexibel prestigelöshet – du trivs i ett mindre, entreprenöriellt team där vägen från idé till beslut är kort.Vad vi erbjuderVi erbjuder en självständig och dynamisk roll i ett stabilt företag som går bra och expanderar. Du får stora möjligheter att sätta din egen prägel på tjänsten och vara med och forma vår fortsatta tillväxtresa.Ansökan och kontaktLäs gärna mer om oss på www.uthyres.eu.Skicka din ansökan (CV och ett kort personligt brev) till application@billebro.se. Urval sker löpande.Välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.title: Identity & Access Management Engineer
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 

Position description

We are looking for an experienced Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer to design, build, and operate the identity platforms that secure access to our applications, infrastructure, and data. You will own the technical direction of our IAM ecosystem, including authentication, authorization, lifecycle management, and privileged access. You will work with security, IT, engineering, and compliance teams to deliver a secure, scalable, and user-friendly access experience aligned with Zero Trust principles.


What you will do

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise IAM solutions, including SSO, MFA, federation, and directory services.

  • Architect and manage identity lifecycle processes (joiner/mover/leaver), automating provisioning and deprovisioning across SaaS, cloud, and on-prem systems.

  • Implement and operate Privileged Access Management (PAM), including vaulting, session management, and just-in-time access.

  • Lead Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) initiatives such as access reviews, certifications, role-based access control (RBAC), and segregation-of-duties controls.

  • Integrate applications with the identity platform using SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and LDAP.

  • Develop automation and tooling (APIs, scripts, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code) to reduce manual identity operations.

jobs.title: Vi søger en pædagog, der tør tage ansvar for verdens vigtigste job og som ved, at de første år i et barns liv fortjener vores allerbedste pædagogik
jobs.description:
Ved vores seneste pædagogiske tilsyn blev Børnehuset Degnebakken placeret i den højeste faglige kvalitet. Det er vi stolte af. Men vi ser det ikke som en anledning til at læne os tilbage. Tværtimod, for høj faglig kvalitet er ikke noget, man bliver færdig med. Det er noget, vi skaber hver eneste dag i mødet med børnene, i vores relationer, i vores refleksioner og i de valg, vi træffer som professionelle.

Lige nu søger vi en pædagog til vores vuggestue .Og for os er vuggestuen ikke bare begyndelsen på institutionslivet men det er her, nogle af de allervigtigste fundamenter bliver lagt. Det er her, barnet skal opleve:Jeg er værd at være sammen med.Der er voksne, som ser mig og prøver at forstå mig.Jeg kan noget selv.Jeg hører til i et fællesskab.Verden er et trygt og spændende sted at gå på opdagelse i.

De mindste børn fortæller os ikke altid med ord, hvad de har brug for. Derfor skal vi være voksne, der ser, mærker og er nysgerrige på børnenes initiativer. Voksne, som forstår, at omsorg og pædagogik ikke er hinandens modsætninger, men hænger uløseligt sammen. Hos os ligger pædagogikken også i de små øjeblikke. Når et barn prøver selv. Når vi tager strømper på. Når vi spiser. Når et barn rækker hånden ud. Når to børn opdager hinanden. Når vi synger den samme sang igen og igen. Og når et barn har brug for en voksen, der bliver, også når noget er svært.

I Degnebakken tror vi på:at børn altid gør det bedste, de kanat nærværende voksne er afgørende for børns tryghed, trivsel og udviklingat stærke relationer ikke opstår af sig selv, men kræver voksne, der er til stede og tager ansvarat børn udvikler sig gennem leg, relationer, deltagelse og hverdagens små øjeblikkeat når et barn står på kanten af fællesskabet, skal vi først kigge på rammerne, relationerne og vores egen praksisat børn har forskellige forudsætninger, og derfor kan have brug for noget forskelligt fra osat vores professionelle undren gør os dygtigereog at det altid er de voksnes ansvar at justere pædagogikken, når noget bliver svært for et barn eller i børnefællesskabet.Det betyder ikke, at vi altid har det rigtige svar. Det betyder, at vi er villige til at lede efter det sammen.

Hvorfor vuggestuen? Fordi vuggestuepædagogik er noget helt særligt. Du får lov til at følge den enorme udvikling, der sker i de første år. De første relationer. De første venskaber. Sproget, der vokser frem. Kroppen, der kan mere og mere. Barnet, der langsomt opdager: Jeg kan selv.Men du bliver også den voksne, barnet skal kunne låne ro, mod og tryghed af. Derfor leder vi efter en pædagog, som kan se det store i det små.

Måske er du vores nye kollega, hvis du:er uddannet pædagog og brænder for dit fager omsorgsfuld, nærværende og tydeliger nysgerrig på børnenes initiativer og perspektivertør stille spørgsmål til din egen og vores fælles praksishar lyst til at bidrage til et stærkt arbejdsfællesskabog selvfølgelig gerne vil lege, synge, fjolle, være på gulvet og grine sammen med både børn og kolleger.

Hvad får du hos os?Du får dygtige og stabile kolleger, som tager deres faglighed alvorligt og hjælper hinanden i hverdagen. Du får en arbejdsplads med høje faglige ambitioner, men også plads til at være menneske.Du får mulighed for at sætte dit faglige aftryk og være med til at udvikle vores pædagogiske praksis.Du får et hus, hvor vi samarbejder på tværs og bruger hinandens forskellige styrker.Du får en leder, der tror på, at gode løsninger bliver bedre, når vi finder dem sammen.

Vi lover ikke, at alle dage bliver nemme, for vi arbejder med børn, relationer og fællesskaber. Det kan være fantastisk. Det kan være udfordrende. Og nogle dage kan det være begge dele inden frokost. Men vi lover, at du ikke står alene med det.

Hvis du kan genkende dig selv i vores måde at tænke børn og pædagogik på, vil vi rigtig gerne høre fra dig. Og du behøver faktisk ikke nøjes med at læse om os. Ring og lav en aftale om at komme forbi. Mød børnene, se vuggestuen og tal med os. Få en fornemmelse af hverdagen og mærk efter, om Degnebakken også kunne være dit sted. Vi vil nemlig hellere lære dig at kende end bare at læse dit CV.Vi glæder os til at møde dig.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer fra 1/1-2027 og det er i vuggestuen .Ansøgningsfrist: 22.november Kontakt leder Sabine Holm-Hansen på 72599444, hvis du vil vide mere eller aftale et besøg.

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager | Toxic
jobs.description:
Op duizenden werkvloeren in Nederland wordt dagelijks gewerkt met gevaarlijke stoffen. Dat kan veilig, als je weet wat je in huis hebt, wat het doet en welke regels erbij horen. Daar helpt Sdu Toxic organisaties bij. Toxic is de meest complete SaaS-oplossing voor wet- en regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland. Organisaties registreren er hun stoffen mee, beoordelen blootstelling, leggen maatregelen vast en informeren hun medewerkers. Zo helpen we QHSE-professionals om mensen veilig te laten werken en aan de arbowetgeving te voldoen. Achter Toxic staat een team met diepgaande kennis van chemische producten en de regels die erbij horen. En een succesvol marketing- en salesteam dat zorgt dat steeds meer organisaties ons vinden.

Toxic is onderdeel van Lefebvre Sdu, dat al 200 jaar bouwt aan juridische en fiscale kennis, en van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider op dat gebied. De vraag groeit. Onze Commercieel Medewerkers Binnendienst en marketing plannen meer afspraken in dan we nu kunnen afronden. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Accountmanager die van die gesprekken klanten maakt.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT

Jij bent het gezicht van Toxic. Voor de veiligheidskundigen, managers en directies die met ons werken, word jij degene die ze kennen en vertrouwen. Je leert hun organisatie kennen, luistert naar wat er speelt en denkt mee over wat ze nodig hebben. Zo bouw je relaties die jaren meegaan, en groeit Toxic met je klanten mee.

  • Je leert je klanten kennen: hun mensen, hun processen en wat er bij hen speelt. Zo word je hun vaste gesprekspartner en denk je mee over de volgende stap.

  • Elke nieuwe relatie begint met een goed gesprek. De binnendienst en marketing plannen de afspraken, jij bereidt je voor en ontdekt wat een organisatie nodig heeft. Daarnaast zoek je zelf nieuwe kansen.

  • In je demo's laat je zien hoe Toxic werkt en wat het oplevert. Gaat de vraag verder dan het standaardplatform? Dan werk je met collega's een oplossing op maat uit, met API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen.

  • Je bouwt relaties met veiligheidskundigen, inkopers en directie, brengt hun belangen samen in 1 voorstel en sluit deals met een hogere dealwaarde.

  • Met strategische accountplannen houd je overzicht op je belangrijkste klanten. Je ziet kansen voor up- en cross-sell en herkent retentierisico's vroeg. Samen met Customer Success zorg je dat nieuwe klanten goed starten.

  • Je houdt je pipeline en forecast actueel in Salesforce en deelt wat je bij klanten hoort met marketing en product.

  • Als senior ben je mentor en sparringpartner voor collega-accountmanagers.

Currently, our operations cover our busy restaurant service, takeaway, and event catering, and we are looking for the right person to take responsibility for the day-to-day organization and operational flow of our kitchen.

jobs.title: Support Engineer I (NYC, Weekend Shift)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


As a Support Engineer you are at the forefront of helping those developers create. In a given day you’ll help folks with all sorts of things ranging from general Replit usage questions, identifying and debugging issues on the platform and helping to build and maintain the tools we use. We use tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and Replit itself to get the job done. We also value solving the problems we can ourselves. We have a number of tools we build and maintain ourselves.



You will work on a small, global team of support specialists and engineers united by Replit's mission to make the next billion software creators. Together, you'll ensure developers worldwide have the support they need to bring their ideas to life.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Work directly with Replit customers via support tickets to solve technical product issues, bugs, and provide technical guidance while meeting daily ticket volume and resolution time targets.

 - Collaborate with the rest of the Support team in telling the story of our users to the rest of Replit.

 - Directly contribute to and maintain the Support team's Knowledge Base.

 - Support customer-facing communications for outages and incidents and swiftly report ongoing bugs for Eng to triage and fix.

 - Prior experience in software development or relevant technical support experience

 - Proven ability to work efficiently in fast-paced, high-volume support environments with strict productivity metrics.

 - Strong time management and ticket triage skills with comfort in performance tracking and regular reporting.

 - Excellent communication skills with initiative to ask questions when encountered with the unknown.

NICE TO HAVE:

WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex operational challenges systematically and devise effective solutions

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

jobs.description:
Er du en passioneret og struktureret leder, der brænder for god mad, højt humør og fremragende gæsteservice? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Hos Ralphy’s Fried Chicken på Nørre Allé brænder vi for at levere byens bedste og mest saftige fried chicken. Vi har travlt, og vi søger derfor en stærk og engageret restaurantansvarlig fra 1. december 2026, som vil være med til at drive og videreudvikle restauranten.

  • Daglig drift: Sikre en smidig og effektiv drift af restauranten og køkkenet i tæt samarbejde med teamet.

  • Lager og bestillingsstyring: Holde overblik over råvarer, lagerbeholdning og bestillinger hos leverandører.

  • Er stærk til overblik, struktur og kan holde hovedet koldt, når der er travlt.

  • Er en god kommunikator, der kan lede og samle et ungt og energisk team.

  • Tager ejerskab, er mødestabil og går forrest med et højt serviceniveau.

  • Taler og forstår dansk og/eller engelsk.

  • En nøglerolle i en spændende og voksende restaurant.

  • Et dynamisk og uformelt arbejdsmiljø med gode kolleger.

  • Opstart 1. december 2026.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og lukker opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Adresse: Nørre Allé 22F, 8000 Aarhus C

Startdato: 1. december 2026

Ben jij een technisch talent met een passie voor de maritieme sector? Heb je ervaring met het onderhouden en herstellen van scheepsmotoren en andere scheepsinstallaties? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Als scheepsmechanicien te Zeebrugge ben je verantwoordelijk voor het onderhoud en de reparaties van verschillende scheepsonderdelen. Je speelt een cruciale rol in het waarborgen van de operationele betrouwbaarheid en veiligheid van onze schepen.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Uitvoeren van preventief onderhoud aan scheepsmotoren, hydraulische en pneumatische systemen en andere mechanische installaties.
  • Diagnose stellen en verhelpen van mechanische storingen en defecten.
  • Uitvoeren van reparaties en vervangingen van onderdelen, zowel op locatie als in de werkplaats.
  • Samenwerken met de technische dienst om verbeteringen en aanpassingen aan de installaties te implementeren.
  • Registreren van uitgevoerde werkzaamheden en rapporteren van bevindingen.
  • Waarborgen van de naleving van veiligheids- en milieuregels tijdens alle werkzaamheden.
  • Deelname aan storingsdiensten in geval van urgente problemen.
  • Afgeronde opleiding als scheepsmechanicien, werktuigkundige of vergelijkbaar.
  • Ervaring met het onderhouden en repareren van scheepsmotoren en mechanische systemen.
  • Kennis van hydrauliek, pneumatiek, elektrotechniek en scheepssystemen.
  • Zelfstandig kunnen werken, maar ook goed functioneren binnen een team.
  • Probleemoplossend vermogen en oog voor detail.
  • Flexibiliteit en bereidheid om te reizen.

jobs.title: Vendeur en magasin spécialisé  en pisciculture
jobs.description:
Pour notre client situ dans la région de Mouscron, nous recherchons un vendeur en magasin spécialisé en pisciculture.

Il s'agit d'un contrat intrim en vue d'un CDI.

Pour réussir en tant qu'employé de magasin en pisciculture, il est nécessaire d'allier des compétences techniques en aquaculture (soins des animaux, gestion de l'eau) à des compétences commerciales et relationnelles pour conseiller la clientèle.

Compétences techniques et aquacoles

• Connaissance des espèces : Identifier les poissons, leurs besoins spécifiques et leurs comportements.

• Gestion de la qualité de l'eau : Maîtriser les paramètres physico-chimiques (pH, température, oxygène...)

• Entretien des installations : Nettoyer et maintenir les bassins, aquariums, systèmes de filtration et pompes.

• Alimentation et soins : Rationner la nourriture selon les espèces et repérer les signes de maladies ou de stress.

Compétences commerciales et relationnelles

• Conseil client : Guider les acheteurs (particuliers ou professionnels) sur le choix des espèces et du matériel.

• Vente et encaissement : Maîtriser les techniques de vente, l'utilisation de la caisse et la gestion des transactions.

• Fidélisation : Développer une relation de confiance grâce à une posture accueillante et professionnelle.

- Avoir des connaissances en pisciculture.

- Bilingue ou avoir des connaissances en Neerlandais

- Avoir des connaissances en bassins de jardin (entretien des bassins avec filtration autour, poissons d'eau froide, ...)

- Pouvoir conseiller les clients sur les diffrents types de nourriture pour poissons

- Pouvoir conseiller les clients sur les différents types d'aquariums, sur les produits d'entretiens des aquariums...

jobs.title: Technieker Workshop Sales
jobs.description:
Van diagnose en herstelling tot montage en technische aanpassingen: jij zorgt ervoor dat onze machines technisch helemaal klaar zijn voor hun volgende eigenaar.

Als technieker binnen Workshop Sales werk je aan nieuwe en tweedehandsmachines die we verkopen. Je zorgt ervoor dat elke machine technisch in orde is en klaarstaat voor de klant.

Je komt terecht in een team van ongeveer vier techniekers, waaronder elektrotechniekers en elektromechaniekers. Je werkt nauw samen met je collega's en wordt in je ontwikkeling begeleid door een specialist. Heb je nog niet alle kennis in huis? Geen probleem. We investeren in de opleiding van onze techniekers en leren je de kneepjes van het vak.

Wat doe je precies?

  • Je maakt nieuwe en tweedehandsmachines verkoopklaar.

  • Je monteert accessoires en past nieuwe machines aan volgens de wensen van de klant.

  • Je stelt parameters in en bouwt onder andere track units in.

  • Je controleert machines op slijtage, storingen en technische gebreken.

  • Je stelt diagnoses en voert herstellingen uit.

  • Je herstelt onder andere hydraulische lekken en demonteert overbodige accessoires.

  • Je controleert de veiligheidsfuncties en zorgt ervoor dat de machine technisch volledig in orde is.

  • Je zorgt mee voor de finale afwerking van de machine, zoals het aanbrengen van de juiste stickers.

  • Je werkt met verschillende types machines en bouwt zo een brede technische kennis op van mechanica, hydraulica, elektriciteit en elektronica.

  • Je hebt een technische opleiding gevolgd, bijvoorbeeld TSO Autotechnieken, Elektromechanica of een gelijkwaardige richting, of je hebt relevante ervaring.

  • Je hebt een goede technische basis en werkt graag met machines.

  • Je kan werken met test- en diagnoseapparatuur en technische schema's lezen.

  • Je hebt kennis van mechanica. Ervaring met hydraulica, sensoren en elektrische componenten is een plus.

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig en bereid om bij te leren.

  • Je spreekt vlot Nederlands. Kennis van het Frans en Engels is een plus.

Nog niet alle nodige kennis of attesten? Geen probleem. Wij voorzien de nodige opleidingen en attesten, zoals een heftruck- en hoogwerkerattest.

jobs.title: Pædagogiskassistent søges til barselsvikariat på ca. 30 timer om ugen
jobs.description:
Fribørnehuset i Øster Jølby har 9 motiverede og engagerede medarbejdere, 32 glade børn og deres forældre. Vi mangler en pædagogiskarssistent til en stilling på 30 timer om ugen i en tidsbegrænset stilling frem til sommerferien 2027. Vuggestuen og børnehaven ligger sammen og har fælles ledelse. Der kan være dage f.eks. ved sygemeldinger o. lign. hvor personalet dækker hinanden ind på tværs af vuggestue og børnehave. Det vil være et stort plus, hvis du på nuværende har erfaring fra tilsvarende job, eller hvis du har spændende kompetencer f.eks. indenfor motorik eller musik.

Hvem er du?Som person forventer vi, at du er interesseret i:

  • At skabe en tæt kontakt til børn, kollegaer og forældre.

  • At stimulere børnene til at blive selvhjulpne og robuste.

  • At lege på gulvet sammen med børnene.

  • At bruge din fantasi og kreativitet i legen sammen med børnene.

  • At tage ansvar og arbejde selvstændigt.

  • At være med til at udvikle vores læringsmiljø.

  • At deltage i arbejdet med udviklingen af vores pædagogiske læreplan.

  • At deltage i et aktivt personalesamarbejde.

  • At være ude, også når det er koldt og vådt.

Hvem er vi? 

Fribørnehuset bygger ligesom friskolen på de Grundtvig-Koldske værdier. Vi er centralt placeret i Øster Jølby - tæt på hal og Præstbro anlægget. Fribørnehuset lægger vægt på at skabe gode rammer og styrke trivsel, udvikling og læring for både børn og medarbejdere. Vi er ”Grønne Spirer” og vi er meget ude året rundt. Vi har en dejlig stor legeplads med masser af muligheder. Vi har ofte bål og værkstedsaktiviteter i gang. Vi tager også tit på ture ud af huset - både til skov, strand og på besøg ved virksomheder eller museer. Vi arbejder med de nye styrkede lærerplaner, og vi har særligt fokus på børnenes leg. Vi arbejder tæt sammen med friskolen, og deltager f.eks. nogle gange i deres morgensang og leger på deres legeplads. Vi modtager børn i alderen ½ år og op til skolestart. . Som ”Fribørnehus” lægger vi vægt på at rammerne er trygge og hjemlige, og omgangstonen bærer præg af humor og hjertevarme. Løn og ansættelsesforholdVi ønsker stillingen besat hurtigst muligt efter 1. december 2026. Løn- og ansættelsesforhold følger gældende overenskomst.

Ansøgningsfrist

Ansøgningsfrist d. 20. november kl. 12.00. Ansøgningen sendes til: Frihuset@ojf.dk

Hvis du gerne vil vide mere, eller har lyst til at besøge os, inden du sender din ansøgning, så ring og lav en aftale: 97741157

jobs.title: Brand Creative
jobs.description:
Bij Agristo willen we meer dan een sterk merk bouwen. We willen een merk creëren dat mensen ervaren, onthouden en overal herkennen. Op een beurs, tijdens een klantenevent, op sociale media, in een campagne of op een plek die we vandaag nog niet bedacht hebben.Als Brand Creative geef jij vorm aan die ervaringen. Jij vertaalt uitdagingen, verhalen en ideeën naar creatieve concepten die mensen zien, voelen en onthouden.Je bent een conceptuele denker met een sterk visueel inzicht. Je ziet kansen, legt verbanden en weet hoe je een idee kan omzetten in iets tastbaars. Soms is dat een krachtig design, soms een campagne, een video, een event of een totaalbeleving.Je bent niet iemand die gewoon een briefing uitvoert. Je vertrekt vanuit een blanco blad, ontwikkelt een sterk creatief idee en brengt het tot leven. Afhankelijk van het project werk je zelf de uitvoering uit of schakel je externe specialisten in, maar je blijft steeds creatief verantwoordelijk voor het eindresultaat.Je creëert ideeën die blijven hangen
  • Je vertaalt businessuitdagingen, producten en verhalen naar sterke creatieve concepten.
  • Je kijkt verder dan de voor de hand liggende oplossing en zoekt naar wat mensen echt zal opvallen en bijblijven.
  • Je maakt ideeën snel tastbaar via visuals, storyboards, prototypes of experience concepts.
  • Je beoordeelt creatieve voorstellen kritisch en tilt ideeën naar een hoger niveau.
  • Je gebruikt storytelling, design, content, video, motion, events of andere creatieve formats wanneer dat het concept versterkt.
Je maakt van contactmomenten echte merkervaringenElke interactie met Agristo is een kans om ons merk sterker te maken.
  • Je ontwikkelt creatieve concepten voor productlanceringen, klantenevents, beurzen, campagnes, employer branding en corporate communicatie.
  • Je denkt verder dan afzonderlijke middelen en creëert herkenbare ervaringen over verschillende touchpoints heen.
  • Je vertaalt complexe verhalen naar creatieve formats die impact maken.
  • Je zorgt ervoor dat elk contactmoment duidelijk aanvoelt als Agristo.
  • Je helpt mee bouwen aan een sterk internationaal merk dat lokaal relevant blijft.
Je brengt ideeën tot leven
  • Je neemt creatieve projecten op van eerste concept tot finale oplevering.
  • Je bepaalt welke expertise, tools en partners nodig zijn om een idee te realiseren.
  • Je werkt samen met collega’s, bureaus, fotografen, videomakers en andere externe partners.
  • Je schrijft sterke briefings en geeft duidelijke creatieve richting.
  • Je bewaakt kwaliteit, timing en merkconsistentie.
  • Je schakelt vlot tussen creatief denken, hands-on uitvoering en projectcoördinatie.
Je blijft ontdekken
  • Je volgt nieuwe technologieën, tools en creatieve trends op.
  • Je zet tools zoals Adobe Creative Cloud, AI, motion design, video, Canva of Copilot doelgericht in wanneer ze meerwaarde bieden.
  • Je helpt mee creatieve templates, systemen en tools ontwikkelen zodat collega’s wereldwijd het Agristo-merk consistent kunnen uitdragen.
  • Je bent een sterke conceptuele én visuele denker.
  • Je wacht niet op ideeën, je creëert ze zelf.
  • Je kan een idee snel vertalen naar iets concreets waar anderen op kunnen reageren.
  • Je hebt gevoel voor kwaliteit en weet het verschil tussen een goed en een uitzonderlijk idee.
  • Je begrijpt hoe je een idee van concept tot realisatie brengt.
  • Je werkt vlot samen met verschillende stakeholders en externe partners.
  • Je hebt een sterke basis als graphic designer en bent vertrouwd met Adobe Creative Cloud.
  • Je bent vooral een creatieve allrounder die zich moeiteloos beweegt tussen concept, design, content, video, beleving en coördinatie.
  • Je begrijpt hoe creativiteit kan bijdragen aan customer engagement, storytelling, employer branding en corporate communicatie.
  • Je bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technologieën en creatieve mogelijkheden.
  • Je neemt ownership en zorgt ervoor dat ideeën daadwerkelijk gerealiseerd worden.

jobs.title: PhD position in biology, specialisation in aquatic ecology
jobs.description: Department of Aquatic Resources (SLU Aqua)Third-cycle subject areaBiologyDescription of the doctoral projectA PhD position in biology with specialisation in aquatic ecology is available at the Department of Aquatic Resources at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU Aqua). The theme of the PhD project is on management and conservation methods of critically endangered fishes, focusing on Anguillid eels. Trap and Transport (T&T) is a management method used to enable fish to continue their migration in fragmented riverine systems, and to reduce hydropower turbine mortality for downstream migrating fish. Today, we lack knowledge regarding how T&T should be conducted to optimize the method from an eel’s perspective. The aim of this project is to answer some of these knowledge gaps through field studies, experiments, analysis of existing data, modelling, and via international expert knowledge exchange. The main questions that will be addressed are:     How can the core aspects of the T&T process be optimized from an eel’s perspective?    How is T&T currently conducted in different countries and what can we learn from each other?    In which Swedish watersheds should T&T be prioritized today and in the future?    In addition, the project aims to develop best practice guidelines for T&T to be used at a national and international scale. About the positionThe main task is to conduct the PhD thesis work under supervision, including development of the PhD student's methodological, theoretical, analytical, writing, and presentation skills. The PhD student will conduct experiments in the field, including handling of eels, tagging and more. The work will be done at SLU Aqua in Drottningholm (Stockholm), and at various field sites. The position includes collaboration with international researchers, and one of the co-supervisors is Dr. Derek Evans at the Agri-Food and Bioscience Institute (AFBI), Northern Ireland. The student will also collaborate closely with Dr. Jani Helminen, Natural Resources Institute (LUKE) Finland. RequirementsTo meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39). Specific entry requirements for the third-cycle courses and study programme in biology. To meet the specific entry requirements, you must have at least 90 HEC in biology-related subjects. This must include a degree project, and at least 30 HEC must be at second-cycle level.You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6. Desirable experience    Experience with animal experiments and/or fieldwork.    Experience working with fish.    Experience with relevant practical and statistical methods.    Experience with independent writing.    Experience with organising workshops or large meetings.    Experience with analysis of large datasets.    Experience in collaboration with commercial fishers, industries and management agencies.    Will contribute to a good working climate.    Good communication skills in English, written and spoken.    Driver’s licence.    Great emphasis on personal qualities, collaboration skills, analytical and problem-solving abilities, and capacity for independent work. About usAt the Department of Aquatic Resources (SLU Aqua) we are passionate about conservation and sustainable management of aquatic animals, including fish. We are geographically distributed across Sweden, and this PhD position will be based in Stockholm at the Institute of Freshwater Research, beautifully situated on the countryside on the island of Lovön right by lake Mälaren. We offer:     An excellent and professionally stimulating working environment with dedicated colleagues    Access to a broad international network of scientists    Salary as PhD research fellow in the state salary scale    Good welfare benefits Read more about SLU Aqua: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/aquatic-resources/ Read more about staff benefits and life as an SLU employee: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/ Read more about PhD courses and PhD study programmes: https://www.slu.se/en/study/programmes-courses/doctoral-education/ Form of employment and salary Employment as a doctoral student (4-year programme)Doctoral student’s salaries are set following the local collective agreement. Salary progression is fixed. Scope100% LocationDrottningholm, Stockholm Start date2027-04-01, or upon agreement. Application and selection Please submit your application using the link below. The deadline is 30 November 2027. Read more about the attachments that your application should include at https://www.slu.se/en/study/programmes-courses/doctoral-education/how-can-i-become-a-doctoral-student/application/ Selection among eligible applicants is based on the documents attached to the application, and is carried out with regard to the applicant’s ability to complete the programme within the allotted time. Academic union representativeshttps://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/ Note: This is a shortened version of the advertisement adapted to the Swedish Public Employment Service’s (Platsbanken) system. Please see the full advertisement on SLU’s website: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/jobs-and-vacancies/ The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. Über Jurata

Jurata entwickelt den Jurata Legal Agent (www.jurata.ai), die juristische KI der nächsten Generation. Der Legal Agent übernimmt Recherche, Drafting und die Überarbeitung von Dokumenten und belegt seine Antworten mit Millionen verifizierter Erlasse, Gerichtsentscheide und weiterer relevanter Quellen. Entwickelt in der Schweiz, von Juristen für Juristen.

Der Legal Agent ist täglich bei tausenden Legal Professionals im Einsatz, von führenden Kanzleien über Rechtsabteilungen renommierter Unternehmen bis hin zu Schaden- und Rechtsteams grosser Versicherungen wie der Mobiliar und Protekta. Weil die Nachfrage nach der Lösung stark wächst, bauen wir nun unser Sales- und Business-Development-Team gezielt aus. Dafür suchen wir dich.

Deine Rolle

KI verändert gerade fundamental, wie Juristinnen und Juristen arbeiten, und in dieser Rolle bist du mittendrin. Als Werkstudentin oder Werkstudent in unserem Sales- und Business-Development-Team in Zürich bringst du den Jurata Legal Agent zu Anwältinnen, Kanzleipartnern, General Counsels und AI Leads in Unternehmen. Du sprichst mit ihnen auf Augenhöhe, zeigst in Demos, was KI in ihrem Arbeitsalltag konkret verändern kann, und begleitest sie vom ersten Gespräch über den Vertragsabschluss bis zum erfolgreichen Onboarding.

Du startest nicht bei null: Du erhältst ein bewährtes Setup mit Playbooks, qualifizierten Kundenanfragen und Coaching durch das Team. Gleichzeitig trägst du früh Verantwortung für eigene Ergebnisse und siehst direkt, was du zum Wachstum von Jurata beiträgst.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du kontaktierst Kanzleien, Rechtsabteilungen und weitere juristische Organisationen per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn und vereinbarst Termine.

  • Du bearbeitest eingehende, qualifizierte Kundenanfragen und findest heraus, wo der Legal Agent konkreten Mehrwert schafft.

  • Du zeigst live, was der Legal Agent kann, und überzeugst juristische Fachpersonen in Produktdemos mit deiner juristischen Kompetenz und echten Fällen aus der Praxis.

  • Du begleitest Neukundinnen und Neukunden beim Onboarding, damit der Legal Agent schnell Teil ihres Alltags wird.

  • Du bist an Events, Fachanlässen und Hochschulen das Gesicht von Jurata.

  • Du pflegst deine Sales-Pipeline und unser CRM (HubSpot) sauber und zuverlässig.

  • Du bringst Kundenfeedback und Einwände strukturiert ins Team ein und gestaltest so Produkt und Playbook direkt mit.

Was du mitbringst

Sales-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind deine Persönlichkeit, Tech-Affinität, Lernbereitschaft und dein juristisches Verständnis.

  • Du studierst Rechtswissenschaften (Bachelor oder Master) und kannst dich mit einem Pensum von 40–80 % engagieren.

  • Du arbeitest gerne mit Menschen und hast Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt.

  • Es reizt dich, juristische Fachpersonen von technologischer Innovation zu überzeugen.

  • Du interessierst dich für Legal Tech, KI und Sales und greifst ohne Scheu zum Telefon.

  • Ein Nein bringt dich nicht aus der Ruhe: Du bleibst dran und lernst daraus.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und sorgfältig.

  • Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch und kannst dich auf Englisch verständigen. Französisch oder Italienisch sind ein Plus.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Legal AI an vorderster Front: Du arbeitest in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Legal-Tech-Start-ups der Schweiz, mit einem Produkt, das bereits täglich in der Praxis im Einsatz ist.

  • Netzwerk in der Rechtsbranche: Du lernst Kanzleipartner, General Counsels und Rechtsabteilungen kennen, lange vor deinem Berufseinstieg.

  • Bewährtes Setup: Playbooks, qualifizierte Anfragen und regelmässiges Coaching machen dich schnell selbstständig.

  • Fixum plus Provision ohne Obergrenze: Du erhältst ein Fixum und dazu eine Erfolgsprovision, die nach oben nicht begrenzt ist. Die angegebene Vergütungsspanne umfasst Fixum und Erfolgsprovision.

  • Flexibles Pensum: Innerhalb von 40–80 % richtet sich dein Pensum nach Vorlesungen und Prüfungen, nicht umgekehrt.

  • Praxiserfahrung, die zählt: Du erlebst aus erster Hand, wie KI die juristische Arbeit verändert, und baust Sales-Skills auf, die dir in jeder Karriere Vorteile bringen werden.

  • 25 Ferientage: Du hast 25 Ferientage pro Jahr, bei Teilzeit anteilig.

  • Remote-Woche: Du arbeitest bei uns im Büro in Zürich. Nach der Probezeit hast du Anrecht auf eine Woche Remote Work pro Jahr.

  • Fitness-Abo: Du erhältst ein kostenloses Abo für das Fitnessstudio direkt neben unserem Büro.

  • Firmenlaptop: Du erhältst von uns einen Firmenlaptop.

  • Teamkultur: Wir pflegen eine echte Start-up-Kultur, haben einen legendären Teamgeist und unterstützen uns jederzeit gegenseitig. Es gibt kostenlose Snacks und Getränke, regelmässige Teamevents, (freiwillige) gemeinsame Workouts und eine lockere Kleiderordnung.

So bewirbst du dich

Bewirb dich direkt über JOIN mit deinem Lebenslauf, deinen universitären Leistungsausweisen, weiteren (Arbeits-)Zeugnissen und ein paar Sätzen zu deiner Motivation, die du direkt im Bewerbungsformular eingeben kannst. Ein zusätzliches Bewerbungsschreiben ist nicht erforderlich. Wir melden uns bei Interesse innert weniger Tage für ein unkompliziertes Kennenlernen.

Passt es zeitlich gerade nicht, aber du kennst jemanden, der in Frage kommt? Empfiehl uns die Person per E-Mail an ----- Bei einer erfolgreichen Anstellung schenken wir dir als Dankeschön ein Studenten-Jahresabo für den Jurata Legal Agent.

Volvo Group shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm."Job description:Location: Skövde / Mariestad/ Göteborg     About the OpportunityWe are looking for an experienced Equipment / Manufacturing Engineer to support the development, industrialization, and ramp-up of advanced battery manufacturing operations. What We Offer      Opportunity to contribute to the development of next-generation battery manufacturing facilities.     Involvement in large-scale industrialization and production ramp-up projects.     Exposure to cutting-edge manufacturing technologies and equipment.     Collaborative and innovative working environment.     Professional growth and career development opportunities.     The chance to help build world-class manufacturing operations that support a sustainable future.    Join us and help establish the manufacturing equipment and production capabilities that will power the next generation of battery technology.   PracticalSend your application by 2026-11-16.      We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities. Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

jobs.title: Manager, Commercial Outcome Architects (Customer Success)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are looking for a proven Outcomes Architects Manager with a strategic and entrepreneurial spirit to join the GTM Team. As the Commercial OA Leader, you will play an important role defining/iterating on our expand motions, providing customer feedback to help share our roadmap, driving increased adoption, owning ongoing value delivery, and and generating expansion revenue to grow our business. You will own the strategy and execution of your team’s segment.

The Outcomes Architect team is a new function at Notion that combines RM, CSM and SE capabilities to drive workflow adoption and retention at our customers.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Increase Team Performance on Adoption, Retention, and Customer Value: Your role centers on up-leveling the team to boost product adoption, retention, customer value, and satisfaction through effective retention strategies and churn prevention in the Commercial segment (note that your team will own a subset of renewals).

 - Team Leadership and Development: As a leader, you'll recruit, train, and mentor a high-performing Outcomes Architect team that embodies our core values and operational goals.

 - Data-Driven Insights and Operational Excellence: You will build and refine a consistent KPI/OKR system that enables data-driven decisions to identify risks, trends, and opportunities.

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration and Partnerships: You will partner with solutions consulting and forward deployed engineers to ensure smooth customer onboarding and continuously refine the customer journey to drive long-term success. You will also bridge the gap between customers and internal teams by channeling feedback into product development, ensuring continuous improvement of the platform.

 - AI Workflow Adoption: You and your team will drive new workflows and build beside customers to implement them.

 - Customer Leadership: You will serve as the key extension of your team for high-stakes customer engagements (both internally and externally), such as business reviews.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of people management experience for a CS, sales, SE or account management team

 - Experience with large and strategic customers (experience with Fortune 500)

 - Experience working with technical stakeholders

 - Experience driving AI adoption

 - Can convey complex information to executives clearly and concisely and resolve tradeoffs

 - Effective communicator across levels and audiences

 - Strong leadership skills with a focus on empowerment, positive-mindsets, collaboration and ability to inspire a team of direct reports

 - High ownership mentality

 - Comfortable with the ambiguity and pace of iteration of an early-stage startup

 - Growth mindset and thrive in the building stage of a nascent team

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - You have experience using Notion

 - You've built new CS playbooks or processes

 - Experience using Gainsight

 - Experienced in hiring and training talent at scale

 

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $225,000 - $275,000 per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.

 

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. jobs.title: Thuisverpleegkundige regio Brugge (meer specifieke regio nog bespreekbaar)

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Taurus

Do you want to be part of a new entrepreneurial adventure and help build the next global FinTech? Then we might just have the job for you.

Taurus is a FINMA-regulated securities firm, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, and a leading European provider of digital asset infrastructure solutions for banks, broker-dealers, corporates, and private companies. Using blockchain technology, our platform covers cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities and assets, digital currencies, and stablecoins. We are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to support our fast global growth.

Tasks

The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager to join our Project & Organization team. You will play a central role in managing high-impact projects — from the implementation of our platform within financial institutions to strategic cross-functional initiatives. Working closely with both clients and internal teams, you will help deliver a seamless, high-quality experience while contributing directly to Taurus's continued growth.

This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and digital assets — ideal for someone eager to grow in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are looking for a resourceful, forward-thinking, and hands-on professional capable of driving strategic planning, operational execution, and client delivery in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Main Responsibilities

  • Client-Facing Project Management: Lead end-to-end delivery projects for our clients (financial institutions, issuers, or LP/market makers). This includes designing operating models and workflows, setting up custody and tokenization platforms, and managing technical implementations in close collaboration with client teams and Taurus' Engineering and Security departments.

  • Internal Strategy & Operations: Deliver cross-functional projects sponsored by the Executive Committee, working across Product, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Sales. Typical assignments involve regulatory filings, business requirement specifications, operational improvements, and international expansion

  • Blockchain Forensics & Due Diligence: Produce high-quality source-of-funds analyses, wallet screening, and crypto due diligence reports using blockchain intelligence tools to support compliance reviews, onboarding, and investigations.

  • Commercial & Operational Support: Contribute to sales RFPs/RFIs, support ad-hoc commercial or operational priorities across the company.

Requirements

Your Profile

  • Master's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm or in project management within a financial services or fintech environment.

  • Solid understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and the broader digital asset ecosystem (custody, trading, tokenization, staking, derivatives, etc.).

  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver with a high level of attention to detail.

  • Precise, organized, autonomous, open-minded, hands-on, and results-oriented — a true self-starter and fast learner.

  • Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus.

  • Willingness to travel to client locations as required

Benefits

What We Offer

  • An opportunity to work at the intersection of digital assets and traditional finance, with direct exposure to leading financial institutions.

  • A skilled and experienced team, including world-renowned experts in digital assets and blockchain.

  • A fast-paced, entrepreneurial learning environment with strong team spirit.

  • A great moment to join as Taurus grows and expands globally

As the company evolves in a dynamic and innovative environment, its DNA is based on merit. There will be growth opportunities for candidates with an open mindset and a strong delivery track record. We are an equal opportunity employer.

Note

We will only consider direct applications and won't consider applications submitted via recruitment agencies.
