jobs.title: Nordic Certification Coordinator
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at koordinere certificeringsaktiviteter på tværs af Norden og sikre en professionel og effektiv service til vores kunder?

Control Union Denmark A/S søger en struktureret og serviceminded Nordic Certification Coordinator, som får en central rolle i koordineringen af vores certificeringsaktiviteter. Du bliver en del af en international virksomhed og får en alsidig hverdag med kontakt til kunder, auditorer og kolleger i både Danmark og de øvrige nordiske lande.Som Nordic Certification Coordinator bliver du et vigtigt bindeled mellem kunder, auditorer og vores interne organisation. Du får ansvar for at koordinere certificeringsforløb og sikre, at opgaver, dokumentation og deadlines bliver håndteret korrekt og effektivt.Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Koordinering og planlægning af audits og certificeringsaktiviteter

  • Daglig kontakt med kunder, auditorer og kolleger i Norden

  • Opfølgning på igangværende certificeringsforløb og deadlines

  • Behandling, kontrol og arkivering af dokumentation

  • Vedligeholdelse af kunde- og certificeringsoplysninger i relevante systemer

  • Udarbejdelse og udsendelse af tilbud, aftaler og certifikater

  • Koordinering med internationale kolleger og øvrige Control Union-kontorer

  • Besvarelse af kundehenvendelser og administrativ support

  • Deltagelse i kundebesøg, messer, træning og relevante arrangementer

  • Bidrag til løbende forbedring af interne arbejdsgange og processer

Opgaverne kan udvikle sig i takt med virksomhedens aktiviteter og dine kompetencer.Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med koordinering, administration, kundeservice eller certificering

  • Arbejder struktureret og har et godt overblik

  • Er detaljeorienteret og følger opgaver helt til dørs

  • Kommunikerer professionelt og imødekommende med både kunder og kolleger

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig indgå aktivt i et internationalt team

  • Har gode IT-kundskaber og let ved at sætte dig ind i nye systemer

  • Behersker engelsk på et godt professionelt niveau, både mundtligt og skriftligt

  • Har mulighed for at deltage i kundebesøg, messer, audits og andre aktiviteter, hvor der kan forekomme rejseaktivitet

Erfaring fra certificerings-, audit-, kvalitets- eller fødevareområdet er et krav.Vi tilbyder:

  • En alsidig stilling med stor kontaktflade i en international organisation

  • Mulighed for at arbejde fra vores kontor i Randers samt fra hjemmekontor efter aftale

  • En fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen

  • Fleksibilitet i tilrettelæggelsen af arbejdsdagen

  • Pensionsordning med sundhedsforsikring

  • Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • Et samarbejdsorienteret arbejdsmiljø med korte beslutningsveje og mulighed for selvstændigt ansvar

Der kan i perioder forekomme arbejde uden for almindelig arbejdstid i forbindelse med blandt andet rejser, messer, træning og uddannelse.Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til rm@controlunion.dk senest 30.11.2026.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og forbeholder os retten til at afslutte rekrutteringsprocessen, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Tiltrædelse: Efter aftaleArbejdssted: Randers,og mulighed for hjemmearbejdeAnsættelsesform: Fuldtid, 37 timer om ugen

jobs.title: Ervaren mechanieker in de haven van Antwerpen
jobs.description:
Wij zoeken een ervaren mechanieker die niet bang is om de handen uit de mouwen te steken en deel wil uitmaken van een hecht, stabiel onderhoudsteam.

Samen met je collega’s en onder leiding van een ervaren brigadier zorg jij dat de installaties blijven draaien. Jouw dag is nooit hetzelfde:

  • Je voert zelfstandig of in teamverband complexe herstellingen en revisies uit.
  • Je lost mechanische defecten en blokkades op met oog voor detail.
  • Je werkt nauw samen met je team: jullie rekenen op elkaar en tillen het onderhoud naar een hoger niveau.

Je bent een technisch expert met een passie voor mechanica en een hart voor de haven.Je combineert expertise met een positieve instelling.

  • Technisch onderlegd: Je hebt ervaring met bout- en flensverbindingen, pakkingen en (safety)valves.
  • Roterende machines: Je hebt kennis van aandrijvingen, lagers, mechanische verbindingen en kan basis-uitlijningen uitvoeren met een rotaline.
  • Veelzijdig: Je beheerst de basis van metaalbewerking (boren, zagen, slijpen). Heb je laservaring? Dan is dat een mooie streep voor!
  • Veilig & Handig: Je weet hoe je lasten moet aanslaan en manipuleren. Heb je nog geen certificaat voor de heftruck, rolbrug, flensmonteur, hoogwerker of ademlucht? Geen probleem, dat kun je bij ons behalen.
  • Mentaliteit: Je kiest voor kwaliteit boven kwantiteit, spreekt vlot Nederlands en bent een echte teamplayer die ook onder druk nauwkeurig blijft werken.

jobs.title: hulpverlener Team Perspectief
jobs.description:
Je start je dag met een goedemorgen, een kopje verse koffie of thee en een babbel met de collega’s. Je leest je mails na en beantwoordt alvast de meest urgente vragen.  Je agenda toont een gevulde dag! Fijn, daar hou je van!  Je bent helemaal klaar voor een intakegesprek in de voormiddag. Je gaat naar de ACM Jongerenwerking waar je hebt afgesproken met een kandidaat-bewoner voor de opvang. In het gesprek pols je naar hun motivatie om na te denken over haalbare toekomstperspectieven. Je bevraagt ook hoe die samenwonen in een huis met 14 andere bewoners ziet en noteert voor jezelf kort je bevindingen en observaties.  Na deze intake ga je naar de opvang zelf. Daar heb je gesprekken gepland staan met twee bewoners. Met de eerste praat je over de stappen die gezet moeten worden: er staat een afspraak met de ICAM-coach op de planning en jullie moeten naar de ambassade om te proberen papieren in orde te brengen. Je spreekt hen ook nog aan over de schulden die die heeft en jullie maken een voorstel tot afbetalingsplan.  Het tweede gesprek gaat over het psychisch welzijn van de bewoner en hun gedrag in het huis. Je zoekt een mooi evenwicht tussen luisteren naar hun noden en toch stellen van minimumverwachtingen en grenzen. Het samenleven verloopt namelijk niet zo goed op dit moment. Jullie maken heldere afspraken over hygiëne en lawaai.  Na de gesprekken werk je je cliëntregistratie verder bij en breng je je teamcoördinator op de hoogte van het gesprek met de bewoner.  En dan tijd om even uit te blazen : lunch !  Na de lunch staat de bewonersvergadering op de planning. Je overloopt nog met je collega’s wie welke thema’s zal brengen en wat jullie plan van aanpak is. De vergadering loopt vlot.  Nadien heb je met de collega’s Perspectiefbegeleiding nog een casusbespreking. Je bespreekt kort die ene casus waar je even op vast loopt en kan met de input van je collega weer verder.  Je ziet 3 voicemailberichten en wat smsjes op je smartphone. Je maakt nog even de tijd om deze te behandelen en om je mailbox te checken. Nadien neem je opnieuw nog even de tijd om je cliëntregistratie dossiers aan te vullen.  Later deze middag maak je nog een poster voor de activiteit die je wil doen met de bewoners. Je hangt de poster op in de leefruimte, zodat geïnteresseerden weten wanneer de activiteit zal doorgaan.  Je hebt niet alles afgekregen maar je weet ondertussen dat dit hoort bij deze job. Er ligt morgen nog wat werk op je te wachten!
 	 - 	 Je bent goed in krachtgericht werken en je hebt een coachende, cultuursensitieve begeleidingsstijl. 		 - 	 Je hebt ervaring met het thema migratie en bent bereid je te verdiepen in verblijfsvragen en perspectiefbegeleiding. 		 - 	 Je bent een echte teamplayer. jobs.title: Technical Writer, Fixed term
jobs.description: **Contract type:** Fixed-term**Location & Travel:** Helsinki (Remote first, Occasional travel to the Helsinki area is required.)**Career Opportunity:** This fixed-term position may lead to a permanent offer in customer support, quality assurance, or project deliveries based on performance, aspirations, and business needs.AILiveSim provides an advanced simulation platform that integrates AI, robotics, and video game technology. Located in Helsinki, we serve a variety of industries, including maritime, defence, aeronautics, and mobile machines. With controlled simulations, we accelerate the development cycles and provide scalable solutions for training, testing, and validating autonomous systems and AI algorithms.To support our growing user base and ensure our platform is as accessible as possible, we are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Technical Writer. In this role, you will be responsible for translating complex technical concepts into clear and easy-to-understand documentation. This is an opportunity to work closely with cutting-edge AI, robotics, and simulation technology while shaping how our clients and developers interact with our platform.**Key Responsibilities**- **Documentation Creation:** Write, edit, and maintain high-quality product, technical documentation, including user manuals, tutorials, and both customer- and AI-facing documentation resources. - **Knowledge Delivery Processes:** Define and develop various ways to convey information, documentation, example scripts, tutorials and configuration files manually or with AI code assistants. - **Content Organization:** Structure and organize technical content to ensure it is highly searchable, intuitive, and user-friendly for both internal teams and external clients. - **Cross-Team Collaboration:** Work closely with software engineers, product specialists, and the sales team to deeply understand new platform features, updates, and user needs. - **Standardization & Review:** Establish documentation standards and review existing technical materials for clarity, accuracy, and consistency across all company channels. - **User-Centric & Adaptive Approach:** Gather feedback from users and internal teams to continuously improve the usability and comprehensiveness of our documentation, evolving content based on user profiles and technical requirements. **Requirements**- **Technical Writing Experience:** Track record in writing software or technical documentation. - **Communication Skills:** Excellent written and spoken English skills, with a talent for breaking down complex, highly technical concepts into simple, readable language. - **Technical Abilities:** Comfort and enthusiasm for learning complex software systems, with the ability to quickly grasp concepts related to 3D simulation tools, robotics, and AI. **Valuable Assets**- Experience reading or working with programming languages (such as C++ or Python) and documenting APIs. - Interest or background in AI, robotics, 3D graphics, game technologies (e.g., Unreal Engine), or autonomous systems. - Experience creating visual aids, diagrams to supplement written documentation. - Experience creating AI readable documentation, such as instruction files, schemas, Model Context Protocols **How to Apply** To apply, please send your CV, cover letter, and a link to your portfolio or writing samples with "Technical Writer" in the subject line to Jobs@ailivesim.com.Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position will be filled as soon as a qualified candidate is identified.

jobs.title: Assistant Archivist
jobs.description: Role ProfileThe successful candidate will report to the Librarian & Archivist, to process and catalogue incoming collections of archives and promote the content of the Library’s extensive holdings. The candidate will be part of the Library team and contribute to its ongoing work and outreach.BackgroundThe Library of the Representative Church Body provides a repository for the Church of Ireland’s archives, manuscripts and related objects which tell the story of the Church’s community. These include records from parishes throughout Ireland, the archives of the Church’s dioceses, cathedrals, architectural drawings, the administrative records of the Representative Church Body and its multiple committees, and thousands of manuscripts relating to the Church’s people, buildings and activities, spanning from medieval times to the present. Some have relevance for a worldwide research audience, and public engagement with that audience is an important Library function.Specific Responsibilities•    Assisting in the processing and cataloguing of incoming collections;•    Updating and uploading finding aids to the Library’s web pages;•    Contributing to the Library’s ongoing digitization projects including managing projects on a book scanner and digital slide scanner;•    Assisting visitors and answering public enquires;•    Initiating and managing exhibition projects and contributing to raising the profile of the Library and its varied collections;•    Oher projects and tasks as may be assigned by the Librarian and Archivist.Person SpecificationEducation / Training    Essential•    A primary degree in history or other relevant discipline•    A recognised postgraduate qualification in archive or library studies Desirable•    Professional member of the ARA (Archives and Records Management Association)Experience    Essential•    A minimum of three years’ experience working in an archive, including at least one year’s experience in a religious archive.•    Experience digitising archival materials across multiple formats (including paper records, photographic material, and slides)•    Proven experience of completing archival projects in a systematic and timely fashion•    Experience of collaboration, teamwork and building relationshipsDesirable•    Knowledge of latest digitisation systems (eg. Book2Net Lizard, Tocosa, Silverfast9). Knowledge / Skills    Essential•    Excellent communication skills including making presentations and engaging with relevant stakeholders•    Experience curating small displays for exhibition•    Proficient in Microsoft Access (including database management and reporting)•    Experience in developing and managing websites and organisational social media accounts, including updating content and maintaining an online presence.•    Excellent organisational and inter-personal skills with proven ability to work to deadlines and prioritise workloadsDesirable•    Experience researching and writing content for publications including online and print content

jobs.title: Videnskabelig assistent til kvantitativ dataindsamling og statistisk analyse i uddannelsesvidenskab
jobs.description:
Ved Det humanistiske Fakultet, Syddansk Universitet i Odense er en fuldtidsstilling som videnskabelig assistent inden for uddannelsesvidenskab med særligt fokus på kvantitativ dataindsamling og statistisk analyse ledig til besættelse 1. januar 2027 og ét år frem.

Den videnskabelige assistent vil skulle arbejde på forskellige større og mindre forskningsprojekter, alle ledet af professor Ane Qvortrup. Fælles for projekterne er, at de undersøger danske og europæiske gymnasie- og erhvervsuddannelseselevers trivsel, selvforståelser og undervisningsoplevelser. Yderligere projekter kan komme til. 

De primære arbejdsopgaver vil bestå i kvantitativ dataindsamling og statistisk analysearbejde samt deltagelse i øvrige forskningsopgaver i relation til projekterne. Der søges en medarbejder, der har stærke kompetencer inden for kvantitative metoder, herunder i særdeleshed surveymetodik, og som har erfaring med uddannelsesvidenskabelig forskning. Ligeledes forventes gode kompetencer inden for mundtlig og skriftlig kommunikation.

jobs.title: Night Receptionist for winter season 2026-2027
jobs.description: Kakslauttanen Arctic Resort is one of Finland's best-known and most talked about travel destinations. This family business, founded in 1974, is in Saariselkä, Lapland. Kakslauttanen hosts around 30,000 visitors each year, many of them from abroad. We are looking for skilled, experienced, and service-oriented night receptionist for the winter season 2026-2027. A Night Receptionist is responsible for assisting our guests and making sure they feel safe and well taken care of during the night. The work mainly involves helping guests with different requests, both by phone, messages and in person around the resort.Guest requests can be anything from bringing an extra blanket or helping with sauna instructions to opening a door if a guest has locked themselves out. You need to be ready to handle different situations and find solutions independently. The work requires a responsible, flexible and solution-oriented attitude, as you will be working independently during night shifts.The contract is seasonal, starting as soon as possible and ending at the end of March 2027. We provide full-time hours. The work schedule consists of 5 night shifts followed by 2 days off.The role will involve: * Assisting guests with their requests by phone, messages and in person * Helping guests with practical issues around the resort * Handling unexpected situations and finding solutions * Making sure guests feel safe and well taken care of during the night * Supporting other resort operations when neededDesired qualifications, skills, and experience: * Fluent in written and spoken English. Other languages are an advantage. * Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience * Previous experience in hotel reception work and night shifts is required * A valid driving license is required * Good experience and confidence in winter driving * Ability to work independently and make decisions * A responsible, proactive and solution-oriented attitude * Excellent customer service skillsWe have two receptions serving our guests during the winter season, in East Village and West Village. The Night Receptionist will work at our West Village reception, and the night receptionist takes care of our guests staying in both villages.The location of the resort is in the middle of beautiful nature. Here you also have time to enjoy nature and try different activities that you might not get to experience otherwise. We have a small gym for our staff, as well as opportunities to try cross-country skiing and other winter activities.You need to have a valid right to work in Finland, either through an EU/EEA citizenship or a valid residence permit that allows working in Finland. It is possible to rent an apartment through us, so joining our team is easy wherever you are coming from.In terms of employment, we follow the collective agreement of the tourism and restaurant industry (MaRa TES). The salary is based on the collective agreement and depends on your previous work experience and education.We review applications already during the application period, so we may contact suitable candidates before the application deadline.You can also read [https://kakslauttanen.teamtailor.com/posts]our blog to see how it's like to work at Kakslauttanen.

Arvomme yhteistyö, luottamus, kehitys ja vastuullisuus ovat työmme perusta.**Tarjoamme sinulle**- mahdollisuuden seurata uusimpien viestintäteknologioiden kehitystä läheltä ja vaikuttaa siihen, miten niitä hyödynnetään Suomessa kriittisessä viestinnässä - asiantuntevan työyhteisön, mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi sekä tehtävän, jossa teknologisilla valinnoilla on konkreettinen merkitys - työpaikan, jossa satsataan työntekijöiden hyvinvointiin; esimerkiksi vuonna 2026 erillisverkkolaiset saavat käyttää viikossa tunnin työaikaa liikuntaan - hybridityömahdollisuuden - hyvät työnteon puitteet ja mutkattoman työilmapiirin - ervenomaiset henkilöstöedut: lounasetu, virike-etu (käytettävissä myös hierontaan ja terveyspalveluihin), laaja työterveyshuolto, matkapuhelinetu ja laaja vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus - mahdollisuuden tulospalkkioon - kilpailukykyisen palkan, joka sijoittuu kokemuksestasi ja osaamistaustastasi riippuen 6000–6700 €/kk välille. jobs.title: OT/IT Engineer, Actiw
jobs.description: We are looking for an OT/IT Engineer to join Actiw and work on OT and IT solutions for international automation system projects.Actiw is one of the leading logistics innovators and solution providers, specialising in industrial storage and automated loading. Actiw Oy is part of the Joloda Hydraroll Ltd. group, and together we form the world's largest company dedicated to loading automation.Our Finnish offices are located in Pieksämäki and Jyväskylä. For over 30 years, we have been solving, optimising and automating material handling processes across various industries in collaboration with major global customers. We are fully committed to making our customers' loading processes easier by providing automated loading equipment, intelligent turnkey solutions and 24/7 services that improve safety and productivity.[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/a0d1f111-a9ab-4350-9b6c-16c352c6a37f/original.jpeg]Would you be our new OT/IT Engineer?As an OT/IT Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and implementing OT and IT solutions for our automation system projects. Your work will combine servers, networks, industrial IT and cybersecurity. You will be involved in different stages of our projects, from design and configuration to testing, documentation, commissioning and support. In practice, you will work with Linux servers, virtual machines, databases and industrial networks, as well as design and configure network solutions, switches, routers and firewalls.An important part of your role will be ensuring the cybersecurity of the systems we deliver. Your responsibilities will include managing access rights, secure remote connections and updates, as well as documenting technical solutions. You will work closely with our software, electrical and automation engineers and project teams, as well as our customers' IT, OT and cybersecurity specialists, turning their requirements into practical technical solutions. You will also support our sales team in reviewing customer OT/IT requirements during the RFQ phase and defining suitable technical solutions.In addition to customer projects, you will develop and maintain standardized and reusable OT/IT solutions, such as server and VM templates, reference network architectures and security configurations. You will also help ensure that our solutions comply with relevant OT/IT standards and regulations. As this is a new role at Actiw, you will also have the opportunity to shape the position and contribute to the development of our OT/IT expertise.This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Actiw. Your primary workplace will be in Jyväskylä or Pieksämäki, with a hybrid working model that allows you to work remotely a few days a week. The role may also include occasional travel within Finland and abroad.What are we looking for?You have a relevant educational background, for example in information technology, automation or electrical engineering. You have already gained relevant practical work experience in technical environments and are familiar with industrial IT and automation.We expect you to have experience with Linux server environments and a good understanding of computer networks and networking principles. Experience with virtualization, databases, network devices, firewalls and secure network solutions is also valued. A good understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals will help you succeed in the role. Knowledge of machine safety, industrial cybersecurity standards and relevant regulations is considered an advantage. You do not need to be an expert in every area from day one, but we expect you to have a solid technical foundation and a willingness to continuously develop your expertise.In addition to your technical skills, we value a systematic and solution-oriented approach and the ability to understand the bigger picture. You are able to turn customer requirements into practical technical solutions and clear documentation, and you enjoy working with experts from different fields as well as customers and partners.Why us?We offer you a responsible and interesting role where you will work on a variety of projects with well-known international customers. You will have the freedom to take ownership of your work while having the support of skilled colleagues around you. The role also offers excellent opportunities to develop professionally and broaden your expertise.Your work will have a tangible impact on the security, availability and quality of our systems. As this is a new position, you will have a genuine opportunity to shape your role and influence how our OT/IT solutions and operating practices are developed going forward.Our work community has a strong team spirit and a good sense of humour. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We want to provide our employees with the best possible working environment, including hybrid work and flexible working hours. You will also receive an annual sports benefit, occupational healthcare services and leisure-time insurance.Learn more about us: Actiw [https://www.joloda.com/en/about-us/actiw/]Are you interested?If you are interested, we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Please submit your application in either English or Finnish via the link below by 22 November 2026. The interview process will begin during the application period, and the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information on the position, please contact Nea Repo, Recruitment Consultant, e-mail: nea.repo@biisoni.fi [nea.repo@biisoni.fi].Please note that we only process applications submitted through our recruitment system. We are unable to accept applications sent by email.

jobs.title: Den selvejende institution Stefanshjemmet søger pr. 1/1 2027 en ergoterapeut til afdelingen Havglimt 2.  Arbejdstiden er 37 timer pr. uge.
jobs.description:
Den selvejende institution Stefanshjemmet søger pr. 1/1 2027 en ergoterapeut til afdelingen Havglimt 2. Arbejdstiden er 37 timer pr. uge.

Som ansat på Stefanshjemmet er det vigtigt for os, at du er fagligt stolt, engageret og har hjertet på rette sted og et menneskesyn der stemmer overens med Stefanshjemmets værdier. Dagligdagen byder på mange spændende faglige udfordringer og etiske dilemmaer. Havglimt 2. har en stabil medarbejdergruppe. Du får gode og dygtige kollegaer der hjælper hinanden, her er et godt arbejdsmiljø og højt humør mellem medarbejdere og beboere.

Stefanshjemmet er et bo- og beskæftigelsestilbud til mennesker med erhvervet hjerneskade og/eller svære fysiske handicap.

På afdelingen Havglimt 2. er der 10 beboere med erhvervet hjerneskade, men med forskellige udfordringer af fysisk, kognitiv og/eller kommunikativ karakter. Medarbejderne har en baggrund som fysioterapeut, SOSU-assistent, SOSU-hjælper, pædagog eller omsorgsmedarbejder og varetager pleje, omsorg, bostøtte og aktivitet for beboerne efter serviceloven.

På Stefanshjemmet værner vi om det tværfaglige miljø og har omkring 130 ansatte.

Arbejdet på afdelingerne tager udgangspunkt i beboernes behov og muligheder og vi samles af vores neuropædagogiske tilgang, en ressourceorienteret tilgang med KRAP som ramme. samt værdier og etik.

Alle medarbejdere indgår i arbejdet med plejeopgaver, bostøtte og aktiviteter for beboerne, og byder ind i de fælles opgaver med hver deres faglighed. Vi søger en dedikeret ergoterapeut, der har lyst til at indgå i såvel aktiviteterne som plejen og omsorgen for beboerne og i tilrettelæggelsen af denne.

Vi ønsker i afdelingen at gøre brug af ergoterapeutens viden om kroppens funktion, om udviklende og motivationsskabende aktiviteter i samværet med beboerne, såvel som viden om hjælpemidler og forflytninger.

Vi søger en ergoterapeut, der:

·        Er fagligt velfunderet og brænder for sit fag

·        Har blik for at anvende sin faglighed ind i en hverdag for beboerne, hvor ord som hverdagsrehabilitering, motivation og meningsfuld aktivitet vinder genklang

·        Har viden om eller vil sætte sig ind i anvendelse af hjælpemidler og forflytninger og evt. på sigt vil indtage rollen som forflytningsvejleder i afdelingen og i huset i samarbejde med andre terapeuter

·        Kan arbejde med beboernes mål i tæt samarbejde med øvrige fagpersoner

·        ser værdien i dokumentation og deling af viden i en tværfaglig kontekst

·        Evner at tage sig tid til nærvær med beboerne og påskønner livshistorierne

·        Er engageret og god til at se muligheder

·        Er udadvendt, opsøgende og initiativrig

Hvis du bliver ansat hos os, vil der blive udarbejdet et introduktionsprogram for dig som en del af din oplæring i huset.

Arbejdstiden er skiftende dag- og aftenvagter med arbejde hver 3 weekend.

På Stefanshjemmet er der desuden en boligforening med 44 boliger og et aktivitets- og samværstilbud.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til principperne om ny løn efter overenskomst med Ergoterapeutforeningen.

Stefanshjemmet har driftsoverenskomst med Aarhus Kommune. 

Ved yderligere spørgsmål kan du kontakte afdelingsleder Tina Rudebeck Holm, tlf. 4185 7871

Du kan indhente mere viden om Stefanshjemmet på vores hjemmeside: www.stefanshjemmet.dk

Ansøgningsfristen er den 17. november 2026 kl. 8.00

Ansøgningen skal sendes pr. mail til stefanshjemmet@aarhus.dk mærket ergoterapeut på HG2

jobs.title: Directeur(trice) d'association d'accueil de groupes (H/F)
jobs.description: Suite au départ de son directeur le 30 septembre 2026, l'Association de Gestion du Centre d'Accueil Polyvalent (CAP) de Saint-Front (43) recrute en CDI à temps plein : un(e) directeur(trice) avec une prise de poste prévue le 1er février 2027.Son projet associatif s'appuie sur les valeurs de l'éducation populaire, de l'économie sociale et solidaire et du développement durable, avec un fort ancrage territorial. La gouvernance est assurée par un conseil d'administration composé de représentants associatifs (CEMEA Auvergne, Ligue de l'enseignement 43) et de la municipalité de Saint-Front.Le centre a récemment obtenu l'Écolabel, témoignant de son engagement dans la transition écologique.Description de la structure : www.cap-st-front.frMissions principales :Dans un contexte où l'Économie Sociale et Solidaire est sous tension, notamment pour les associations du secteur « Sport, Animation, Loisir et Lien social », la qualité de la gestion financière, la recherche proactive de nouvelles ressources et la vigilance sur les équilibres économiques constituent des priorités majeures du poste. Le(la) directeur(trice) exerce quatre grandes fonctions :1. Gestion financière, matérielle et administrative, et pilotage des équilibres économiques- Élaborer, suivre et analyser rigoureusement le budget annuel, gérer la trésorerie, contrôler les dépenses et recettes- Préparer les clôtures d'exercice en lien avec l'expert-comptable, assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la gouvernance.- Veiller à la maîtrise des coûts, anticiper les risques économiques et proposer des mesures correctives.- Superviser la gestion opérationnelle du site, l'entretien et la conformité des équipements.- Garantir la satisfaction des usagers par une démarche qualité continue.2. Conduite et mise en œuvre du projet d'action et de développement, et recherche proactive de ressources- Travailler en équipe avec les coordinateurs/trices et l'équipe permanente.- Développer les relations stratégiques et mobiliser les réseaux professionnels.- Animer la participation collective et la communication interne.- Rechercher de nouveaux publics, mener des actions de commercialisation et développer des activités génératrices de revenus.- Être pro-actif(ve) dans la recherche de nouvelles ressources (financements publics, privés, mécénat, appels à projets, diversification des activités), en cohérence avec le projet associatif et la nature de la structure d'accueil.3. Animation de l'équipe et gestion des ressources humaines- Manager de façon coopérative une équipe déjà en place (recrutement, formation, accompagnement, organisation du travail, évaluation).- Organiser les délégations et animer des temps collectifs pour donner du sens au travail- Veiller à la qualité de vie au travail, à la prévention des risques et à la gestion de la santé au travail.- Optimiser la gestion des ressources humaines en tenant compte des contraintes économiques.4. Évaluation et évolution du projet associatif- Analyser et partager les données d'activité avec la gouvernance, en intégrant systématiquement les impacts financiers.- Identifier et développer des partenariats locaux, en veillant à leur contribution à l'équilibre économique.- Préparer et suivre les conseils d'administration et assemblées générales.Profil recherché :Un expérience confirmée dans le tourisme social, les séjours collectifs de mineurs et la gestion d'équipement ainsi que la maitrise de la gestion financière et le management coopératif sont des compétences et des connaissances particulièrement attendues par l'employeur pour ce poste.Conditions :- Logement de fonction dans l'enceinte du centre (type F6) du fait d'un travail fréquent les week-end, vacances scolaires et les astreintes liées à la fonction.- Une première étape d'entretiens est prévue le 3 décembre 2026 sur place.

jobs.title: Job i Portugal med firmabolig - Kunderådgiver for Audi - Opstart den 3. december - Book en samtale i dag!
jobs.description:
Kundeservicerådgiver for Audi. Vi har opstart den 3. december med mulighed for firmabolig.

Er du klar til at tage springet og blive en del af en global digital organisation, der leverer support i verdensklasse?

Vi søger en kunderådgiver til en spændende rolle med Audi – en af Europas mest ikoniske bilproducenter. Stillingen er 100 % remote fra Portugal, og du bliver en nøglespiller i et internationalt team, der sikrer en ekstraordinær kunderejse for Audi’s brugere.

Hvad laver en Kundeservicerådgiver?

Som kundeservicerådgiver er du kundens direkte kontaktpunkt og hjælper med alt fra bilteknologi til digitale funktioner og serviceydelser. Du skaber en professionel oplevelse med struktur, empati og høj kvalitet i centrum.

Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Besvarelse af henvendelser via telefon, e-mail og chat

  • Fejlsøgning af tekniske problemer og vejledning i bilsystemer

  • Registrering af kundeinteraktioner i CRM-systemet

  • Opdatering på Audi’s produkter og politikker

  • Aktiv deltagelse i teamets deling af best practices

Dine kvalifikationer:

Vi leder efter dig, hvis du:

  • Taler og skriver dansk + har et minimum B2-niveau i engelsk

  • Har erfaring med kundeservice – gerne fra bilbranchen

  • Har teknisk flair og interesse for digitale løsninger

  • Kan kommunikere tydeligt, løse problemer og skabe tillid

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav – vi opfordrer dig stadig til at søge!

Vi tilbyder:

jobs.title: Bli vår nye mekaniker i Ålesund – frihet, faglige utfordringer og et rått team!
jobs.description:
Er du en dyktig mekaniker som brenner for at maskiner skal fungere 100 %, yte maksimalt og se skikkelige ut? Motiveres du av varierte dager, god tillit og friheten til å legge opp din egen hverdag slik at arbeidet flyter best mulig? Da vil du trives hos oss i Cramo.

 

Hos oss blir du ikke bare en som skrur, du får det reelle ansvaret for at utleieparken i Ålesund spiller på lag. Verkstedet og maskinparken blir ditt stolte ansvarsområde, hvor du får styre prosessene, planlegge kapasiteten og ta de faglige avgjørelsene som utgjør en forskjell. Du får en nøkkelrolle med stor handlingsfrihet, samtidig som du blir en del av et uformelt og faglig sterkt team som deler erfaringer og mener at god humor er like viktig som godt håndverk.

 

Hva tilbyr vi deg?

Vi vet at en avdeling kun fungerer bra når folk trives. Derfor legger vi alt til rette for en forutsigbar og god hverdag med lavt stressnivå, selv når det koker litt ekstra.

 

  • Stor tillit og faglig eierskap: Du får styre hverdagen din i stor grad selv og ta avgjørelser som påvirker driften direkte.
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø å sparre med: Du står aldri alene! Teamet i Ålesund, sammen med erfarne mekanikere i resten av regionen, samarbeider tett og deler gladelig av sin erfaring.
  • Gode betingelser: Konkurransedyktig lønn, attraktiv bonusordning og solid pensjons- og forsikringspakke.
  • Balanse og trivsel: Vi har fokus på trivsel og at du har det bra både på og utenfor jobb. Du får støtte til trening og én betalt frivillighetsdag i året.
  • Uformell kultur: En «klart vi kan»-holdning med rom for god humor og høyt under taket.

 

Hva innebærer rollen hos oss?

Som mekaniker hos Cramo i Ålesund tar du styringen over arbeidshverdagen. Du sørger for at maskinene våre er funksjonelle, godt vedlikeholdt og fremstår visuelt flotte for kundene våre.

 

Dine viktigste oppgaver vil være:

  • Helhetlig eierskap til maskinparken: Feilsøking, service, reparasjoner og klargjøring før, under og etter utleie.
  • Styre kapasitet og innkjøp: Du vurderer arbeidsmengden fortløpende. Ved topper, servicer eller årskontroller har du mandat til å koordinere med eksterne leverandører/mekanikere.
  • Prosess- og kostnadskontroll: Du styrer hele reparasjonsløpet fra feilsøking til registrering og kostnadsføring på serviceordre, slik at drift kan fakturere reelle reparasjonskostnader videre.
  • Verksteddrift: Holde orden i delebestillinger, optimalisere verksteddriften og redusere antall maskiner som står «nede».
  • Utrykninger og feltoppdrag: Noen dager jobber du på verkstedet, andre dager drar du ut til kunden og blir helten som løser utfordringene på stedet.

 

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi leter ikke etter en superhelt som kan alt fra dag en, men etter deg som brenner for mekaniker faget, liker å ha oversikt og har god teknisk forstand. Du stolt av jobben du gjør, enten du løser en kompleks feilkode eller sørger for at en maskin ser skinnende ny ut for neste kunde.

 

Det er ideelt om du har:

  • Fagbrev innen anleggs-, landbruks- eller industrimekanikk, elektro (Gr. L) eller et annet relevant mekanisk fag.
  • …men har du lang, praktisk erfaring og en "skru-hjerne" som løser det meste? Søk likevel! Hos oss veier reell kompetanse, faglig engasjement og rett innstilling veldig høyt.
  • Førerkort klasse B (har du BE eller truckførerbevis er det en fin bonus. Har du det ikke, så finner vi ut av det sammen).

  • Grunnleggende digitale ferdigheter og gode norskkunnskaper.

     

Du er en vi passe sammen med dersom du:

  • Motiveres av tillit og frihet under ansvar, og liker å ha kontroll på egne prosjekter og kostnader.
  • Trives med at det koker litt ekstra i ny og ne, men mestrer kunsten å holde hodet kaldt slik at det aldri oppleves som uoversiktlig stress.
  • Er en utpreget lagspiller som bryr seg om kollegene sine, sprer god stemning i kaffepausene og skaper en trygg, inkluderende arbeidsplass.

 

Klar for nye utfordringer?

Send oss en søknad eller ta kontakt for en uforpliktende prat om rollen! Vi gleder oss til å bli kjent med deg.

 

 

 

 

For mer informasjon eller spørsmål, kontakt oss på:

Mail: Richard.taylor@randstad.noMobil: 982 95 163

For å søke:Registrer din CV online på www.randstad.no og søk på denne stillingen.

  • Søknadsfrist - Senest 16.11.26. (Ansettelse kan bli gjort før frist)

Alle søkere vil få svar og blir kontaktet.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Cramo er et av Norges ledende utleieselskaper innen maskiner, utstyr og modulbygg for bygg, anlegg, industri og offentlig sektor. Vi har over 30 avdelinger, mer enn 300 ansatte og er sertifisert innen kvalitet, miljø og arbeidsmiljø (ISO 9001, 14001 og 45001).

Siden 2020 har Cramo vært en del av Boels Rental, en av Europas største og mest fremtidsrettede 

aktører innen utleiebransjen. Dette gir oss et solid apparat i ryggen og gode forutsetninger for videre utvikling.

I vår avdeling jobber vi målrettet for å levere de beste løsningene i markedet, med høy aktivitet, tett samarbeid med både små og store kunder, og et fremoverlent arbeidsmiljø preget av kontinuerlig utvikling og varierte arbeidsoppgaver.

jobs.title: Master Key User SAP FI/CO
jobs.description:
Über die Bell Food Group und die Rolle

Lust auf eine Schlüsselrolle, in der du Finanzprozesse aktiv mitgestaltest und als Bindeglied zwischen Finance, Business und IT agierst? Bei Hügli in Steinach, welche Teil der Bell Food Group ist, wartet eine vielseitige Aufgabe auf dich, in der fundiertes SAP FI/CO-Know-how, ein ausgeprägtes Zahlenverständnis und starke Projektmanagement-Fähigkeiten zusammenkommen. Als Master Key User bist du Dreh- und Angelpunkt, um unsere Finanzprozesse über Ländergrenzen hinweg weiterzuentwickeln und nachhaltig zu harmonisieren.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Prozess-Architektur: Du gestaltest und vereinheitlichst die SAP FI/CO-Module gruppenweit und stellst sicher, dass unsere Systeme optimal auf die Bedürfnisse der Landesgesellschaften abgestimmt sind

  • Standardisierung: Die Entwicklung globaler Richtlinien und Best Practices liegt in deiner Hand, um konzernweit für maximale Transparenz und Effizienz zu sorgen

  • Business Partnering: Als zentraler Ansprechpartner schlägst du die Brücke zwischen Fachbereichen, IT und den lokalen Finanzteams

  • Support & Training: Du befähigst die lokalen Key User durch gezielte Schulungen (DE/EN) und fungierst als kompetenter 1st Level Support bei komplexen Fragestellungen, zusätzlich fungierst du als Schnittstelle zwischen 1st und 2nd Level Support

  • Projektleitung: Spannende SAP FI/CO Roll-outs in Ländern wie Italien, den Niederlanden oder UK sowie der Aufbau moderner Controlling- und Analyse-Tools (z.B. BI, -Profitcenterrechnung etc.) prägen deine Agenda für die kommenden Jahre

  • Konsolidierung: Du begleitest gruppenweite Konsolidierungsprozesse, stellst eine konsistente Datenbasis sicher und unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung der entsprechenden Prozesse und Systemlösungen, beispielsweise in Jedox

Das bringst du mit:

  • SAP FI/CO Expertise: Du verfügst über fundierte und mehrjährige Erfahrung mit SAP FI/CO - idealerweise als Key User, Master Key User oder in einer vergleichbaren fachnahen Funktion. Dein Fokus liegt dabei auf Prozessen und deren Weiterentwicklung; tiefgreifende Programmier- oder Customizing-Kenntnisse setzen wir nicht voraus

  • Zahlen-Affinität: Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für finanzwirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge, Analysen und Kennzahlen. Du musst kein klassischer Controller sein - entscheidend ist, dass du dich sicher in der Welt der Zahlen bewegst und Finance-Prozesse fachlich verstehst

  • Konsolidierung & Reporting: Du kennst dich mit Konsolidierungs-, Planungs- und Reportingprozessen aus und hast idealerweise bereits mit entsprechenden BI- oder Performance-Management-Lösungen wie beispielsweise Jedox gearbeitet

  • Analytischer Scharfsinn: Komplexe Geschäftsprozesse zu durchdringen und in smarte Systemlösungen zu übersetzen, bereitet dir Freude

  • Internationaler Spirit: Da wir global agieren, sind verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse und Freude an der interkulturellen Zusammenarbeit für dich selbstverständlich

  • Macher-Mentalität: Du bringst die nötige Veränderungsbereitschaft mit, um neue Standards nicht nur einzuführen, sondern auch nachhaltig im Unternehmen zu verankern

  • Projekt-Erfahrung: Du verfügst über fundierte Projektmanagement-Erfahrung und bist es gewohnt, komplexe Projekte und unterschiedliche Stakeholder strukturiert zu koordinieren

Das bieten wir:

  • Work-Life-Balance: Bei uns profitierst du von einer 40-Stunden Woche, mind. 25 Urlaubstagen und einem Gleitzeitsystem. Zusätzlich kannst du deine Arbeitstage im Büro und im Mobile Office gestalten

  • Verpflegung: Kulinarik wird bei uns gross geschrieben, frisch zubereitetes Essen in unserem Personalrestaurant macht es für unsere Mitarbeitenden erlebbar

  • Profitiere von bequemer Anbindung an den ÖV, ausreichenden Parkmöglichkeiten sowie der Übernahme deiner Reisespesen für berufliche Fahrten - nachhaltig und sorgenfrei unterwegs

  • Berufliche Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Erweitere dein Wissen durch umfangreiche Weiterbildungsangebote, hochwertige Schulungen im Coop Bildungszentrum und vielfältige persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten wie Mentoring und Coaching

  • Faire Löhne und Sozialleistungen: Sichere deine Zukunft mit unserer überdurchschnittlichen Altersvorsorge, erhalte Jubiläumsprämien und attraktive Prämien für Mitarbeiterempfehlungen. Zudem erhältst du die Personalrabattkarte von Coop und wir übernehmen zwei Drittel deiner Pensionskassenbeiträge

  • Familienfreundlicher Arbeitgeber: Gestalte deine Arbeitszeit flexibel mit Teilzeitmodellen und erlebe ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Vielfalt geschätzt und gefördert wird

jobs.title: Automation Engineer - GMP Pharma & Biotech
jobs.description:
agap2 is a European engineering and operational consulting group founded in 2005 and specialized in the industry. We work in the Pharma, Biotechnology, Medical Devices, Energy, Infrastructure, Transportation, Chemicals, and Information Technology sectors.

As a consultant, you will have to support our clients in the realization of their projects on site by bringing your expertise and your skills.

You are agile and eager to adapt to different work environments that will fuel your curiosity of seeing what’s behind closed doors of the biggest projects of our client’s portfolio.

Tasks

You will work on the design, implementation, qualification and improvement of automation systems in GMP-regulated environments. Depending on your background, your expertise may focus on PLC, SCADA, HMI, DCS, MES or industrial networks.

You will collaborate with engineering, production, quality and validation teams on complex investment and improvement projects.

Your responsibilities

  • Design, develop and implement automation solutions in GMP environments.
  • Contribute to the configuration and programming of PLC, HMI, SCADA, DCS or MES systems.
  • Support FAT, SAT, commissioning, qualification and validation activities.
  • Troubleshoot automation, control and communication issues.
  • Develop and improve automation standards, procedures and technical documentation.
  • Support batch control, recipe management, data integrity and process monitoring activities.
  • Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, suppliers and client stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the delivery of strategic pharmaceutical and biotech projects.

Requirements

  • Degree in Automation, Electrical Engineering, Industrial IT or a related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical, biotechnology or life science environment.
  • Professional experience with at least one of the following: PLC, SCADA, HMI, DCS, MES, industrial automation or OT networks.
  • Knowledge of automation systems and industrial communication technologies.Experience with one or more platforms such as Siemens, Rockwell/Allen-Bradley, Emerson DeltaV or Syncade is an advantage.
  • Understanding of GMP, GAMP 5, data integrity and qualification/validation principles.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a consulting and project-based environment.
  • Good communication skills in English; German is a strong advantage.

Benefits

Joining a group with strong development potential that aims to improve your employability on challenging and varied projects

  • Joining a structure that has been established in Switzerland for a long time with a client portfolio that includes leaders in the sector
  • Having a sustainable job with stability and access to a real collaboration
  • Benefit from training with accredited and certified centers
  • Having a local management team to support you in the achievement of your missions and in the development of your career
  • Being part of a dynamic, committed team with real human values that we live by every day

Only applications from Swiss and EU citizens will be considered.

jobs.title: HR Country Manager Denmark
jobs.description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.   As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.  About the job As HR Country Manager, you will be supporting Alfa Laval's Scaling for Future direction, with a focus on Denmark, with 2000 employees and five Danish legal entities. The role in this form is newly established, giving you a fantastic opportunity to influence the position and make it your own!  The position supports several types of organizations in Denmark and Scandinavia, such as sales companies, factories, shared services, business units, and product groups. The key priority will be to ensure HR alignment across the legal entities and compliance with Danish legislation and collective agreements. You will contribute to harmonizing people policies and practices and as a trusted partner, you will support and inspire management by proactively driving organizational, leadership, and competence development.  You will act as:     HR Country Manager for Denmark, ensuring alignment, compliance, and consistent HR practices across all five legal entities across four sites - Søborg, Kolding, Aalborg and Nakskov.     HR Representative in the Danish Country Council, coordinating national HR topics and providing a consolidated HR view to business leaders in the country council     HR Business Partner for Søborg Site Services and the HR Shared Services Scandinavia organization.     Local HR responsibility for the Søborg site, including Site Management, the Works Council, the Work Environment Council, and the Crisis Management Team.     The one responsible for overall country-level approach to unions, including ensuring alignment in union relationships, works council cooperation and collective agreement governance and also provide guidance together with HR Shared Services on employee relations areas.  Operational responsibilities:    Plan and drive national HR focus areas for the five Danish entities aligned with the business strategy and People Strategy.     Develop and implement people policies, processes, routines, guidelines, tools and analytics.     Ensure country-wide consistency for benefits frameworks, allowances, principles, policies.     Coordinate the salary budget and review process in Denmark together with the Employee Relations team in HR Shared Services     Drive, support and inspire management in organizational, leadership, and competence development.     Coordinate local HR activities at the Søborg site, including collaboration with employee representatives and relevant councils.  Travel is part of the job, mainly to our various sites in Denmark, but you will also have a few travel days a year within Europe. You will be part of the Danish Country Council management team as well as part of the Søborg Site Management team. You report to Per Lund Hansen, a manager who will give you freedom and mandate to perform at your best. You will also have a dotted line to our VP Total Rewards and HR Shared Services, Gabriella Nagy Olofsson.  Who you are You are an experienced and confident HR professional, who is ready to take on the role as a trusted sparring partner for managers and leaders. You bring a genuine interest in understanding the business and getting to know our people. To succeed we see you as a strong communicator able to create engagement, participation, and clarity. You are people-oriented and build good solid relationships and have the know-how in leading through others. You make decisions with overall perspective and consider the needs of the entire organization.  Requirements:     Solid experience from a similar role within a larger international matrix organization and a strong background in country-level HR governance.     In-depth knowledge of Danish labour law, industrial relations, negotiations and collective agreements.     Experience in leading and coordinating change work, developing and implementing HR processes, routines, and guidelines.     Good ability to work in HR systems     Excellent communication skills in Danish and English and the ability to formulate clear and well-structured routines, guidelines, and strategic documents.     Completed university education in HR of at least 180 ECTS credits, or an equivalent education deemed relevant by the employer.     Driving license. We do not accept applications via email, due to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Please send your application no later than November 18, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long!  While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing close to our office in Søborg, Denmark. We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioral traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.  As part of Alfa Laval's commitment to a safe and healthy workplace, we conduct background checks on final candidates for this role, and alcohol and drug testing is applied during the pre‑employment process.  #LI-CL1

jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager for Renewables Service, Location: DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, DK - Aarhus
jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for building strategic customer relationships and turning complex opportunities into long-term business success? Are you motivated by helping accelerate the energy transition through offshore wind solutions? If so, this could be your next career opportunity. At Semco Maritime, we are looking for an experienced Senior Sales Manager to strengthen our Renewables Service business. You will play a key role in developing strategic sales opportunities, supporting key customer relationships, and securing service contracts for offshore wind assets in selected international markets. Your position As our new Senior Sales Manager, you will have end-to-end commercial ownership of strategic sales opportunities within the Renewables Division. Working closely with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, you will lead the external commercial journey from early opportunity identification and qualification through tender management, contract negotiation, award, and handover to project execution. At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector. You will be accountable for building and converting a strong pipeline of strategic opportunities into profitable contracts while developing long-term relationships with selected key customers. You will shape winning commercial strategies based on customer needs, market dynamics, and Semco’s capabilities, and ensure that commercial priorities are aligned across relevant functions.You will contribute to defining our commercial focus for selected customers and market segments, helping ensure that we invest our efforts where Semco Maritime has the strongest position to win. Your success will be measured by your ability to build strategic customer relationships, develop high-quality pipeline and convert complex opportunities into sustainable and profitable business.Your place of work will be at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg, our office located in Copenhagen or our future office in Aarhus. The position is full-time, and you can expect to up to 30 travel days per year. Your tasks & responsibilities As our new Senior Sales Manager, you will take ownership of strategic sales opportunities throughout the entire commercial lifecycle.Working closely with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, you will develop winning strategies, build strong commercial relationships, and identify growth opportunities across existing and new accounts. You will play a central role in shaping account strategies, developing customer-focused value propositions, and ensuring that commercial solutions are aligned with both customer needs and operational capabilities.In addition, you will represent Semco Maritime in customer interactions and industry forums, contribute valuable market insights, and help strengthen our commercial processes and best practices across the organisation.Your tasks will include but are not limited to: 
  • Driving strategic sales opportunities from qualification through contract award and handover.
  • Developing and executing winning strategies for key tenders and commercial opportunities.
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with strategic customers and supporting key account development.
  • Leading customer negotiations in collaboration with technical, operational, legal, procurement, and finance stakeholders.
  • Identifying and pursuing business growth opportunities, including cross-selling, upselling, and framework agreements.
  • Ensuring high-quality commercial proposals, risk assessments, and governance approvals.
  • Promoting a strong culture of safety, quality, compliance, and integrity in all commercial activities.
Your profile & qualifications We are looking for a commercially driven professional who thrives in a customer-focused environment and has a proven track record of managing complex sales opportunities - preferably from the wind industry. To succeed in this role, we imagine that you: 
  • Have significant experience with complex B2B sales, opportunity and tender management, contract negotiations, and the development of winning strategies for strategic sales opportunities.
  • Bring experience from offshore wind, renewable energy, maritime, technical service, or related industries.
  • Have a strong understanding of customer decision processes, competitive positioning, value creation, and commercial risk management.
  • Have experience with key account management, account planning, and building long-term customer relationships.
  • Are comfortable coordinating cross-functional sales and bid activities involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Possess strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills and work in a structured, proactive, and results-oriented manner.
  • Communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing, and are willing to travel as part of the role. 
Welcome to Semco MaritimeAt Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.  Care to join the movement?Change. With us.Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: ICT-asiantuntija | DigiHelsinki Oy
jobs.description: **Ovatko VLAN, VXLAN, RADIUS, 802.11ax ja 802.1X sinulle tuttua työpäivän sanastoa? Haluaisitko seuraavaksi päästä hyödyntämään osaamistasi monipuolisessa tietoliikenneympäristössä, jossa pääset sekä ratkomaan teknisiä haasteita että kehittämään palveluita eteenpäin?**Etsimme DigiHelsingille osaavaa ja motivoitunutta **ICT-asiantuntijaa** vahvistamaan tietoliikennepalveluidemme tiimiä. Tehtävässä työskentelet LAN- ja WLAN-ympäristöjen parissa ja osallistut niiden ylläpitoon, kehittämiseen ja uudistamiseen yhdessä palveluntuottajakumppanimme kanssa.Pääset mukaan tietoliikenneprojekteihin ja uusien palveluiden käyttöönottoihin, tekemään verkkolaitteiden konfigurointeja ja muutostöitä sekä ratkomaan häiriötilanteita. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiakkaiden, palveluntuottajien ja muiden ICT-asiantuntijoiden kanssa.Tässä tehtävässä pääset käyttämään olemassa olevaa verkko-osaamistasi laajasti ja samalla kehittämään sitä edelleen vaativien tietoliikenneratkaisujen parissa.**Mitä pääset tekemään?****Tehtävän keskeisiin vastuisiin kuuluvat:**- LAN- ja WLAN-verkkojen ylläpito ja kehittäminen - osallistuminen projekteihin ja uusien palveluiden käyttöönottoihin - verkkolaitteiden käyttöönotot, konfiguroinnit ja muutostyöt - tietoliikennepalveluiden häiriötilanteiden selvittäminen ja ratkaiseminen - yhteistyö palvelutoimittajien, asiakkaiden ja sisäisten sidosryhmien kanssa Ensimmäisten kolmen kuukauden aikana olet muun muassa ollut aktiivisesti mukana käynnissä olevassa tietoturvahankkeessa, omaksunut DigiHelsingin sisäiset toimintamallit sekä oppinut tuntemaan yhteistyökumppanit, joiden kanssa olet jo päässyt rakentamaan sidosryhmäyhteistyötä**Menestyäksesi tehtävässä sinulla on:**- vahva tietoliikenteen perusosaaminen sekä käytännön kokemusta verkkoympäristöjen parissa - soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto tai vastaava työkokemuksella hankittu osaaminen - kokemusta yritys- tai palveluverkkojen ylläpidosta ja kehittämisestä - hyvä LAN- ja WLAN-ratkaisujen sekä TCP/IP-verkkoprotokollien osaaminen - kokemusta verkkojen vianmäärityksestä ja järjestelmällisestä ongelmanratkaisusta - ymmärrystä verkkoturvallisuudesta, pääsynhallinnasta ja tietoturvakäytännöistä - hyvät yhteistyö- ja asiakaspalvelutaidot - sujuva suomen kielen taito sekä tehtävän hoitamiseen riittävä englannin kielen osaaminen **Eduksi katsomme:**- Cisco-verkkojen ja -laitteiden tuntemuksen - alan sertifioinnit, kuten CCNA:n, CCNP:n tai vastaavan - kokemuksen suurten organisaatioiden verkkoympäristöistä - kokemuksen palomuuriympäristöistä, kuten Palo Alto-, Fortinet- tai Cisco-ratkaisuista - runkoverkon teknologioiden, kuten MPLS:n ja BGP:n, tuntemuksen. **Hyvä tietää tehtävästä**Tehtävä edellyttää valmiutta työskennellä Helsingin alueella eri sijainneissa sekä ajoittain iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin. Työajan ulkopuolista työtä voi olla esimerkiksi suunniteltujen käyttökatkojen, asennusten, muutosten ja poikkeustilanteiden yhteydessä. Tehtävään valitulle tullaan teettämään turvallisuusselvitys, minkä hyväksytty todistus on edellytys työsuhteelle.**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**DigiHelsingillä pääset rakentamaan uudenlaista digitaalista kaupunkia yhdessä asiantuntevien kollegoiden kanssa. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa, kehittää toimintaa ja kasvattaa omaa osaamistasi jatkuvasti muuttuvassa toimintaympäristössä.Meitä yhdistää halu olla erinomaisia siinä, mitä teemme, ja kehittyä jatkuvasti paremmiksi. Uteliaisuus, uuden oppiminen ja oman osaamisen aktiivinen ylläpitäminen kuuluvat meillä ammattilaisuuteen. Arvostamme ihmisiä, jotka seuraavat oman alansa kehitystä, etsivät parempia tapoja tehdä asioita ja jakavat osaamistaan myös muille. Meillä saat vastuuta, pääset vaikuttamaan ja viemään asioita suunnitelmista käytäntöön.Meillä teet asiantuntijatyötä joustavassa hybridimallissa, jossa yhdistyvät sujuva yhteistyö toimistolla ja tehokas monipaikkainen työ. Toimistomme sijaitsee urbaanilla Konepajan alueella Vallilassa, erinomaisten kulkuyhteyksien varrella.Panostamme henkilöstömme hyvinvointiin, viihtymiseen ja yhteisöllisyyteen. Tarjoamme kattavan työterveyshuollon sekä monipuoliset henkilöstöedut, kuten Epassin kulttuuri-, liikunta- ja hyvinvointiedut sekä työmatka- ja lounasedun. Rakennamme yhteisöllistä kulttuuria yhteisten tapahtumien ja virkistyshetkien kautta.Palkitsemme henkilöstöämme kulloinkin voimassa olevan palkitsemismallin mukaisesti.**Monimuotoisuus ja yhdenvertaisuus**Arvostamme työyhteisössämme monimuotoisuutta ja yhdenvertaisuutta. Uskomme, että erilaiset kokemukset ja näkökulmat tukevat innovatiivisuutta, hyvinvointia ja tuloksellisuutta. Kannustamme henkilöitä erilaisista taustoista hakemaan meille töihin.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: About the roleBittium SafeMove Comms is a quantum-safe, end-to-end encrypted communications platform for government agencies, defence forces, and critical infrastructure organisations. It covers voice, video, and messaging on Android, iOS, and Windows, and is built on a zero-trust architecture that customers can run on-premises, in air-gapped networks, in the cloud, or in isolated tactical environments.Within our Security business, we are looking for an experienced and versatile Senior Full Stack Developer to join Bittium Wireless Oy and the team that develops, deploys, and maintains SafeMove Comms across our entire customer base. The position is based in Oulu, Finland, and offers a hybrid working model. You will work on both client and server, and you'll have real influence on how the product evolves. When the situation calls for it, you'll take the technical lead, both within the team and together with our customers.We are a small team, and we see that as a real opportunity for you. You'll get to take ownership early, have a direct say in technical decisions, and learn faster than you would in a larger organisation, across clients, servers, security, and customer work. With that opportunity comes responsibility: you'll own what you build, and you should be comfortable handling the pressure that comes with work where our customers' security depends on us.What you'll do- Develop SafeMove Comms desktop and mobile clients as well as server-side components- Solve demanding integration and architecture challenges without losing sight of the user experience- Take ownership of problems and drive them to working solutions, independently or together with the team- Lead technical discussions with the team and customers when needed- Take part in deploying and maintaining the product in demanding customer environmentsWhat we expect from you- Solid experience in software development across both client-side and server-side technologies- Strong software development skills and an agile mindset- Good collaboration skills and the ability to solve demanding problems independently- A willingness to take ownership and provide technical direction within the team and beyond- Experience with desktop development using JavaScript/TypeScript and React, or with Android development- Experience with server-side technologies such as Linux, Java, SQL databases, and Nginx- Fluent Finnish and EnglishWe especially value- Knowledge of network security- Knowledge of the Signal Protocol or similar end-to-end encryption protocols- Knowledge of PKI and certificate management- Experience in iOS developmentNice to have- Broader expertise in information security and cryptography- Experience with Rust, Redux, or ElectronInterested?Send us your application as soon as possible. We will begin interviewing candidates during the application period.About BittiumBittium specializes in the development of reliable, secure communications and connectivity solutions leveraging its 40-year legacy of expertise in advanced radio communication technologies. Bittium provides innovative products and services, customized solutions based on its product platforms and R&D services. Complementing its communications and connectivity solutions, Bittium offers proven information security solutions for mobile devices and portable computers. Bittium also provides healthcare technology products and services for biosignal measuring in the areas of cardiology and neurology. Net sales in 2025 were EUR 119.3 million and operating result was EUR 19.4 million. Bittium is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki

jobs.title: Warehouse work for peak season in Ringsted
jobs.description:
Ready for peak season? Join our warehouse team in Ringsted!

Black Friday is just around the corner – and we’re gearing up for our busiest time of the year!

At HumanizeR, we’re looking for energetic and reliable warehouse workers to join our logistics team in Ringsted as peak season kicks off. With Black Friday marking the start of an intense period, we need extra hands to keep thousands of parcels moving and ensure deliveries get where they need to be.

Looking for extra work, a flexible schedule, or a chance to get your foot in the door? This could be the perfect opportunity!

What will you be doing?

You’ll be part of a hardworking team keeping the logistics operation running smoothly. Your tasks will include:

  • Sorting parcels and preparing shipments.
  • Loading and unloading trailers.
  • Helping keep the flow of parcels moving during our busiest season.

No previous warehouse experience is required, training will be provided.

Choose your shift
  • Afternoon shifts: 14:00–22:00 or 16:00–22:00
  • Night shifts: 23:00–06:00

Please note that end times may vary slightly depending on the daily workload.

Why join HumanizeR?

jobs.title: Night Shift In the Inbound department at Imerco!
jobs.description:
Are you a night owl looking for a temporary warehouse job where you can earn money and gain valuable experience? Do you enjoy practical, hands-on work and prefer working at night? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

We are looking for motivated and reliable warehouse employees to join the inbound department at Imerco, one of Scandinavia’s largest merchandise companies. As we head into the busy Black Friday and Christmas season, we need dedicated night shift workers to help ensure that incoming goods are received and handled efficiently.

The job

Your working hours will be from 23:00 to 07:00, Monday to Friday. The job starts in week 45 or 46 and includes training shifts. It is important that you are available to start during these weeks and can work through to the end of December.

It will be approximately full-time from November. This is a great opportunity to earn extra money while gaining valuable warehouse experience.

Your tasks in the inbound department include:

  • Receiving incoming shipments

  • Opening, lifting, and moving boxes

  • Unloading pallets

  • Working with the Autostore

We are looking for candidates who enjoy working at night and can stay focused and productive throughout their shifts. You should be comfortable with physical work, routine tasks, and a busy warehouse environment.

Additionally, we expect you to:

  • Have experience working in a warehouse – experience with an Autostore is an advantage

  • Be comfortable working night shifts from 23:00 to 07:00

  • Prefer practical, hands-on, and structured work

  • Be physically fit and able to stay active throughout the shift

  • Be reliable, punctual, and able to work independently

  • Communicate well in either English or Danish

We offer valuable warehouse experience during the busy Black Friday and Christmas season, along with the opportunity to earn money during the winter period. You will become part of a friendly and supportive team, where tasks are clearly defined and workflows are well structured.

Working hours, salary and location

  • Working hours: Monday to Friday, 23:00–07:00

  • Start: Week 41, including two consecutive training shifts

  • Employment period: Through the end of December

  • Salary: DKK 156.34 per hour, including Fritvalgskonto

  • An ekstra 35 kr/hour when working the night shift

The warehouse is located in Vallensbæk, with good bus connections, nearby train stations, and free parking available.

Ready to join the night shift team?Apply today! We conduct recruitment on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Work in the evenings and earn extra – Join Imerco’s Black Friday Team!
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a temporary evening job in November and December? Do you enjoy being physically active, working at a fast pace, and being part of a great team? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

We are looking for motivated and hardworking temporary workers for the evening shift at Imerco’s warehouse in Vallensbæk. You will help ensure that thousands of Danes receive their Christmas presents on time.

The job requires that you can work 4-5 evening shifts per week during the period from November 20 to December 12. It is essential that you are available to work on the weekends of November 28–29 and December 5–6. The training will take place in the beginning of November.

Your primary task will be packing online orders for private customers. You will work at a packing station and handle a wide range of products – from Christmas decorations and kitchen equipment to electronics and gift items. The products must be securely packed in cardboard boxes so that they arrive safely at the customer.

Detta söker vi:

We are looking for someone who:

  • Enjoys routine-based and independent work

  • Has a good eye for detail – especially during the busy Christmas period, when accuracy is important

  • Is reliable, punctual, and able to take responsibility for their shifts

  • Is physically fit enough to stand and work actively throughout the shift

  • Has good energy and a positive attitude, even when the pace is high

  • Is available for 4 evening shifts per week from November 20 to December 12

  • Is available to work on November 28–29 and December 5–6

Experience from warehouse work, retail, or other physically demanding jobs is an advantage, but not a requirement. The most important things are that you are hardworking, dependable, and willing to put in an effort during the busiest months of the year.

We offer an exciting temporary evening position in a well-established retail company, where you will become part of a friendly and supportive team. You will gain valuable warehouse experience, work in a structured environment with clearly defined tasks, and have the opportunity to earn extra money during the busy Christmas season.

We offer a total hourly wage of DKK 156.39 per hour, in addition to which evening and weekend supplements are provided.

We conduct interviews and onboard new employees on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to submit your application. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Expert System Engineer – Intune & SCCM
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

  • Evaluate backend and endpoint infrastructure to define upgrades, changes, and expansion proposals.
  • Conduct feasibility studies and evaluate hardware and software solutions to meet organizational needs.
  • Develop technical designs in alignment with specific architectural requirements and implement system improvements.
  • Provide high-level support and maintenance for the IT infrastructure following ITIL methodologies.
  • Deliver technical advice and information to internal and external stakeholders regarding the technology stack.
  • Maintain technical documentation and actively share expertise within the engineering team.

Requirements

  • You possess 8+ years of experience in system engineering within large-scale environments of at least 100,000 endpoints.
  • You have expert knowledge of Intune, including MDM, MAM, BYOD, Enterprise Mobility + Security, and Conditional Access Policies.
  • You bring advanced expertise in System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM), focusing on distribution groups, task sequences, and software management.
  • You have in-depth experience with Active Directory, LDAP, GPO, and domain management.
  • You possess deep expertise in infrastructure stacks for Windows, MacOS, Linux, Android, and iOS.
  • You have 5+ years of experience with PowerShell and VBScript for infrastructure automation.
  • You bring broad knowledge of Azure, including license assignment and dynamic groups, alongside Office 365 and Windows Defender.
  • You possess a solid understanding of networking protocols such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and VLAN.
  • You’re able to interact effectively with diverse technical and business stakeholders.
  • You are fluent in Dutch or French with a very good level of English.

Nice to Haves

  • Certifications in MCSA, MCSE, or MCSD.
  • Experience with ServiceNow or PM² methodology.
  • Knowledge of PatchMyPC or 3rd party MDM solutions like Knox or KAI.
