jobs.title: Senior UX Designer - Map Visualisation
jobs.description:
TomTom's map is seen by millions of people every day - in dashboards, on phones, and across partner products worldwide. As a Senior UX Designer on the Map Visualisation team, you will shape how our 2D and 3D geospatial data is designed, styled and delivered across TomTom's product portfolio. 

You'll spend your days crafting multi-zoom map experiences, working with spatial data and collaborating closely with engineers and product managers to turn cartographic intent into production-ready map styles. You'll need to be as comfortable discussing label collision and style-layer specifications with engineers as you are refining colour palettes and visual hierarchy. 

This is a product role first. You'll be embedded in a cross-functional team that ships map rendering, map styles and SDKs used by other TomTom products and by the customers who build on our platform. You'll take part in the whole development lifecycle, from discovery and solution design through pull requests to release. Your product judgement, and your ability to bring people with competing priorities to a clear decision, matter here as much as your cartographic craft. 

AI is part of how we work. We expect you to use it to explore, prototype and ship faster, to know where it falls short, and to help shape map experiences in products where AI is part of the experience itself. 


What You'll Do

  • Design Compelling Map Experiences Create and refine 2D and 3D map visualisations from concept through production delivery. Own the end-to-end cartographic design process - from data exploration and sketching through to style implementation, QA and iteration across zoom levels, regions and use cases. 

  • Maintain and Evolve Core Map Styles Enhance TomTom's core map styles, ensuring consistency, readability and visual quality across platforms, screen densities and global markets. Balance aesthetic ambition with rendering performance and data constraints. 

  • Work as Part of the Product Team Work day-to-day alongside software engineers and product managers building TomTom's map data structures, renderers and SDKs. Take part in planning, refinement and reviews, provide design specifications engineers can act on, and review visual output during development and before release. 

  • Make and Own Trade-offs Help decide what ships, when and at what quality. Weigh visual fidelity against render budget, memory and frame rate on automotive and mobile hardware, customer requests against platform consistency, and scope against release dates. Reach a decision with the people who own the product, record it and see it through. 

  • Contribute to Renderer and Tooling Requirements Provide detailed input on the data and rendering capabilities needed to achieve design goals. Define requirements for internal cartographic authoring tools and identify workflow improvements that raise the team's output quality and speed. 

  • Bring AI into the Design Workflow Use AI to shorten the loop from idea to rendered map: generating and editing style-spec JSON, scripting data exploration, and building interactive prototypes on real data instead of static frames. Turn what works into shared workflows the team can reuse, and help define how we check AI-generated output for cartographic quality. 

  • Design for AI-Driven Map Experiences Contribute to how the map responds when the request comes from an AI system rather than a tap, for example in GeoAI answers, conversational search or agent-generated routes. Work out how the map shows what the AI found, how confident it is and when it is wrong. 

  • Inform Decisions with Research and Data Participate in user research, customer conversations and competitive benchmarking. Use insights to ground design decisions and advocate for improvements that address real user needs. 

  • Support the Design System and Standards Contribute to the Map Visualisation design system - documenting patterns, conventions and cartographic guidelines that enable consistency and scale across the product portfolio. 


What You'll Need

Leadership & Product Team Experience 

  • A track record of shaping product direction from the design seat. You set out the options, make the case for one and bring engineering, product and business stakeholders with you. 

  • A track record of shipping software as a designer embedded in a product team, ideally on map, location or developer-platform products: SDKs, APIs, map styles or tooling that other teams and companies build on. 

  • A clear understanding of how products move from discovery to release and beyond, including planning, roadmaps and measuring results after launch. You know how versioned releases, deprecations and backwards compatibility shape design choices on a platform with external customers. 

  • Hands-on familiarity with how software gets built: backlogs, refinement, estimation, definition of done, Git, pull requests, code reviews, CI/CD, feature flags and release trains. You don't need to write production code, but you need to understand how your designs move through a rendering pipeline and into a release. 

  • Sound judgement under constraint. You can point to decisions where you gave something up to ship, and explain why it was right for the product and its users. 

  • Clarity with senior audiences. You can turn a complex design problem into a short, well-argued recommendation and own the result. 

  • Comfort with disagreement. You challenge a decision with evidence, accept the outcome when it goes the other way and keep the work moving. 

  • Experience contributing to solution design documents, technical specifications and cross-functional planning. 

Cartography & Digital Map Making 

  • A solid foundation in digital cartography, GIS or geographic information design. If your map-making depth is still growing, show us how fast you are closing the gap, including how you use AI to learn. 

  • Experience designing multi-zoom digital maps with attention to cartographic conventions, label placement, generalisation and cultural adaptation. 

  • Working proficiency with key mapping technologies and ecosystems: MapLibre, Mapbox GL JS, OpenStreetMap data and tooling, QGIS, ArcGIS, Leaflet, OpenLayers or comparable platforms. 

  • Experience working with diverse spatial datasets - vector tiles, raster tiles, GeoJSON, shapefiles, point clouds or terrain data. 

  • Awareness of cartographic standards across regions and cultures, including sensitive topics such as disputed borders and local place names. 

Map Visualisation & Rendering 

  • Demonstrated ability to build visually compelling 2D and 3D map experiences - from thematic styling and terrain visualisation to street-level detail. 

  • Hands-on experience designing 3D map content such as buildings, terrain, landmarks and lane-level road geometry, in stylised or realistic form. You understand how LOD, lighting, materials and camera pitch affect legibility and performance. 

  • Experience with 3D data formats and pipelines such as glTF and 3D Tiles, and how 3D assets are prepared and optimised for real-time map rendering. 

  • Good understanding of real-time rendering concepts as they apply to maps: style layers, zoom interpolation, data-driven styling, symbol rendering and performance considerations. 

AI in Your Practice 

  • Evidence that AI has changed how you work. Be ready to show a real example, such as a map style, data visualisation or coded prototype built with AI, and tell us where it let you down. 

  • Sharp judgement of AI output. You can spot errors in generated work and know which decisions still need a designer's eye. 

  • Experience turning personal AI use into workflows the team shares, within the limits of confidential data and licensing. 

Senior-Level Craft & Collaboration 

  • 5+ years of professional experience in UX, product or cartographic design, with most of that time spent inside software product teams. 

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cartography, Geography, GIS, UX Design, Computer Science or a related field - or equivalent professional experience. 

  • Ability to build clear, concise prototypes and specification documentation that bridge design and engineering. 

  • Strong visual and graphic design fundamentals - typography, colour theory, hierarchy and layout. 

  • User-centric mindset with a collaborative, low-ego approach to problem-solving. 

  • High attention to detail and a real passion for the craft of map making. 


Nice to Have

  • Experience with game engines or 3D content pipelines (Unity, Unreal Engine, Blender) and their application to geospatial visualisation. 

  • Familiarity with front-end languages and graphics APIs (JavaScript/TypeScript, WebGL, WebGPU, GLSL) or scripting for cartographic automation (Python, PostGIS, Overpass API). With AI, even basic coding skills go a long way. 

  • Experience with map data processing tools and pipelines: Tippecanoe, Tilemaker, osm2pgsql, Mapnik or similar. 

  • Understanding of the automotive, fleet management or logistics industries and their mapping requirements. 

  • Familiarity with emerging trends in spatial computing, AR navigation or digital twins. 

  • Experience contributing to design systems at scale. 

What we offer

A competitive compensation package, of course.  

Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning. 

Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities.  

Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.

Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance. 

Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping.  

Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday. 

Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world. 

Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom! 

Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location. 

Meet your team

We’re the User Experience Design team. Fueled by user insights and data analytics, our mission is to create powerful, easy-to-use products that delight our customers, from millions of drivers to automotive customers who embed our technologies in their vehicles. We deliver the design specifications for all TomTom’s products. Joining us, you'll be part of a team that brings together design disciplines from user research to interaction, concept and visual design. Together, we'll continue to develop a map that people trust all around the world.


At TomTom...

You’ll help people find their way in the world. In 2004, TomTom revolutionized how the world moves with the introduction of the first portable navigation device. Now, we intend to do it again by engineering the first-ever real-time map, the smartest and most useful map on the planet.

Work with a team of 3,600+ unique, curious and passionate problem-solvers. Together, we’ll open up a world of possibilities for car manufacturers, enterprises and developers to help people understand and get closer to the world around them.


After you apply

Our recruitment team will work hard to give you a meaningful experience throughout your journey with us, no matter the outcome. Your application will be screened closely and you can rest assured that all follow-up actions will be thorough, from assessments and interviews all the way through onboarding. To find out more about our application process, check out our hiring FAQs.


TomTom is an equal opportunity employer

TomTom is where you can find your place in the world. Every day we welcome, nurture and celebrate differences. Why? Because your uniqueness is what makes you, you. No matter your culture or background, you’ll find your impact at TomTom. Research also shows that sometimes women and underrepresented communities can be hesitant to apply for positions unless they believe they meet 100% of the criteria. jobs.title: Datainsinööri Tietohallinto
jobs.description: Haluatko olla mukana kehittämässä tulevaisuuden terveydenhuoltoa? Etsimme ehkä juuri sinua Datainsinööriksi vakituiseen työsuhteeseen HUSin Tietohallintoon!HUSin Tietohallinto on aktiivinen toimija, joka kehittää ja ottaa käyttöön uusia innovaatioita terveydenhuollon toimialalla. Tietohallinto on HUSin tulosyksikkö ja se toimittaa tietojärjestelmä-, tietotekniikka- ja viestintätekniikkapalveluita sekä tietotekniikan laitevuokrausta pääsääntöisesti HUS-yhtymälle, yhtymän yhteistyökumppaneille sekä tytär- ja osakkuusyhteisöille. Meillä pääset työskentelemään Suomen suurimman terveydenhuoltoalan toimijan strategisen IT-osaamisen parissa ja kehittämään tulevaisuuden terveydenhuoltoa. Miksi HUS? * Merkityksellinen työ: Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan terveydenhuollon tulevaisuuteen ja parantamaan ihmisten elämänlaatua. * Tasapaino työn ja vapaa-ajan välillä: Tarjoamme joustavat työajat, mahdollisuuden etätyöhön ja kilpailukykyisen palkan. * Ammattitaitoinen ja mukava työyhteisö: Meillä työskentelee huippuosaajia, jotka tukevat ja inspiroivat toisiaan. Tehtävän kuvausHaemme nyt datainsinööriä vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Tietohallinnon Data, AI ja analytiikka -vastuualueen Tietoallas- ja tietotuotantopalvelut -vastuuyksikköön.Data, AI ja analytiikka -vastuualueella kehitämme tulevaisuuden terveydenhuoltoa. Missionamme on tehdä terveydenhuollosta entistä tehokkaampaa ja vaikuttavampaa sekä luoda datalla arvoa. HUSin tietoallasta on kehitetty edelläkävijänä jo kymmenen vuoden ajan, ja datan rooli HUSin toimintojen kehittämisessä on kaiken ytimessä.Meillä työskentelee huippuosaajia datan, tekoälyn, tiedolla johtamisen ja tutkimuksen saralla monipuolisissa rooleissa, kuten analyytikkoina, kehittämispäällikköinä, tuotepäällikköinä ja tietoarkkitehteina. Osaajiamme motivoi merkityksellinen työ, ja etsimme aktiivisesti lisää työkavereita datan, analytiikan ja tekoälykehittämisen saralla. Tulevaisuuden sote rakennetaan datalla!Tietoallas- ja tietotuotantopalvelut -vastuuyksikössä työskentelee vajaa 20 datan, datainfrastruktuurin ja analytiikan asiantuntijaa. Yksikkömme vastaa HUSin tietoalustasta, joka pitää sisällään tietoaltaan, tietovaraston sekä raportointiympäristön HUS-laajuiselle raportoinnille. Tietoallas- ja tietotuotantopalvelut yksikössä pääset mukaan kehittämään ja ylläpitämään yhtä Euroopan suurinta terveysdatan data-alustaa yhdessä timanttisen tiimin kanssa.Haettavassa tehtävässä toimit osana HUSin tietoallas- ja tietotuotantoyksikkö, ja sen Data Engineering -tiimiä. Tehtävänäsi on kehittää ja ylläpitää datan käsittelyyn liittyviä prosesseja ja dataputkia. Osallistut aktiivisesti tietoaltaan teknisten kyvykkyyksien ja datan laadun kehittämiseen, tuoden esiin uusia näkökulmia ja parannusehdotuksia erityisesti infrastruktuuriin ja teknisiin kokonaisuuksiin liittyvissä kysymyksissä. Osallistut tiimisi kanssa datan mallinnukseen liittyviin suunnittelu- ja kehitystehtäviin koko tietoalustan tasolla, mukaan lukien tietoallas, tietovarasto ja raportointiympäristö. Tuet osaltasi tietoalustan kehitystä ja varmistat että HUSilla käytössä olevat ratkaisut palvelevat tehokkaasti liiketoiminnan tarpeita, sekä tukevat organisaation kokonaisstrategiaa.Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää * Ohjelmointitaitoja (esim. Python, Scala, SQL, Spark) * Osaamista tietoarkkitehtuurista, pilviteknologioista ja pilviarkkitehtuurista * Osaamista Microsoft Azuren ympäristöstä sekä Databricksistä * Kykyä kommunikoida selkeästi suomeksi ja englanniksi * Hyviä priorisointitaitoja ja paineensietokykyä.Arvostamme * Kokemusta ketterien kehitysmenetelmin hyödyntämisessä * Kokemusta terveydenhuollon käsitteistä ja tietomallinnuksesta * Ymmärrystä eri tiedon mallintamismenetelmistä ja metodologioista * Innovointikyvykkyyttä tiedolla johtamisen kehittämisessä * Sitoutumista yhteisiin toimintamalleihin ja laatutyöhön * Kykyä tiimityöskentelyyn sekä itsenäiseen- ja asiakastarvelähtöiseen ohjautuvuuteen muuttuvassa toimintaympäristössä * Intoa kehittää HUSin työyhteisöä ja työkulttuuria kohti entistä ketterämpää ja tehokkaampaa toimintaa.Me tarjoamme sinulle * Itsenäisen ja vastuullisen työn, jossa pääset johtamaan omaa työtäsi * Joustavan työajan ja hyvän työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainon * Asiantuntevan ja mukavan työyhteisön, jossa kehitetään jatkuvasti työskentelytapoja ja työkulttuuria * Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa Suomen suurimman erikoissairaanhoidon palvelujen tarjoajan toiminnan kehittämiseen * Ammattitaitoista, empaattista ja inhimillistä johtamista * Mahdollisuuden kehittää ja modernisoida HUSin toimintakulttuuria * Kilpailukykyisen palkan ja mukavat työajat * Työn, jolla on todellista merkitystä: Me huslaiset olemme sitoutuneet terveydenhuollon palvelujen kehittämiseen ja pääsemme päivittäin tekemään töitä ihmisten hyvinvoinnin tukemiseksi.Virkaan tai tehtävään valittavasta henkilöstä voidaan tehdä hakijan suostumuksella henkilöturvallisuusselvitys (turvallisuusselvityslaki 726/2014). Turvallisuusselvitysmenettelystä ja selvityksen kohteen oikeuksista löytyy tarkempia tietoja osoitteessawww.supo.fi.Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 4806,69 €/kk ja mahdolliset kokemus- ja muut lisät. Työ voi alkaa 4.1.2027 tai sopimuksen mukaan. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana sopivien henkilöiden löytyessä.Hae meille hakuajan loppuun mennessä. HUSissa olet osa vaikuttavinta hoitoa.Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdotSoveltuva korkeakoulututkinto tai soveltuva opistotutkinto ja soveltuva kokemus.Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista.YhteystiedotLisätietoja tehtävästä antaa vastuuyksikön päällikön sijainen Ossi Syd, ext-ossi.syd@hus.fitai vastuualueen johtaja Sara Kinnunen, sara.kinnunen@hus.fi.Hakemukset liitteineen tulee jättää sähköisen järjestelmän kautta.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Software Engineer, Infrastructure

Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) Â· $185Kâ$215K base + meaningful early-stage equity + full benefits

Â 

About Sodalis

Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait.

Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist.

We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx).

Â 

The Opportunity

Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own.
We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live.

We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range.
You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture.

What you'll do

  • Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between.

  • Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy.

  • Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site.

  • Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range.

  • Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering.

  • You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services.

  • You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded.

  • You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them.

  • You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity.

  • You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required.

How we work

We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk.

In this role you will lead machinery safety inspections and risk assessments, apply the EU Machinery Directive and harmonised standards, and influence engineering and operations leaders to build safe-by-design into our equipment and processes. jobs.description: Sustainable Finance Project ManagerPermanent contract (CDI), full-time | Start: as soon as possible | Location: LuxembourgThe roleDo you enjoy bringing order to complex projects, following up on every action, and taking pride in documents that are clear, accurate and well-written? The LSFI is looking for a Sustainable Finance Project Manager to run its multi-stakeholder platforms, which bring together seniordecision-makers from the public and private sectors of the Luxembourg financial centre. You will work under the supervision of the Head of Sustainable Finance.As the central point of contact between the LSFI team and its stakeholders, advisory boards and working group members, you will make sure that every meeting is well prepared, every discussion is accurately recorded and every agreed action is followed through to completion.What you will do• Stakeholder Forum: organise the LSFI Stakeholder Forum from start to finish (dates, agendas, presentations, minutes) and use participant feedback to improve each edition.• Advisory Bodies (IIAB and SAB): run their secretariat together with their Chair and Vice Chair, and track agreed actions until they are completed.• Women in Finance (WiF) Charter: onboard new signatories, manage the annual data collection campaign, coordinate the Steering Committee and the founders, and steer the annual progress report through to publication with the data provider and consultant.• Working Groups and Taskforces: launch new groups on topics selected by Management, run their secretariat with the Chair and Vice Chair, and keep members focused on tangible outcomes.• Support the Head of Sustainable Finance: Contribute to other LSFI projects as assigned by the Head of Sustainable Finance (including but not limited to coordination, planning of activities, participating in events, desk-top research) and to the day-to-day activities of the team.What we expect from you• Outstanding organisation: you plan ahead, take ownership, and drive several projects in parallel and meet deadlines.• Attention to detail and precision: accuracy matters to you, whether in a set of minutes, a data file or a slide.• Excellent writing skills: you draft clear, concise and well-structured agendas, minutes, emails and reports, and you can summarise complex discussions.• Diplomacy and firmness: you are at ease with senior stakeholders and remain courteous but persistent on follow-ups and deadlines.• Adaptability: you handle shifting priorities calmly without losing sight of the essentials.Qualifications and experience• Master's degree (or equivalent) in business, finance, communications, political science or a related field.• At least 2 years of experience in project management, stakeholder coordination or a secretariat role, ideally in an association, a public body or the financial sector.• Genuine interest in sustainable finance; knowledge of the Luxembourg financial centre and experience in the field of sustainable finance are an advantage.• Excellent command of English, written and spoken; German, French and/or Luxembourgish are an advantage.• Advanced proficiency in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel).Who we areThe Luxembourg Sustainable Finance Initiative (LSFI) (www.lsfi.lu) is Luxembourg's coordinating entity on Sustainable Finance. Acting as a centre of excellence and knowledge hub, it works with the whole financial ecosystem to accelerate the financing of the transition, with the ambition of making Luxembourg a global centre for sustainable finance. Guided by its Sustainable Finance Strategy 2030, the LSFI:• Builds expertise and leadership: acts as Luxembourg's expert on sustainable finance topics and regulation, sharing insights with financial institutions and policymakers and raising Luxembourg's international profile;• Mobilises the financial sector: runs working groups, taskforces and advisory boards, and drives initiatives such as the Women in Finance Charter to unlock high-impact, innovative projects;• Measures and communicates progress: publishes the annual Luxembourg Sustainable Finance Study, maintains a Resource Hub on regulation, standards and labels, and organises events such as the annual LSFI Summit and Masterclasses.The LSFI was founded in January 2020 by the Luxembourg Government (Ministry of Finance and Ministry of the Environment, Climate and Biodiversity), Luxembourg for Finance (the agency for the development of the financial centre) and the High Council for Sustainable Development (Conseil Supérieur pour un Développement Durable).What we offer• A role at the heart of the Luxembourg sustainable finance ecosystem, working closely with key public and private decision-makers and experts in the field.• A small, committed team where initiative is valued and where you will be involved in many aspects of our work.• Flexible working hours and access to training in sustainable finance.• A gross annual salary between EUR 45,000 and EUR 55,000, depending on qualifications and experience.How to applySend your CV and cover letter via e-mail.As writing is central to this role, the quality of your cover letter will be part of our assessment.Submission deadline: 30 November 2026

jobs.title: Job på Malta - Administrativ kundeservice - I gaming - Book en samtale i dag!
jobs.description:
Drømmer du om at kombinere et socialt arbejdsliv med sol, hav og et ungt dansk team? Har du lyst til at arbejde i et miljø, hvor tempo, samarbejde og personlighed betyder lige så meget som erfaring? Så har du muligheden for at blive en del af et lille, tæt dansk team i Sliema, hvor du arbejder med kundesupport for flere etablerede brands.

Du bliver en vigtig del af et team på otte danske kolleger, hvor man lægger stor vægt på personlighed, trivsel og fællesskab. Her handler det ikke kun om at yde god kundeservice — men også om at fungere godt socialt, bidrage til stemningen og være en del af et miljø, hvor man både arbejder og laver ting sammen uden for kontoret.

Vi leder efter en udadvendt og engageret person, der motiveres af at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og som trives i et miljø, hvor man hurtigt bliver en del af fællesskabet.

Hvad laver en administrativ kundeservicemedarbejder?

Du besvarer kundehenvendelser via e-mail og chat og sikrer, at hver kunde får en professionel og hjælpsom oplevelse. Du hjælper med teknisk support, guider kunder gennem platformen og sørger for, at eventuelle problemer bliver løst hurtigt og korrekt. Du overvåger også hjemmesidens funktionalitet og rapporterer fejl eller driftsproblemer til teamlederen. Derudover hjælper du med at promovere nye produkter og kampagner og støtter teamet i ad hoc-opgaver, når der er behov.

Du bliver en del af et mindre, socialt team, hvor personlighed og samarbejde vægtes højt — og hvor fredagsbar, fælles frokost og sociale aktiviteter er en naturlig del af kulturen.

Bidrager til teamet og udviklingen

Du er med til at skabe en god stemning i teamet og bidrager til, at hverdagen fungerer. Du deler viden, støtter nye kolleger og hjælper med at sikre, at teamet arbejder effektivt og med høj kvalitet. Da teamet er lille, har du mulighed for hurtigt at få mere ansvar og udvikle dig i rollen. Du bliver en vigtig del af et fællesskab, hvor man hjælper hinanden, og hvor personlighed og teamfit er afgørende.

Dit ansvar:

  • Kundesupport via e-mail og chat

  • Teknisk vejledning og fejlfinding

  • Overvågning af platformens funktionalitet

  • Rapportering af driftsproblemer

  • Hjælp til kampagner og produktinformation

  • Vidensdeling og støtte til nye kolleger

  • Opdatering af interne systemer og kundehistorik

  • Ad hoc-opgaver efter behov

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Taler og skriver dansk og godt engelsk

  • Udadvendt, social og trives i et ungt team

  • Har øje for detaljer og arbejder struktureret

  • Motiveret for at lære — erfaring er ikke et krav

  • Bonus: Erfaring med kundeservice eller kendskab til casino-/iGaming-branchen

  • Evne til at håndtere flere opgaver og bevare overblikket

Da teamet kun består af otte danske kolleger, lægger man stor vægt på personlighed og på, hvordan du fungerer i fællesskabet. Du skal trives i et miljø, hvor man både arbejder sammen og laver ting sammen uden for arbejdstiden.

Løn og benefits:

  • Årsløn: 27.000 EUR

  • Relocationpakke

  • Løn stiger efter oplæring/kvalifikation

  • Ca. 15 % skat

  • 40 timer om ugen

  • Rotation mellem 08.00 – 21.00

  • 22 feriedage om året

  • Sundhedsforsikring

  • Socialt arbejdsmiljø med fredagsbar, frokost og teambuilding

  • Danske ledere og et stabilt team

  • Gode lokale deals på fitness, sprogkurser m.m.

Karrieremæssige fordele:

  • Internationale muligheder – Malta er et globalt knudepunkt for tech- og iGaming-industrien, hvilket giver adgang til et bredt netværk af virksomheder og karrieremuligheder.

  • Erhvervserfaring i et voksende marked, en vigtig del af den digitale verden, og erfaring inden for dette felt kan åbne døre til fremtidige roller i tech, compliance og kundeservice.

  • Udvikling af værdifulde færdigheder – Du vil opbygge kompetencer inden for kommunikation, problemløsning og digital sikkerhed, som er eftertragtede på arbejdsmarkedet.

  • Mulighed for karrierevækst – Mange virksomheder i Malta tilbyder interne udviklingsprogrammer og karriereforløb, så du kan avancere i din rolle.

Livet på Malta:

  • Middelhavslivsstil – Malta byder på en afslappet livsstil med smukke strande, historiske byer og en livlig expat-community.

  • Engelsk som arbejdssprog – Engelsk er et af de officielle sprog i Malta, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig både socialt og professionelt.

  • Lav kriminalitet og god sikkerhed – Malta har en af de laveste kriminalitetsrater i Europa, hvilket gør det til et trygt sted at bo.

  • Leveomkostninger – Leveomkostningerne er generelt lavere end i mange andre europæiske lande, især når det kommer til bolig og dagligvarer.

Skat på Malta:

  • Attraktive skatteforhold – Malta har en gunstig skattepolitik for expats, hvor indkomstskat kan være så lav som 15 % for visse erhvervsgrupper.

  • Ingen ejendomsskat – Der er ingen årlig ejendomsskat, hvilket kan være en fordel for dem, der ønsker at investere i bolig.

  • Lav selskabsskat – Hvis du senere ønsker at starte din egen virksomhed, har Malta en af de mest konkurrencedygtige skatteordninger i EU.

Klimaet på Malta:

  • Solrigt året rundt – Malta har over 300 solskinsdage om året, hvilket gør det til et af de mest solrige steder i Europa.

  • Milde vintre – Selv i januar falder temperaturen sjældent under 10°C, hvilket betyder, at du kan nyde udendørslivet året rundt.

  • Varme somre – Sommeren kan blive varm med temperaturer op til 35°C, men den friske havbrise gør det behageligt.

At arbejde på Malta giver dig ikke kun en spændende karrierevej, men også en fantastisk livsstil i et solrigt og dynamisk miljø. Lyder det som noget for dig?

Har du arbejdet med salg, telemarketing eller marketing i mere end et år og er klar til næste skridt i din karriere? Eller brænder du for digital markedsføring, er kreativ og vil gerne certificeres som konsulent, der hjælper virksomheder med at skabe succesfulde digitale kampagner?

Hvis du er teknisk stærk, kreativ og udadvendt — og samtidig trives i et tempofyldt og foranderligt miljø — så har vi måske det perfekte job til dig.

Hvad laver en Google Ads Sales and Onboarding Specialist?

Du arbejder tæt sammen med ambitiøse virksomheder, der skal onboardes til digital vækst. Du rådgiver om Pay-Per-Click-kampagner (PPC), identificerer vækstmuligheder og skaber langsigtet værdi. Du udvikler og optimerer kampagner, opsøger kunder via telefon og video, og identificerer løsninger, der matcher deres unikke behov. Du opbygger tillid og sikrer, at dine kunder får det fulde udbytte af deres digitale investeringer — både på kort og lang sigt.

Du håndterer et højt volumen af kunder og rådgiver i komplekse kontekster. Du arbejder med strategier, der øger ROI og kampagnespend, og bistår med integration på tværs af platforme. Du bruger AI-værktøjer i din dagligdag og kommunikerer effektivt med forskellige interessenter — altid med respekt for datasikkerhed og GDPR.

Du bliver en del af et globalt team i hjertet af Barcelona, hvor teknologi og marketing mødes. 

Engelsktalende arbejdsmiljø er standard, og du får fuldt betalt oplæring, personlige coaches og adgang til certificeringer. Stillingen åbner døre til intern karriereudvikling og spændende projekter inden for digital markedsføring.

  • Rådgivning om digital positionering og annoncering

  • Forståelse for ROI og integration med andre platforme

  • Support og strategisk planlægning på nordisk niveau

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Dansk og engelsk på minimum C1

  • Bachelorgrad eller relevant erfaring i marketing/salg/Telemarketing

  • Kendskab til Google Ads, CRM og datastyring

  • Proaktiv og strategisk tilgang til kundeopgaver

  • Evne til at navigere i komplekse stakeholder-miljøer

  • Passion for digital markedsføring og forretningsudvikling

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav — hvis rollen vækker din interesse, opfordrer vi dig stadig til at søge!

Benefits:

  • Fast fuldtidsstilling (39 timer/uge) med hybridmodel i Barcelona

  • Flyttepakke med flybillet og indkvartering i privat studie

  • Privat sygeforsikring og sundhedsfokus

  • Bonus for at anbefale en ven

  • Arbejdsmiljø med sociale aktiviteter og teambuilding

  • Kontor med havudsigt i World Trade Center, Barcelona

Hvad får du ud af at tage afsted?

Barcelona byder på solrige dage, strandliv og kreativ energi. Her kan du nyde tapas ved havet, arbejde med banebrydende teknologi og udvikle dig både personligt og professionelt i et byliv, der aldrig står stille. Derudover får du:

Forestil dig at starte dagen med café con leche, arbejde med digitale strategier under palmerne og slutte af med live-musik ved stranden. Hos TP får du ikke bare et job — du får muligheden for at bygge en karriere, forme fremtiden og leve livet fuldt ud.

jobs.title: Pitkäaikainen sijaisperhe huostaanotetuille nuorille/teineille
jobs.description: Olisitko valmis auttamaan apua tarvitsevia nuoria tarjoamalla heille pitkäaikaisen kodin, tasapainoisen elinympäristön ja tukemalla heidän kasvuaan ja kehitystään? Sijaisperheenä pääset tekemään todella tärkeää työtä ja vaikuttamaan lapsen elämään kokonaisvaltaisesti. Tällä hetkellä tarvitaan erityisesti sijaisperheitä, joilla on mahdollisuus ottaa sijoitukseen teini-ikäisiä lapsia ja kykyä vastata heidän vaativiinkin tarpeisiinsa.Sijaisperhe on perhe, joka antaa kodin lapselle, joka ei voi asua omassa kodissaan. Sijaisperhe huolehtii lapsen arjesta, kasvatuksesta ja hyvinvoinnista. Sijaisperheelle maksetaan palkkiota ja kulukorvausta jokaiselta kuukaudelta, kun sijoitettu lapsi asuu perheessä. Kuukausitulot riippuvat sijoitettujen lasten määrästä (alla olevan taulukon mukaisesti). Tulot kerryttävät eläkettä.-Yksi lapsi: palkkio 2009 euroa, kulukorvaus 1035 euroa, yhteensä 3044 euroa-Kaksi lasta: palkkio 4018 euroa, kulukorvaus 2071 euroa, yhteensä 6089 euroa-Kolme lasta: palkkio 6027 euroa, kulukorvaus 3107 euroa, yhteensä 9134 euroa-Neljä lasta: palkkio 8036 euroa, kulukorvaus 4143 euroa, yhteensä 12179 euroaEnnen kuin voitte toimia sijaisperheenä, tulee teidän osallistua sijaisperhevalmennukseen. Haemme nyt sopivia perheitä tähän yksilöllisesti toteutettavaan valmennukseemme. Valmennus räätälöidään teille sopivaksi ja sen voi aloittaa sopimuksen mukaan, vaikka heti. Osa valmennustapaamisista on perhekohtaisia ja osa toteutuu ryhmässä muiden valmennettavien perheiden kanssa (etäyhteydellä). Valmennus on prosessi, jonka kesto on keskimäärin 5-7kk.Perhehoitajana eli sijaisvanhempana toimiminen edellyttää:-Ikä noin 25-60 vuotta. Tätä ikähaitaria voi hieman venyttää lapsen iästä riippuen, mutta ajatuksena on, että henkilön tulee olla kypsä päättämään pitkästä (mahdollisesti yli kymmenen vuoden) sitoutumisesta ja henkilön ei tulisi saavuttaa eläkeikää, ennen kuin lapsi on täysi-ikäinen.-Vakaa talous ja elämäntilanne. Traumatisoituneiden ja erityistarpeisten lasten hoitaminen on vaativaa ja jos oma elämäntilanne ei ole tasapainossa, saattaa se vaikuttaa voimavaroihin ja kyvykkyyteen toimia sijaisperheenä.-Ei mielenterveys-, päihde- eikä rikostaustaa. Nämä lienevät itsestään selviä esteitä.-Sopiva asumismuoto. Teinille pitää pystyä järjestämään omaa huonetta.Arvostamme seuraavia asioita, mutta tiedämme, ettei koko listan mukaista superperhettä välttämättä löydy. Ota siis rohkeasti yhteyttä, vaikkei jokainen kohta täyttyisi.-Ei omia alle kouluikäisiä lapsia-Kahden vanhemman perhe-Mahdollisuutta auttaa kahta tai useampaa lasta (esim. sisarukset)-Kokemusta erityisyydestä, esim. nepsyoireista, traumatyöskentelystä, oppimishäiriöistä-Kokemusta kiintymyssuhteen rakentamisesta-Kokemusta kasvatustyöstä-Kokemusta lastensuojelustaTyötä tukevia ammattikoulutuksia ovat esim. sosiaali- ja terveysalan- sekä kasvatustieteen koulutukset. Näiden lisäksi erilaiset terapeuttiset, ohjaukselliset ja psykiatriset lisäkoulutukset tarjoavat vahvaa tukea työssä menestymiseen. Virallista koulutusvaatimusta ei perhehoitajan työssä kuitenkaan ole.Aikaisempi työkokemus voisi esimerkiksi olla joku näistä:-Lastenkodin ohjaaja, perhetyöntekijä, sosiaaliohjaaja-Opettaja, erityisopettaja, varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja-Sairaanhoitaja, terveydenhoitaja-Psykologi / psykoterapeutti / toimintaterapeutti-Nuoriso-ohjaaja, yhteisöpedagogiTai muu vastaava työkokemus.Perhehoitajan tehtävässä pärjää parhaiten, jos osaa nähdä lapsen mahdollisesti haastavan käytöksen taakse ja ymmärtää aiempien elämänkokemusten merkityksen lapsen kasvulle ja kehitykselle. Työssä tarvitaan joustavuutta ja valmiutta ymmärtää ja kohdata lapsen biologinen perhe ja suku, eli läheisverkostot. Tämä voi joskus olla haastavaa, koska lapsen sijoitus herättää vanhemmissa usein paljon tunteita. Työhön kuuluu myös yhteistyötä sosiaalitoimen sekä muiden viranomaisverkostojen kanssa. Sijoitettu lapsi tarvitsee turvallisen kodin, paljon aikuisen huomiota, säännöllisyyttä ja rutiineja sekä tietysti kiintymystä, läheisyyttä ja rakkautta. Lapsesta tulee vähitellen sijaisperheen tärkeä ja tasaveroinen perheenjäsen.Sijaisperheen arki mukailee tavallista lapsiperhearkea, sisältäen arkea ja juhlaa, itkua ja naurua. Perheen toisen vanhemman tulee jäädä kotiin hoitamaan sijoitettua lasta/lapsia ainakin vuodeksi, jotta kiintymyssuhde ja asettuminen perheeseen mahdollistuu. Työn tukena on meiltä ammattitaitoinen tukityöntekijä, jonka kanssa käydään säännöllisesti läpi kuulumiset sekä paneudutaan lapsen asioihin myös syvällisemmin, lapsen yksilöllinen tilanne huomioiden. Kuljemme sijaisperheen rinnalla ja meille on tärkeää saavuttaa avoin ja luotettava yhteistyösuhde. Tukityömme on säännöllistä ja toteutuu puheluin ja kotikäynnein. Tukityön lisäksi tarjoamme perhehoitajillemme työnohjauksen ja lisäkoulutusmahdollisuuksia.Suomen Perhekodit Oy on nuori suomalainen yritys. Valmennamme ja tuemme sijaisperheitä arjen tilanteissa, koko lapsen perheessä asumisen ajan. Huolehdimme byrokratiasta niin että sinä voit huolehtia lapsesta ilman turhaa stressiä. Olemme helposti lähestyttävä, ihmisläheinen ja aidosti lapsen asioista huolehtiva joukko. Verkkosivuiltamme löydät kattavat tiedot sijaisperheenä toimimisesta.Ota yhteyttä, niin mietitään yhdessä, olisiko teidän perheenne sopiva sijaisperheeksi!

jobs.title: Senior Application Carve-out Lead / Specialist
jobs.description:
For our client were looking for 2 Senior Application Carve-out Lead / Specialists capable of independently driving assigned application separation activities from planning through execution and validation.

The resources will work closely with Service Managers, application vendors, business stakeholders, project teams and other IT teams. The overall objective is to add independent execution capacity to the team and reduce the amount of day-to-day carve-out planning, coordination and hands-on execution currently performed by Service Managers.

Scope: Dedicated demerger resources supporting application portfolios currently managed by IT Service Managers.

Resource 1- Support for Group Finance applications HFM Hyperion, IPM Anaplan, Tagetik, Workiva
Resource 2 - Support for project FX hedging and calculation application PROFIT

The resource is expected to:
· Take end-to-end ownership of assigned application carve-out activities.
· Establish and maintain the application-level carve-out plan, activities, dependencies and readiness. · Identify dependencies related to applications, integrations, data, environments, users/access, infrastructure, vendors and other solutions.
· Coordinate target environment and solution setup activities with relevant internal and external stakeholders.
· Drive technical and functional separation activities through testing, cutover and validation.
· Coordinate vendors and other technical resources required to complete the separation.
· Proactively identify gaps, risks, issues and required decisions.
· Ensure that required technical and operational documentation is created and maintained.
· Support solution handover and operational readiness after separation.
· Escalate to the Service Manager primarily when business/application-specific decisions, prioritization or escalation are required.

The resource should drive the work rather than only coordinate and report it.

Expected background and capabilities:
· Strong experience in enterprise application lifecycle, implementation, migration or separation activities.
· Previous experience in IT carve-outs, demergers, M&A integrations or comparable application transformation programs is strongly preferred.
· Good understanding of enterprise applications and their dependencies, including integrations, data flows, identity/access, environments and vendors.
· Experience in planning and executing testing, deployment, cutover and validation activities.
· Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, application owners, vendors and cross-functional IT teams in an international environment.
· Strong documentation and structured problem-solving capabilities.
· Self-driven, proactive and hands-on way of working.
· Ability to independently structure ambiguous topics and drive them towards resolution.
· Fluent written and spoken English.

Key success criterion: The resource must be capable of independently taking ownership of an application/workstream and driving the carve-out forward without requiring continuous operational steering from the Service Manager.

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Have you independently led end-to-end application carve-out, separation, demerger, or M&A-related activities, from planning through cutover and validation?Kyllä
- Have you personally owned an application/workstream and driven its carve-out activities without requiring continuous day-to-day steering from a Service Manager or Project Manager?*
- Do you have hands-on experience managing dependencies across applications, integrations, data, environments, identity/access, infrastructure, vendors, and business stakeholders?
- Have you been responsible for planning and driving application testing, deployment, cutover, validation, and operational handover as part of a separation or transformation?*

Please apply with your updated CV in English, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role. We offer continuously, which means that we sometimes remove the assignments before deadline. If you are interested, we recommend that you apply immediately.

Contract start: November 2026
Contract end: Until July-August 2027
Allocation: 100 %
Location: Preferably Tampere or Jyväskylä. Remote within Finland also a possibility.

We offer you: We offer a versatile assignment where every day is different and interesting. We also offer a very competitive salary and good employee benefits.

Are you interested in becoming a part of our dynamic team? The position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found, so please be quick and submit your application! 

Please include your salary expectation in your application. For more information, contact Kimmo Kärsämä, tel. 050 412 7500, kimmo.karsama@lokki.fi 

Explore Lokki, through our blog and website: https://www.lokki.fi/  .

Our vision is to provide the best customer experience with our reliable, humane and effortless service around Finland. Our most important asset is a person who, as we know, thrives in a reliable and supportive atmosphere. jobs.title: SAP Analytics Consultant
jobs.description:
We are seeking three experienced French-speaking SAP Analytics professionals to strengthen the internal SAP Finance/Analytics team of a public-sector client in Lausanne. The team supports the client’s financial reporting, budget planning, annual accounts and budget publication, all running on an SAP S/4HANA, BW / BW-IP, HANA and BusinessObjects landscape.

The three positions cover the full application lifecycle: one keeps the existing reporting and planning chains running, one builds enhancements and new developments, and one defines the target analytics architecture and guides the team through complex projects. All three work together within the same team, so you will have regular contact with colleagues across RUN, BUILD and architecture.

Location: Lausanne (minimum 3 days/week on-site during the first 3 months for onboarding and knowledge transfer, then remote. Remote work is possible only from Switzerland or the French border zone.

Contract: 01.01.2027 - 31.12.2029, renewable annually

Language: Fluent French

The Positions:

  1. SAP Analytics Techno-Functional Consultant – Corrective & Adaptive Maintenance (RUN) | approx. 100%

  • Qualify and analyse incidents on BW/IP, BO/Lumira, SLT, CDS/HANA Views and output management, including impact analysis

  • Reproduce issues and analyse data, performance, SLT replication and XML generation

  • Deliver corrections and changes across BW/IP, BO, Lumira, CDS/HANA, SLT and the custom ABAP XML program, with regression testing

  • Provide daily support for financial and budget reporting, as well as the production of annual accounts and budget publication

  • Deploy changes, support go-lives, carry out root cause analysis, and drive optimisation and documentation

2. SAP Analytics Techno-Functional Consultant – Enhancements & New Developments | approx. 60%

  • Analyse financial, budget and social reporting needs and map CRM/S4, BW, SLT and output management flows

  • Design BW/IP, HANA, CDS, BO/Lumira and SLT solutions and estimate effort and risks

  • Run POCs on analytical models, SLT and XML output flows

  • Build BW/IP models, CDS/HANA Views, BO/Lumira reports, SLT flows and the ABAP XML program, including testing

  • Prepare environments, transports and go-lives, and hand over to the support team

3. SAP Analytics Expert – Evolutive Maintenance & New Developments (mini-projects) | approx. 45%

  • Define the target analytics architecture (BW/IP, HANA, CDS, BO/Lumira, SLT) in line with the SAP roadmap and cloud analytics solutions

  • Lead scoping and GAP analysis, and deliver documented recommendations backed by SAP references and SWOT analysis

  • Lead POCs and validate performance and reporting output

  • Conduct design reviews, performance analysis and optimisation

  • Support the team on complex developments and knowledge transfer

Your Profile (all positions):

  • Senior-level SAP Analytics / BI experience on S/4HANA (for the Expert position: expert level, with proven experience in leading analytics architecture and design)

  • Strong BW / BW-IP skills in design, modelling, data loading, financial reporting and budget planning

  • Hands-on experience with financial reporting tools: AfO, BEx Analyzer, BEx Query Designer, WAD and broadcasting

  • Experience in budget planning, including planning models, simulations, consolidation and reporting

  • Solid knowledge of SAP BusinessObjects, Lumira and migration to WebI (N4V for WebI is a plus)

  • Experience with SAP SLT (CRM → S/4HANA replication, monitoring and troubleshooting)

  • Experience designing, extending and optimising CDS Views and HANA Views

  • ABAP skills to maintain and enhance a custom program generating XML for output management

  • Understanding of integration across CRM, S/4HANA, BW, HANA and reporting tools, with a focus on data quality, performance, security and governance

  • Knowledge of management accounting (controlling) and project management

  • Familiarity with RUN processes: incident resolution, SPS/SP cycles, regression testing, transports and Basis validation

  • Experience with Jira, ChaRM, Solution Manager and Confluence

  • Knowledge of SAP cloud analytics solutions (and, for the Expert position, the SAP analytics roadmap)

  • SAP Analytics certifications (BW, BW-IP, CDS Views, SLT, BO, Lumira, SAP cloud analytics) are an advantage

  • Fluent French is essential

What We Offer:

  • A long-term engagement through 2029, renewable annually

  • Meaningful work supporting the financial and budget processes of a public-sector organisation

  • A broad and modern SAP Analytics landscape covering BW/IP, HANA, CDS, SLT, BO/Lumira and cloud analytics

  • A choice of focus (RUN, BUILD or architecture) to suit your expertise and availability

  • Collaboration within an experienced internal SAP Finance / Analytics team

  • Remote working after the onboarding phase

  • Opportunities to shape the client’s analytics architecture and future roadmap

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer - Deepdesk
jobs.description:
About Deepdesk

Deepdesk, part of AnywhereNow, powers AI Assistants and Virtual Agents for enterprise contact centres, helping brands such as Achmea, Vodafone and DHL boost productivity today while scaling for the future of customer experience. As part of AnywhereNow, a global leader in customer experience technology with 220 colleagues worldwide, we combine the agility of a scale-up with the strength of an established enterprise provider.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced developer to join our small engineering team. The centre of the role is backend development in Python or Go and cloud infrastructure, with some front-end work alongside.

At Deepdesk, we are building “Augmented Intelligence” for the enterprise. Think Gmail Smart Compose for contact centres. We use machine learning to provide agents with real-time recommendations and autocomplete suggestions, supporting them in efficiently assisting customers. Alongside recommendations, we offer fully virtual assistants that can take care of repetitive tasks.

You will work on the services behind this: the Python and Go services and APIs, the data stores and the cloud infrastructure that run our product for enterprise customers, including the services that serve our recommendation models. You will also pick up front-end work where it helps the product, for example in our admin interface and widgets.

We are also building voice agents: AI that talks with customers in real time. Speech is turned into text, a language model works out the answer, and the answer is spoken back, all within a fraction of a second. You will help build and run the services behind this, in Python and Go.

We have a start-up culture, but your code is directly used and proven at scale. Our technology is cutting-edge and continually evolving.


What You’ll Be Doing

•  Build and maintain backend services and APIs in Python and Go, with background processing for heavy work.

•  Keep our databases fast and reliable.

•  Run and improve our infrastructure on Google Cloud: Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines.

•  Build and run the real-time voice agent services: speech to text, language model and text to speech, with low latency, in Python and Go.

•  Help deploy and run the machine learning services behind our recommendations. Machine learning experience is not required.

•  Design and provide complete and accurate end-to-end metrics.

•  Write and review well-tested, clean and maintainable code.

•  Follow software engineering best practices while staying pragmatic and avoiding over-engineering.

•  Contribute to front-end features in TypeScript and React when needed.

Our Stack

•  Backend: Python (Django REST framework, FastAPI and Celery) and Go.

•  Voice: Go for our real-time voice AI service, with WebSockets, speech to text, language models, text to speech and the OpenAI Realtime API.

•  Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse and Elasticsearch.

•  Cloud: Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Flux and Cloud Build.

•  Front end: TypeScript and React.

•  Quality: automated tests (pytest, and BDD integration tests written in Go), code review on every change, and automation to keep our code and delivery practices in shape.

What We’re Looking For

•  Strong professional experience building backend services in Python or Go. In Python, Django or FastAPI is a plus.

•  Solid knowledge of relational databases, in particular PostgreSQL.

•  Hands-on experience with containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD. Google Cloud is a plus.

•  Working knowledge of TypeScript and React, enough to build and fix front-end features. It does not need to be your strength.

•  A disciplined approach to testing, code review, maintainability and delivery.

•  Comfort working with autonomy and taking full ownership in a fast-moving environment.

•  Interest in voice and real-time systems, and willingness to also work in the other language. Our voice AI service and our integration tests are written in Go, and most of the backend is in Python.

•  A plus: experience with Celery, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, serving machine learning models, or real-time audio.

Why Join Us?

•  Based in the Netherlands, with flexibility over how you organise your time. [HR: confirm office and hybrid details]

•  A small team working with major enterprise clients.

•  Start-up culture combined with enterprise demands and production scale.

•  Full autonomy and full ownership of your work.

•  High standards, trust and plenty of humour.

•  The opportunity to shape real-time AI experiences used in enterprise contact centres.

•  Full-time (40 hours), permanent contract.

Information Security Responsibilities

All employees are responsible for supporting and maintaining the organisation’s information security standards. This includes:

•  Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures and guidelines at all times.

•  Protecting company, customer and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or loss.

•  Using company systems, devices and networks in a secure and compliant manner.

•  Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team.

•  Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required.

•  Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in line with company policies and legal requirements.

Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.

jobs.title: Morgenfrisk medarbejder til vores biludlejning.
jobs.description:
Hos Oscar Biludlejning søger vi en til en medarbejdere til vores afdelinger i Hørsholm og Birkerød, der trives med ansvar, kan arbejde selvstændigt og sætter en ære i, at tingene er i orden.

Du bliver den person, der sørger for, at vores biler står klar til kunderne – rene, velholdte og klar til afhentning fra morgenstunden. Vores kunder forventer en god oplevelse, og den starter med en bil, der lever op til en høj standard.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Tjekke biler ind og ud

  • Registrere eventuelle skader, kilometerstand og brændstofniveau

  • Kontrollere bilernes generelle stand og være opmærksom på rengøring og eventuel røglugt

  • Rengøre og tanke bilerne efter behov

  • Klargøre bilerne til næste udlejning

  • Håndtere nøgler og den digitale nøgleboks

  • Holde øje med dæk, olie og øvrige væsker

  • Hjælpe med at få biler til og fra værksted, når der er behov for det

Hos Oscar Biludlejning udlejer vi primært brugte biler, men derfor skal standarden stadig være høj. Vi forventer, at vores biler er præsentable, driftssikre og klar til brug – hver eneste dag.

Et job med frihed og ansvar:

Du får ansvaret for den daglige drift i både Birkerød og Hørsolm, og planlægger i høj grad selv dit arbejde. Stillingen er på cirka 2–3 timer om dagen, mandag til fredag. Nogle dage tager det lidt kortere tid, andre dage lidt længere.

Arbejdet ligger primært om morgenen, og du skal være indstillet på at starte tidligt, så bilerne er klar til kunderne omkring kl. 08.00. Til gengæld har du tidligt fri.

En del af opgaverne kan følges og planlægges hjemmefra via app og e-mail, og bor du tæt på afdelingen, vil du ofte kunne forberede meget af arbejdet aftenen før.

Derudover vil du hver anden weekend have ansvaret for to afdelinger. Opgaverne vil fortsat ligge om morgenen, og tidsforbruget vil være nogenlunde det samme.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er selvstændig og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Har øje for detaljer og høje kvalitetsstandarder

  • Er praktisk anlagt og kan lide at have orden omkring dig

  • Er fleksibel og hjælpsom over for kolleger

  • Har kørekort til almindelig personbil

  • Ikke er bange for store varevogne (alle biler er max 3.500 kg. til alm. kørekort)

Vi søger først og fremmest en medarbejder, der har lyst til at blive hos os i længere tid. Derfor vægter vi stabilitet og engagement højt.

Stillingen kan være særligt interessant for dig, der er førtidspensionist, efterlønner eller pensionist, og som ønsker et fleksibelt deltidsjob med faste rutiner, ansvar og kontakt til mennesker.

Du vil naturligvis få grundig oplæring, så du føler dig tryg i opgaverne og godt klædt på til rollen.

Kunne det være noget for dig?

Så send os en ansøgning og fortæl lidt om dig selv og din motivation for at blive en del af Oscar Biludlejning.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette person.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Embedded Platform
Senior business analyst - deadline 03/11/2026
jobs.description:
Job description :

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to work closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and technical teams to analyze business needs, define requirements, and ensure successful delivery of features within an Agile/SAFe environment.

The role involves managing the product backlog, preparing and refining user stories, facilitating requirements workshops, supporting PI Planning and sprint execution, and coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT). The ideal candidate will have knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power BI, Power Pages, and Dataverse, as well as the ability to leverage AI tools to improve requirements gathering and business process analysis.

Key responsibilities :

  • Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders, Product Owners, and SMEs to gather, analyze, validate, and document business and technical requirements.

  • Feature & Backlog Management: Analyze upcoming roadmap features, identify business value, dependencies, risks, and gaps, and continuously refine the product backlog.

  • User Stories & Acceptance Criteria: Create and refine Epics, Features, and User Stories with clear scope, detailed acceptance criteria, dependencies, and relevant functional and non-functional requirements.

  • Business Process Documentation: Prepare process flows (as-is/to-be), mockups, business rules, data mappings, impact assessments, and other supporting documentation as required.

  • Microsoft Power Platform: Understand Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven), Power BI, Power Pages, Dataverse, access structures, data models, solution architecture, and inbound/outbound data flows.

  • Agile & SAFe Delivery: Participate in PI Planning, backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily meetings, system demos, and other Agile/SAFe ceremonies.

  • PI Preparation: Support pre-PI planning activities, identify knowledge gaps and dependencies, prepare refinement materials, and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure feature readiness.

  • Definition of Ready & Definition of Done: Ensure that User Stories meet the agreed Definition of Ready (DoR) before entering a sprint and contain the necessary information to support the Definition of Done (DoD).

  • Technical & Cross-Team Coordination: Collaborate with development leads, testers, Product Owners, and other teams to clarify technical feasibility, resolve dependencies, and maintain alignment on scope and responsibilities.

  • User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Prepare UAT scenarios, use cases, and sample test data; coordinate end-user testing; collect and analyze feedback; and document decisions and follow-up backlog items.

  • Delivery & Release Support: Verify that delivered functionality meets business requirements, prepare sprint release notes, and ensure that documentation, user guidance, and training materials are updated.

  • Documentation & Traceability: Maintain centralized and accessible project documentation in tools such as SharePoint or Wiki, ensuring traceability from Epics and Features through User Stories, acceptance tests, and releases.

  • AI-Assisted Analysis: Use AI capabilities such as Copilot, AI agents, and other relevant tools to support requirements gathering, process analysis, validation of assumptions, and initial solution ideation.

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify business processes, improve requirements quality, and maintain a backlog buffer of approximately 1.5–2 sprints of ready User Stories.


Job requirments:

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst in Agile/Scrum and SAFe environments.

  • Strong experience in requirements elicitation, stakeholder management, business process analysis, and documentation.

  • Practical knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including:

    • Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven apps)

    • Power BI

    • Power Pages

    • Microsoft Dataverse

    • Data models, access structures, and data integrations.

  • Experience defining and refining Epics, Features, User Stories, and detailed Acceptance Criteria.

  • Knowledge of backlog management, refinement sessions, sprint planning, and PI Planning.

  • Experience with business process modelling, process flows, mockups, business rules, data mappings, and impact assessments.

  • Understanding of functional and non-functional requirements, including performance, scalability, availability, security, auditability, and GDPR/privacy.

  • Knowledge of Definition of Ready (DoR), Definition of Done (DoD), and requirements traceability.

  • Experience supporting UAT, including test scenario preparation, test data coordination, feedback analysis, and defect or backlog item management.

  • Ability to identify dependencies, clarify scope, assess gaps, and coordinate with technical teams and business stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with technical documentation, solution architecture, data models, APIs, and integration flows.

  • Experience using documentation and collaboration tools such as SharePoint, Wiki, and backlog management platforms.

  • Awareness of AI tools, including Copilot and AI agents, for requirements analysis, process improvement, and solution ideation.

  • Strong communication, analytical, facilitation, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple features and priorities in a structured delivery environment.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Finom is a fast-growing European tech startup, headquartered in Amsterdam, on a mission to revolutionize the financial landscape for entrepreneurs globally. We are developing an all-in-one financial B2B solution that seamlessly integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a mobile-first platform.
 
Following a significant €115 million Series C equity round, bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million, we are expanding aggressively across key EU markets (Germany, France, Netherlands, Italy, Spain). We go beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, to simplify financial management for small and medium-sized businesses.
 
At Finom, we empower our employees to make a real difference. We nurture an innovative and inspiring environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation, and ensuring every effort benefits our users, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Engineering Manager - Product
 
We're looking for an Engineering Manager who's both a technical leader and a product builder. You'll guide a cross-functional team (5-10 engineers across backend, frontend, mobile, and QA) in delivering products that create real value for hundreds of thousands of businesses across Europe.

What You Will Be Doing
  • You're a seasoned technical leader with strong engineering roots and a track record of building teams that ship products that matter. You communicate clearly with everyone – engineers, product managers, executives – and you're genuinely curious about the product, the users, the business, and how your team's work drives real impact.
  • You don't just manage delivery. You challenge problem framing with your PM partner, ensure the team solves the right problems, and think in terms of business outcomes, not just technical outputs. You're comfortable discussing retention and conversion funnels alongside system architecture. You help the team understand ROI and prioritize based on value and effort.
  • You have deep technical expertise and can still step in to unblock when needed. You balance feature delivery with technical debt, keeping scalability in mind while ensuring the team ships at pace. You make technical decisions through explicit trade-offs, not gut feelings, and help everyone understand the "why" behind choices.
  • You take ownership of both outcomes and people. You run meaningful 1:1s, create growth plans, and own hiring and promotions. You build engaged teams through honest feedback and coaching. You invest in making the team more productive – better tools, smarter processes, fewer bottlenecks.
  • You drive predictable delivery by partnering tightly with Product and Design. You communicate proactively about priorities, risks, and constraints. You encourage healthy debate and move toward "disagree and commit" when needed.

    • Who You Are
  • 5+ years of software development building data-intensive production systems
  • Proven track record leading cross-functional engineering teams
  • Deep technical knowledge: hands-on experience with at least one of the common general-purpose languages and platforms (C#/.NET, Java/JVM, JavaScript/Node, Go), distributed architectures, databases, messaging and queueing systems.
  • Experience in product-led organizations, ideally with international scopeStrong business acumen – you connect engineering work to revenue, retention, and trust
  • Comfortable with product metrics (DAU/MAU, retention, conversion funnels)
  • Exceptional communication in English across all audiencesA builder's mentality: you care about shipping great products and growing great teams

    • Our tech stack

     

  • Backend: .NET Core, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Kubernetes

  • You'll lead teams using React, Swift/Kotlin, Python/ML frameworks, and modern QA tools

    • What You Will Get In Return
     
    Make a genuine impact on the product
     
    We're a growing fintech serving hundreds of thousands of European businesses. You'll lead a domain team with real ownership and autonomy over what you build and how you build it. This is a place for curious leaders who want to grow as technical managers, product thinkers, and people leaders.
     
    Work in the EU
     
    Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
     
    Become a stock options holder
     
    Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
     
    Receive unwavering support and care
     
    Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
     
    Work & Swim program
     
    Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.
     
    Equal Opportunity Statement 
     
    At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer  (Excavator Automation)
jobs.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  

 

 

About the Job

The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. This role is at the intersection of system engineering, integration, field deployments, and debugging.

We are looking for an engineer with a degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Robotics or relevant fields and at least 2 years of practical, hands-on experience working with real systems - and if they fail, you can help us figure out why. This is not an entry-level or new-graduate role.

You will help define and execute system-level test scenarios, support atypical and beta deployments, and act as a technical bridge between the field and the engineering team. You will help train our field engineers and keep them in touch with fast evolving autonomy capabilities.

What you will do

  • Validate system behavior across machines, environments, and operating conditions

  • Identify edge cases, failure modes, and operational limits

  • Collaborate with engineering teams on making technical decisions on a system level

  • Investigate system failure during field testing or deployments

  • Apply hotfixes when appropriate

  • Support or conduct deployments if needed, especially pilots or beta customers

  • Support/conduct atypical deployments, pilots, and beta customers

  • Capture lessons learned from deployments and feed them back into system testing and design

  • Help prioritize fixes and improvements based on real-world impact


    • What we're looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or a closely related field

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience working with complex systems (automation, robotics, vehicles, heavy machinery, industrial equipment, or similar)

  • Strong system-level troubleshooting and debugging skills

  • C++ and Python programming skills, proficiency in git systems

  • Proficiency in Linux systems

  • Comfortable working in field environments (construction sites, test yards, deployments)

  • Ability to travel abroad, according to needs of the business

  • Driver’s license B category


    • Beneficial

  • Experience with excavators, heavy equipment, or off-road vehicles

  • Field testing experience

  • Familiarity with communication technologies such as DDS, Zenoh, LCM etc.

  • Experience in motion planning or control

  • Experience in robotic competitions

    • Don't meet every requirement? If you're enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn't match every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect candidate for this or other positions.

    This is an opportunity to join a dynamic, multidisciplinary team and to be part of a company that is reshaping heavy construction.

    Gravis is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team, and do not discriminate based on race, colour, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.
