Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  


About the Job

At Gravis, we build high tech systems that give machine operators superhuman capabilities. To adapt in real time to changes in the environment the Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into an autonomous control system. The robotics platform team builds the software foundation for our robots to enable non stop operation in the harshest environments. We ensure all algorithms execute correctly, based on a rock solid communication layer and world class introspection capabilities. We provide all the tools to deploy, develop and debug the most powerful robots on earth.

As a robotics platform staff software engineer, you will help shape and implement our vision of a scalable, safe and high performing robotics platform. You will  gather requirements from internal customers, architect the communication layer, node orchestration and lifecycle management as well as APIs to off-machine systems. The main focus will be on the design, implementation and maintenance of essential parts of the on-robot platform, contributing to open source projects where feasible. With your outstanding skills, you will be a role model for other developers in our organisation and guide them on their professional journey. 


What you'll do

  • Collaborate closely with engineers from other teams  to derive requirements and help shape the vision of our robotics platform 

  • Derive roadmaps towards our vision, incorporating business needs and handling conflicting timelines and requirements

  • Design, build and maintain parts of the robotics platform, e.g. health monitoring and machine configuration management. Guide junior team members to support your endeavors

  • Monitor external dependencies and alternatives to assess potential issues or improvements

  • Influence, nurture and grow our engineering culture

  • Contribute upstream to open source software projects to close gaps in required functionality

  • Engage in the robotics scene to stay up to date with ongoing developments and share knowledge in and outside of our company 


    • What we're looking for

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in Software Engineering, Robotics Development or similar roles

  • Strong Software Engineering skills and solid experience with related tooling (e.g. clangd, cargo, pyrefly)

  • Strong programming skills in a systems language like C++ or Rust, Python is nice to have

  • Track record of leading high impact projects across teams 

  • Experience with middleware (iceoryx2, DDS, AUTOSAR Adaptive) and IDLs (FlatBuffers, Protobuf)


    • Bonus Qualifications

    Don't meet every requirement? We still want to hear from you. These are nice-to-haves, not dealbreakers:

  • Experience working on safety-critical systems and the respective software development processes

  • Experience in developing a production grade robotics system

  • Track record of open source contributions

  • Experience using Rust in a production environment

jobs.title: Partner Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About Mecka AI

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

About the Role

Signing a capture partner is the start of the work. Getting that partner to steady, high-quality output takes onboarding, training, hardware, support, and reporting, and every step has to run on time.

As Partnership Operations Manager, you will own that path for our regional partnership leads so they can focus on finding and signing partners. This is a new function, so you will set the standards and tooling yourself and make them repeatable across regions.

What You Will Do

  • Deal support: Prepare proposals and agreements from approved templates and keep a clean record of every partnerâs rates, volumes, and term dates.

  • Onboarding: Set partners up on the platform, issue devices and accounts, and train their teams on capture standards so they reach full output quickly.

  • Hardware: Manage device allocation, tracking, replacements, and returns with our hardware and logistics teams, and keep inventory records accurate.

  • Partner support: Be the first point of contact for partners, and run the support channel to clear service levels. Resolve problems yourself or route them to product, engineering, or finance before capture is disrupted, and pass on what partners need from the platform and devices.

  • Performance and reporting: Monitor daily performance and quality across partners, including recorded, approved, and deliverable hours, recording counts, and QA rejection rates. Act when numbers slip, and raise anything commercial with the partnerâs regional lead. Keep scorecards, business reviews, and the data behind them current.

  • Payments: Own partner payments and reconciliation, making sure hours are approved correctly and paid accurately and on time.

  • Playbook: Build and improve the processes, checklists, and tools that keep partner operations running as the network grows.

What You Bring

  • Experience: 3 to 5+ years in partner or vendor operations, supply or merchant onboarding, business operations, program or project management, or account management, ideally at a high-growth marketplace, delivery, or BPO company.

  • Execution: A record of running many partner launches at once across time zones, with clear process and tight follow-up.

  • Organization: Highly organized and detail-focused, able to manage many partners and tasks at once without letting things slip.

  • AI fluency: You use AI tools in your day-to-day work to pull and analyze data, draft partner communications, and streamline your own processes.

  • Problem solving: A practical problem-solver who stays calm under pressure and sees problems through to resolution.

  • Relationships: Strong interpersonal skills. You work well with both partners and internal teams.

  • Agency: A high degree of initiative and comfort with ambiguity. This is an early and unstructured role, so you will set your own priorities, work without an established playbook, and build processes where none yet exists.

Even better if you have

  • Industry: Background in data collection, AI training data, or BPO services.

  • Field deployment: Experience with device deployment and inventory tracking across partner sites.

  • Multi-country: Experience running partner operations across several countries and time zones.

  • Languages: Working fluency in one or more of our regionsâ main business languages, alongside professional English.

If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply â we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, we will partner with you to meet your needs.

We may use AI-assisted tools to help evaluate applications against the requirements of this role. These tools support our recruiting team in identifying qualified candidates but do not replace human judgment or limit which applications may be reviewed or considered.

les clients et les équipes dans leur onboarding, et contribuer au mentoring et à la montée en compétences collective.À propos de vous :- Vous justifiez d'une expérience de 5 à 8 ans et plus en ingénierie cloud, avec une expertise reconnue sur Kubernetes (EKS et/ou GKE) et au moins un provider majeur (AWS, GCP).- Vous disposez d'une solide culture sécurité couvrant les dimensions réseau, applicatif, IAM, supply chain et conformité.- Vous maîtrisez Terraform et les approches d'infrastructure as code, ainsi que les pipelines CI/CD en GitOps.- Vous portez une sensibilité FinOps qui vous permet d'allier performance technique et maîtrise des coûts.- Vous êtes reconnu pour votre leadership technique et votre capacité à embarquer les équipes autour d'une vision commune.- Vous appréciez transmettre votre expertise et accompagner la montée en compétences de vos collègues comme de vos clients.Les prochaines étapes pour nous rejoindre :- Sélection de votre candidature par notre équipe jobs.title: Ura- ja työhönvalmentaja Keski-Uusimaa ja Kanta-Häme
jobs.description: **Ihmisessä on aina enemmän kuin hänen viimeisin ansioluettelonsa kertoo.** Se pätee asiakkaisiimme, ja ajattelemme, että se pätee myös sinuun.Etsimme kasvavaan, lämminhenkiseen tiimiimme ura- ja työhönvalmentajaa, joka innostuu ihmisten kohtaamisesta, tavoitteellisesta valmennustyöstä ja mahdollisuudesta vaikuttaa oman työnsä kehittämiseen.Meille hyvä valmennus on yhdistelmä aitoa kohtaamista, ammatillista osaamista ja konkreettisia tekoja.**Työ, jossa kohtaamisilla on merkitystä**Asiakkaamme ovat erilaisissa työuran vaiheissa. Joku etsii uutta suuntaa, toinen haluaa vahvistaa osaamistaan tai löytää uusia mahdollisuuksia työelämässä. Yhdellä on selkeä tavoite, mutta keinot sen saavuttamiseksi kaipaavat kirkastamista. Toinen tarvitsee rohkaisua ja tukea omien vahvuuksiensa tunnistamiseen.Sinä kohtaat jokaisen asiakkaan yksilönä, kuuntelet, kysyt ja haastat ajattelemaan uudella tavalla. Autat asiakasta tunnistamaan osaamisensa, löytämään vaihtoehtoja ja ottamaan konkreettisia askelia kohti työtä, koulutusta tai seuraavaa vaihetta työurallaan.**Valmennuksessasi oivallukset muuttuvat teoiksi**Työsi koostuu pääosin yksilöllisistä ura- ja työhönvalmennuksista Keski-Uudellamaalla ja Kanta-Hämeessä. Toimimme myös Vantaalla ja tuotamme etävalmennuksia ympäri Suomen. Valmennuksessa hyödynnät ratkaisukeskeisiä ja toiminnallisia menetelmiä, työelämän tuntemustasi sekä yhteistyötä työnantajien ja muiden verkostojen kanssa.Työ on itsenäistä ja vastuullista. Suunnittelet ja toteutat valmennuksia, huolehdit asiakasprosessien etenemisestä sekä varmistat, että tavoitteet, aikataulut ja dokumentointi ovat kunnossa. Meille laadukas valmennus tarkoittaa sekä arvostavaa kohtaamista että tavoitteellista ja tuloksellista työskentelyä.**Tällaista kollegaa toivomme**Etsimme valmentajaa, joka on aidosti kiinnostunut ihmisistä ja heidän mahdollisuuksistaan. Olet lämmin mutta suora, uskallat kysyä vaikeitakin kysymyksiä ja osaat kannustaa asiakasta ottamaan vastuuta omasta etenemisestään.Kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen valittavalta edellytetään sosionomin (AMK) -tutkintoa sekä vähintään viisi (5) vuotta työhönvalmennuksen (tai siihen verrattavissa olevaa) työkokemusta edellisen 10 vuoden ajalta.Osa-aika- tai tuntityöhön sekä yrittäjäyhteistyössä tutkinto voi olla soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto ja yhden (1) vuoden työkokemus alalta.Lisäksi toivomme sinulta:- Kokemusta ura-, työnhaku- tai työhönvalmennuksesta, ohjaustyöstä, rekrytoinnista tai työnantajayhteistyöstä. - Hyvää työelämän, työnhaun ja koulutusmahdollisuuksien tuntemusta. - Asiakaslähtöistä, ratkaisukeskeistä ja tavoitteellista työskentelyotetta. - Itsenäistä, järjestelmällistä ja vastuullista työskentelytapaa sekä kykyä hallita asiakasprosessien kokonaisuuksia. - Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa. Arvostamme myös muuta kielitaitoa, erityisesti ruotsin, venäjän, ukrainan, arabian tai viron osaamista.Meille tärkeää on, että pidät kiinni sovituista asioista, huolehdit työsi laadusta ja haluat kehittyä ammattilaisena.**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**Meille tärkeintä on löytää osaava ja työhönsä sitoutunut valmentaja. Siksi tarjoamme erilaisia mahdollisuuksia liittyä osaksi Cleodian valmentajaverkostoa. Voit työskennellä kanssamme kokoaikaisessa tai osa-aikaisessa työsuhteessa tai toimia yrittäjänä yhteistyökumppaninamme. Kokoaikaisen työsuhteen säännöllinen työaika on 37,5 tuntia viikossa ja kuukausipalkka on 2 900 euroa (sopimuspalkkaus). Osa-aikaisen työn ehdoista ja yrittäjäyhteistyön korvauksesta sovimme erikseen. Työsuhde on aluksi määräaikainen toukokuun 2027 loppuun.Valmennukset toteutetaan pääosin lähitapaamisina, sillä asiakkaamme arvostavat kasvokkaista kohtaamista. Osan työstä voit tehdä etänä.Työsuhteeseen kuuluu:- ePassin liikunta- ja kulttuurietu 300 euroa vuodessa (kokoaikainen työsuhde). - Lakisääteinen työterveyshuolto Mehiläisessä (työsuhde). - Kollegiaalinen tuki ja mahdollisuus jakaa osaamista kokeneiden valmentajien kanssa. - Mahdollisuus osallistua käytännön valmennustyön ja asiakasprosessien kehittämiseen sekä uusien palveluiden ideointiin. Olemme kasvava perheyritys, jossa ihmiset tuntevat toisensa ja apua saa matalalla kynnyksellä. Vaikka työskentelet itsenäisesti, et jää yksin. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteen sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. jobs.title: Scientific Account Executive
jobs.description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

Weâre growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the role

This is a hybrid sales and customer success role for someone with real scientific depth. You'll be the primary point of contact for customers â from first conversation through ongoing engagement. That means understanding what a protein design team is actually trying to achieve, helping them pick the right assays, making sure their experiments are set up correctly, and translating results back into language that's useful for their programs.

The day-to-day:

  • Running technical sales calls where you discuss binding kinetics, expression systems, and assay design, not just pricing

  • Onboarding new customers and helping them design their first experiments on the platform

  • Monitoring ongoing accounts, flagging issues early, and proactively suggesting next steps based on their results

  • Working with the biology team to troubleshoot when a customer's experiment doesn't go as expected

  • Identifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts â new targets, new assay types, larger campaigns

You won't be handed a script. You'll need to understand the science well enough to earn trust from PhD-level protein engineers and CSOs, while also being commercially sharp enough to close deals and grow accounts.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full customer lifecycle: prospecting, technical sales conversations, deal closing, onboarding, and ongoing account management.

  • Serve as the technical point of contact for customers. Understand their protein engineering goals and recommend the right experiments (binding, expression, thermostability, enzyme activity).

  • Understand and explain our assay capabilities in depth: BLI, SPR, cell-free expression, and emerging assay types. Know when each is appropriate and what the data means.

  • Work closely with the biology team to ensure experiments are designed correctly and results are communicated clearly.

  • Build and maintain a pipeline of commercial opportunities across customer segments: AI-driven protein design companies, biotech startups, pharma R&D teams, and academic labs.

  • Develop proposals and quotes tailored to customer needs, from small pilot experiments to large-scale data generation campaigns.

  • Represent Adaptyv at conferences and industry events. Be able to have deep technical conversations at the booth, not just hand out brochures.

  • Feed customer insights back to the product and biology teams: what assays are people asking for, what's missing, where are we losing deals.

What we're looking for

  • Scientific background in protein engineering, biochemistry, biophysics, or a related field. You should be comfortable discussing binding kinetics (KD, kon, koff), expression systems, and assay design without needing to look things up.

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role: field application scientist, technical sales, scientific account management, or similar. CRO or biotech vendor experience is a strong plus.

  • Commercially driven. You care about revenue, pipeline, and closing deals, not just having interesting scientific conversations.

  • Strong communicator who can adapt to the audience: detailed and technical with a scientist, concise and business-focused with a VP.

  • Self-starter who can manage their own pipeline and priorities without heavy oversight.

  • Genuine interest in AI-driven protein design and the companies working in this space. You follow what's happening in the field.

preferred.What we offer you- Attractive Compensation Package: A competitive salary that recognizes your expertise and performance.- Flexible Working Models: Enjoy time for yourself and your family through our flexible working hour models.- Continuous Learning: Benefit from specialized training and daily challenges to keep your expert knowledge up-to-date.- Innovative Environment: Become part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvement.Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usSiemens Advanta provides consulting services in the fields of strategy, operations, AI, and data analytics, as well as solution implementation services, to enable the digital and sustainability transformation of Siemens customers. jobs.title: Executive Operations Partner - EPD (Executive Assistant)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Our Executive Operations team work closely with Notion’s leadership, serving as trusted advisors, collaborators, and problem-solvers. We focus on amplifying the impact of our executives by anticipating needs, streamlining operations, and building systems that keep leaders focused on the highest leverage work. We’re deeply connected to Notion’s mission and values, and we take pride in creating an environment of collaboration, clarity, and authenticity. Our team thrives on strong relationships, operational excellence, and a shared commitment to building tools that empower people to think and work together more effectively.

This role calls for someone who is proactive, adaptable, and deeply organized. Someone who can balance complex scheduling, drive cross-functional coordination, and bring clarity to fast moving priorities. This person will support 2 leaders in our Engineering and Product orgs. Our ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments, operates independently, and consistently finds ways to improve workflows and communication. You’ll be a key partner in making sure our leaders and the company as a whole can move quickly while staying aligned. 

 

This role is based in our San Francisco office. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

jobs.description: **Kiinnostaako sinua 3D-teknologia, digitaalinen aineisto ja käytännön työ erilaisissa kohteissa? Tule mukaan muuttamaan olemassa olevia rakennuksia tarkaksi 3D-aineistoksi. Aikaisempaa kokemusta 3D-skannauksesta tai rakennusalalta ei tarvita. Ratkaisevaa on tekninen uteliaisuus, huolellinen työote ja halu oppia.**_Me Parmacolla uskomme, että rakennusten tulisi olla yhtä joustavia kuin yhteisöt, joita ne palvelevat. Muutamme yhteiskuntaa dynaamisella arkkitehtuurilla – muunneltavilla, siirrettävillä ja kiertotalouteen perustuvilla rakennuksilla, jotka elävät käyttäjiensä mukana. Tule mukaan tekemään tilaa kestävälle tulevaisuudelle!_Haemme noin **yhdeksää 3D-skannaajaa** määräaikaiseen projektiin 31.12.2026 saakka. Jatko on mahdollinen projektin ja Parmacon työtilanteen mukaan. Saat tehtävään kattavan perehdytyksen sekä kokeneempien asiantuntijoiden ja muun skannaustiimin tuen.**Työ sopii hyvin opintojen rinnalle.** Työaika on 0–37,5 tuntia viikossa, ja tarjotuista työvuoroista voi kieltäytyä. Työvuoroista pyritään sopimaan noin 1–2 viikkoa etukäteen. Tuntipalkka on osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan **15,50–17,00 euroa tunnilta**.Työskentelet osana skannaustiimiä ja kierrät työparisi kanssa Parmacon olemassa olevissa rakennuksissa. Suurin osa kohteista sijaitsee pääkaupunkiseudulla, mutta kohdekäyntejä on myös eri puolilla Suomea. Työhön voi kuulua ajoittain yöpymisiä. Käynneistä sovitaan joustavasti opiskelutilanteesi ja käytettävyytesi huomioiden.**Tehtäviisi kuuluu:**- rakennuskohteiden 3D-skannaus työparin kanssa - skannausaineiston jälkikäsittely ja pistepilvien leikkaaminen - skannausten kattavuuden ja laadun tarkistaminen sekä tarvittavat uusintaskannaukset - kohdetietojen, poikkeamien ja vauriohavaintojen huolellinen dokumentointi - skannauslaitteista huolehtiminen sekä projektin käytännön järjestelyihin ja raportointiin osallistuminen. **Menestyt tehtävässä, kun:**- olet kiinnostunut 3D-teknologiasta, digitaalisista työkaluista ja käytännön tekemisestä - opit mielelläsi uusia laitteita ja ohjelmistoja. Sinun ei tarvitse osata niitä valmiiksi. - työskentelet huolellisesti ja järjestelmällisesti sekä huomaat yksityiskohdat - ratkaiset käytännön ongelmia oma-aloitteisesti ja kysyt tarvittaessa apua - viihdyt liikkuvassa työssä ja työskentelet sujuvasti työparin kanssa - sinulla on voimassa oleva B-ajokortti. Omaa autoa ei tarvita. Plussaa, ei edellytys: CAD- tai BIM-ohjelmistot, pistepilvet, 3D-mallinnus tai -skannaus, paikkatieto, data-analyysi, Excel, ohjelmointi, visuaalinen dokumentointi tai muu tekninen tekeminen.**Mitä saat meiltä?**- käytännön kokemusta 3D-skannauksesta ja pistepilviaineistojen käsittelystä - perehdytyksen työssä käytettäviin laitteisiin, ohjelmistoihin ja toimintatapoihin - mahdollisuuden yhdistää liikkuvaa kenttätyötä ja digitaalisen aineiston käsittelyä - kokeneempien asiantuntijoiden ja skannaustiimin tuen - mahdollisuuden kehittää skannausprosessia yhdessä Parmacon asiantuntijoiden kanssa **Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi.** Kannustamme erilaisista taustoista tulevia osaajia hakemaan. Arvioimme hakijat tehtävän kannalta olennaisen osaamisen, valmiuksien ja motivaation perusteella.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative, CEE
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energized by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy

 - Run multi-channel outbound campaigns—email, phone, LinkedIn, and events—to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers

 - Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff

 - Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running

 - Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

jobs.title: AWS Cloud Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
As a Senior AWS Cloud Solutions Architect, you will be the technical lead on our most complex engagements, from assessment and mobilization to large-scale migration and modernization. You will report to an Engineering Manager based in Europe and lead distributed teams of US- and Budapest-based engineers. You will also work closely with colleagues in our AI/ML and Application Development practices.



What you'll be doing:

  • Lead the technical delivery of complex, high-impact migration and modernization engagements, including AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) assessments and mobilization.

  • Lead technical discovery and design multi-service, cloud-native AWS architectures that turn business goals into scalable blueprints.

  • Technically lead teams of 1â4 engineers, and manage the technical roadmap of 2â3 engagements in parallel.

  • Own technical design decisions within project scope. Resolve technical disagreements and handle scope conversations with clients professionally.

  • Represent Client in customers sessions, including executive-level conversations and joint sessions with AWS stakeholders.

  • Spend around 25% of your time on pre-sales: discovery, solution design and co-selling with AWS account teams in North America.

  • Resolve high-risk technical blockers and escalations, including critical production incidents.

  • Adapt to changing delivery expectations and keep engagements on track under uncertainty.

  • Build architectural guardrails, reusable frameworks and components that raise quality across the practice.

  • Coach engineers and share knowledge through internal sessions, workshops, whitepapers and technical evangelism.

  • Be the go-to expert in one or more domains, such as MSSQL Server, PostgreSQL, EKS, VMware, data, security or networking.

  • Help shape our technical offerings and accelerators in line with market and AWS trends.



What you bring:

  • 8+ years in infrastructure or cloud engineering, including 5+ years designing and delivering on AWS.

  • A proven track record of leading at least two large-scale cloud migrations end to end.

  • Hands-on database migration experience with MSSQL Server, Oracle or PostgreSQL.

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect â Professional.

  • In-depth knowledge of core AWS services, including:

    • Compute and containers: EC2, Lambda, ECS, EKS

    • Storage and databases: S3, RDS, EFS, EBS

    • Networking and integration: VPC, API Gateway, CloudFront, SNS, SQS

    • Security: IAM, Security Hub, GuardDuty, KMS, AWS Private CA

    • Operations and migration: CloudWatch, AWS Application Migration Service

  • Strong Infrastructure as Code skills. Terraform is preferred; CloudFormation, AWS CDK or Ansible are also welcome.

  • Hands-on experience building and running CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, GitLab, Bitbucket or similar.

  • Experience running containerized workloads with Docker and Kubernetes or EKS.

  • Strong networking knowledge: TCP/IP, DNS, load balancers, firewalls and VPN, plus AWS networking services such as VPC, Route 53, ELB and CloudFront.

  • Strong security knowledge: IAM, least privilege, access control, endpoint security and data encryption.

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. You are confident with executives and engineering teams alike.

  • Comfort working in a distributed team, with a few hours of daily overlap with Central European Time.

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.


Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with AWS MAP phases: Assess, Mobilize, and Migrate & Modernize.

  • Migrations from VMware, on-premises data centers, Azure or GCP.

  • Experience with AI-assisted migration and modernization tooling, such as AWS Transform.

  • AWS Specialty certifications, such as Security or Advanced Networking.

jobs.title: Marketing Koordinator til MyCruise (barselsvikariat)
jobs.description:
Er du struktureret, initiativrig og god til at holde mange bolde i luften? 

Brænder du for marketing, og trives du med at skabe overblik, koordinere kampagner og få mennesker til at arbejde godt sammen? 

Hos MyCruise søger vi en Marketing Koordinator til vores marketingteam på hovedkontoret i Vanløse. 

Stillingen er et 9-måneders barselsvikariat med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse. 

Som Marketing Koordinator får du en central rolle i at koordinere vores marketingaktiviteter på tværs af Danmark, Norge, Sverige og UK. 

Du bliver bindeleddet mellem vores kampagneansvarlige, lokale salgsteams og specialister inden for blandt andet paid media, sociale medier, nyhedsbreve, grafisk produktion og e-commerce. 

Din vigtigste opgave bliver at skabe struktur, sikre fremdrift og sørge for, at vores kampagner og marketingaktiviteter bliver gennemført til tiden og i høj kvalitet. 

Du bliver en del af et marketingteam med mange forskellige opgaver, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen, hjælper hinanden og har plads til både gode idéer og godt humør. 

Om jobbet 

Du får en varieret hverdag, hvor du er med til at sikre, at vores marketingkampagner hænger sammen på tværs af kanaler og markeder. 

Du kommer blandt andet til at: 

  • Koordinere marketingkampagner på tværs af teams, kanaler og samarbejdspartnere. 

  • Omsætte kampagnebriefs til konkrete opgaver og holde styr på deadlines, materialer og leverancer. 

  • Sikre tæt dialog mellem marketing og de lokale salgsteams om behov og kampagner. 

  • Koordinere versionering, oversættelser og lokal tilpasning af nyhedsbreve og øvrigt marketingmateriale. 

  • Assistere med tekstforfatning, korrektur, nyhedsbreve og lettere indholdsopgaver. 

  • Koordinere indhold og materialer til websites, sociale medier og annoncering. 

  • Hjælpe med dokumentation og afrapportering af partnerkampagner. 

  • Indsamle kampagneresultater og bidrage til evaluering og forbedring af kommende aktiviteter. 

  • Bidrage med idéer og praktisk hjælp til øvrige marketingaktiviteter efter behov. 

Du får selvstændigt ansvar for den daglige koordinering, men arbejder tæt sammen med vores kampagneansvarlige om prioriteringer, budgetter og timing. 

Du skal ikke kunne producere alt selv. Det vigtigste er, at du kan skabe overblik, følge op og sikre, at de rette mennesker har, hvad de skal bruge for at komme i mål. 

 

Vi forestiller os, at du: 

  • Har en god forståelse for marketing, er naturligt struktureret og trives med en hverdag, hvor der sker mange ting.  

  • Gerne har 2-3 års erfaring fra en koordinatorrolle i en marketingafdeling, et digitalt bureau, reklamebureau eller lignende. 

  • Har en relevant uddannelse inden for marketing, kommunikation eller tilsvarende. 

  • Har en god forståelse for digital marketing, herunder sociale medier, nyhedsbreve, annoncering og websites. 

  • Har erfaring med eller kendskab til projektstyringsværktøjer som Asana, Monday.com eller lignende. 

  • Har gode skriftlige kommunikationsevner og flair for kommercielt indhold.

Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, tager initiativ og motiveres af at skabe struktur og gode resultater sammen med andre. 

Hvem er MyCruise? 

MyCruise er et af Skandinaviens førende specialiserede krydstogtsrejsebureauer. Vi samarbejder med en lang række af verdens største krydstogtsrederier og hjælper hvert år vores kunder med at finde den helt rigtige rejse. 

Vi sælger både klassiske ocean cruises, Exclusive cruises og River cruises. 

Vi har kontorer i Danmark, Norge, Sverige og Storbritannien, mens vores danske hovedkontor ligger i Vanløse. Her arbejder marketing tæt sammen med blandt andet salg, produkt og e-commerce om at inspirere vores kunder og skabe gode rejseoplevelser. 

Vi er i vækst og har store ambitioner for de kommende år. Derfor leder vi efter mennesker, der har lyst til at udvikle sig sammen med os. 

Hvad tilbyder vi? 

  • En spændende og alsidig marketingrolle med mulighed for at gøre en forskel. 

  • Tæt samarbejde med engagerede kolleger på tværs af vores fire markeder. 

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling. 

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med marketing i en branche, hvor vi sælger oplevelser og rejser. 

  • Personalepriser på rejser. 

  • Pension og sundhedsordning. 

  • Frokostordning, frugt, kaffe og sodavand. 

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og engagerede kolleger. 

  • En organisation med korte beslutningsveje og plads til nye idéer. 

  • Arbejdsplads på vores hovedkontor i Vanløse tæt på metro og S-tog. 

Lyder det som dig? 

Send dit CV og din ansøgning til job@mycruise.dk 

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat. 

Stillingen er et barselsvikariat på 9 måneder med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse. Vi ønsker opstart hurtigst muligt, og arbejdsstedet er vores hovedkontor i Vanløse.

jobs.title: Senior Assigned Support Engineer-(Designated / Premier Support)
Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: Join Beneq as an Electrical Engineer – Shape the Future of ALD Research Tools!Many breakthroughs in materials science, energy and microelectronics begin in a research lab, on an Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) tool. Those tools have to be flexible, safe and electrically reliable. At Beneq, we build them.Were looking for an Electrical Engineer to join the TFS product team in our Advanced ALD Business Unit. Youll take designs from schematics and customer-specific modifications all the way to certified, fully documented deliveries, working closely with mechanical and automation engineers along the way.As a global leader in ALD solutions, Beneq offers the opportunity to work on technology that enables the next generation of thin film innovation. Many of our deliveries include customer-specific configurations, so youll regularly solve new design challenges. Youll also see the direct impact of your work on equipment used at the forefront of science.If youre an Electrical Engineer who enjoys variety, thrives in cross-disciplinary collaboration and is always looking for ways to make things work better, wed love to hear from you.Your Key Responsibilities * Design, develop and maintain electrical structures, schematics and related documents for Beneqs TFS ALD equipment. * Prepare product purchase structures for customer deliveries and design customer-specific modifications. * Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards (CE, UL) and related requirements. * Support certification processes and maintain the technical documentation needed for regulatory compliance. * Work with software/automation and mechanical engineers to ensure seamless system integration. * Support internal teams on electrical performance questions, both in TFS and across other Advanced ALD product teams. * Identify opportunities for efficiency improvements and new technology adoption, and contribute to new product development.What Were Looking For * 3+ years in electrical system design, including low-voltage and high-power systems. Close-but-not-exact experience is worth a conversation. * A Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field. * Proficiency in EPLAN and AutoCAD or a similar electrical design tool. * Working knowledge of electrical safety and CE, UL, EMI/EMC and IEC certification requirements. * Familiarity with PLC systems, especially Siemens S7. * Understanding of functional safety systems in relation to electrical design. * A detail-oriented, quality-focused approach, plus strong problem-solving, collaboration and communication skills.Bonus Skills That Set You Apart * Qualification for conducting electrical installations. * Experience in thin film processing equipment (ALD, PVD, CVD or PECVD). * Knowledge of ERP and PDM systems such as SAP and Aton.Why Join Beneq?Youll work with one of the worlds top ALD teams at the forefront of thin film innovation. Our environment is collaborative and supportive, and the hierarchy is flat enough that your work is visible. We offer a competitive salary, strong work-life balance, and opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning in a high-tech, international company.How to ApplyAre you ready to take the next step in your career? Submit your application and CV by 19.11. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we may start the interview process during the application period.For more information, feel free to contact Jan-Erik Kari, Engineering Manager 0407618584, Fridays 6th and 13th 10.00-11.00.Beneq is the home of atomic layer deposition. Our mission is to be dedicated to the success of the More-than-Moore device makers by delivering best in class, innovative, and flexible ALD equipment and service solutions. In 1984, we established the worlds first industrial production using ALD. Today, we lead the market with products for semiconductor device fabrication, R&D, and varied ALD solutions. We operate globally and employ 170+ people on three continents. We are a unique employer that combines the hands-on, dynamic mindset of a fast-growth startup with the solid funding and resources of a larger enterprise. Beneqs team of engineers and experts are committed to delivering world class ALD solutions and enabling technology mega trends through advanced solutions. Beneq is headquartered in Finland with legal entities in the USA and Japan.

jobs.title: Vuokravälittäjä Helsinki
jobs.description: Haemme nyt Helsinkiin vuokravälittäjää. Meiltä löytyy runsaasti toimeksiantoja täyttämään uudenkin välittäjän työpäiviä. Toivomme, että sinulla on aiempaa kokemusta asuntojen vuokrauksesta ja/tai asuntosijoittamisesta. Tarjoamme sinulle paikan kasvavassa organisaatiossa, jossa pääset itse vaikuttamaan omaan työhösi. Saat meiltä hyvät työkalut ja tuen, joiden avulla menestyt työssäsi.Etsimämme henkilö on motivoitunut ja positiivinen tiimipelaaja, joka osaa tuottaa laadukkaan asiakaskokemuksen. Osaat aikatauluttaa omaa työtäsi ja työskentelet tarkalla otteella. Pystyt tarvittaessa palvelemaan asiakkaita myös englanniksi. Koska suunnittelet työpäiviesi aikataulun pitkälti itse, toivomme sinulta myös joustavuutta. Ajokortti ja oma auto ovat tässä työssä välttämättömiä.Teemme välitystyötä modernisti ja suunnitelmallisesti, ja kehitämme toimintaamme jatkuvasti. Toivomme, että osaat ja haluat hyödyntää digitaalisia työkaluja, järjestelmiä ja sosiaalista mediaa.Rennossa ja ammattitaitoisessa työyhteisössämme on helppo viihtyä, ja työkavereilta saa aina apua tarvittaessa. Tarjoamme joustavan työajan ja kannustavan provisiopalkkauksen. Korvaamme myös oman auton käytöstä syntyvät kilometrit. Työ on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen.**Hakuaika on 30.10.–12.11.2026**, ja käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana. Aloitusajankohdasta sovitaan erikseen. Tehtävään valitun henkilön luottotiedot tarkistetaan.Lähetä CV ja hakemus viimeistään 12.11.2026 osoitteeseen erika.hilden@asuntopehtoori.fi otsikolla **Vuokravälittäjän rekry Helsinki**.**Kysy tehtävästä lisää:** Erika Hildén, tiimipäällikkö, erika.hilden@asuntopehtoori.fi, p. 044 493 5380

jobs.title: Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
jobs.description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing Department of Food Science Faculty of Science University of Copenhagen The Department of Food Science (FOOD), Faculty of Science (SCIENCE), University of Copenhagen (UCPH) invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor in Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. The research areas of FOOD have a shared mission to contribute to new pathways for society and industry to support the development of solutions based in biology to improve sustainable food production, food security and food safety. FOOD is recognized for excellence in food research, education and industrial collaboration. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. FOOD has the ambition to reinforce our teaching and research in designing and optimizing biology-based solutions as future sustainable food and ingredient technologies. UCPH is strengthening this area by offering the new MSc Biosolutions program in Kalundborg, Denmark, the largest bio-based manufacturing hub in Scandinavia, home to large fermentation-based manufacturers, and a vibrant innovation environment. The candidate for this position is expected to significantly contribute to this new Biosolutions initiative. The aim of the position is to explore the production and use of new solutions based on both biology and engineering addressing sustainability challenges inherent in food systems today. Although we welcome a diverse range of applicants, the focus of the position will be processing in relation to biochemically based solutions and could include the following disciplines:
  • Food process technology, ideally with an emphasis on fermentation & downstream processing
  • Food process system engineering
  • Use of sensor technologies such as in-line or at line spectroscopic tools
  • Large-data, modelling and prediction of food and ingredient processes.
  • Understanding of biological production systems and their use, and with an emphasis on downstream processing
A central part of the activities anchored to this position will be taking place in Campus Kalundborg, and it is crucial that the candidate is able to leverage the local ecosystem to foster strong collaboration with industry. Qualifications are expected in the following areas:
  • A collaborative and innovative mindset
  • Documented scientific impact and outreach in past research work
  • A proven track record in attracting external funding at both national and international level
  • Experience with international collaborations
  • Ability to establish industrial collaboration
  • Excellent interpersonal and communicative skills
Tenure-track assistant professor The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations regarding publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Ingredient Biochemical Processing. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties. The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact. Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered. Associate professor Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required. The candidate must be an inspiring teacher with a vision on teaching development, especially in connection with the new MSc Biosolutions program. A new campus with research and teaching facilities is currently being built in Kalundborg and the candidate is expected to contribute to setting up the facilities Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department. Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered. University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement. Please read more here For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf For associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdf Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here The tenure-track assistant programme The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures. Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields. After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen. Salary and employment conditions The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff. Employment is as either tenure track assistant professor or associate professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish). The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background. The Professor will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing. Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk). Filing of application The position may be applied for at the tenure-track assistant professor level or associate professor level. Please note that it is possible to apply at more than one level. If applied at more than one level, separate applications must be submitted (see below). The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below. Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include
  • Curriculum vitae including:
    • Please describe and document international network and relations
    • Please describe and document internationally based activities
    • Positions held at universities/research institutions outside Denmark
    • Outreach activities, i.e. popular lectures or other activities in the media
    • Grants held, personal or in part. Career development grants.
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan - description of current and future research plans
  • If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document:
    • Experience with supervision of BSc and MSc students
    • Teaching experience
    • Formal pedagogical training
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers
Applying for the associate professorship please include
  • Curriculum vitae including information about external funding
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans
  • Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers
The deadline for applications is 3 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1. After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/. Interviews will be held on 8 March 2027. Please refer to the following no. in future communication in this case: 211-0263/26-2N, Tenure-track Assistant Professor Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. 211-0760/26-2E, Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing.

jobs.title: Tenure Track assistant professor, associate professor or professor of Food Processing & Technology
jobs.description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor, Associate Professor or Full Professor of Food Processing & Technology Department of Food Science Faculty of Science University of Copenhagen The Department of Food Science, Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor, Associate Professor or Full Professor in Food Processing and Technology. Applicants must be capable of, and interested in, conducting and developing basic and applied interdisciplinary research of high international standard in the field of food processing and technology. The position will involve extensive collaborations within the department and with national and international academic groups and industrial partners. Research within the Department has a mission to unearth new solutions for society and industry to support sustainable food production, food security and safety as well as production of high-quality food promoting human health and wellbeing. The Department of Food Science is recognized for excellence in food research, education, and industrial collaborations. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. We encourage applications from a range of disciplines within the food science and technology area, ideally covering the understanding of food macromolecular interactions on a mechanistic level, how processing and formulation affect or determine these interactions, and how this influences final product quality with focus on functional properties. We are seeking a candidate who will establish an internationally leading research program, and we encourage a diverse range of applicants whose work may center on one or more of the following disciplines:
  • Developing a mechanistic understanding of interactions of food macromolecules in complex matrices during processing or formulation spanning dairy, plant, and single-cell protein sources.
  • How this knowledge can be used in the rational design of functional ingredients and healthy foods using established and emerging processing technologies
  • Development and utilization of high throughput methods for characterizing and quantifying the physicochemical behavior of food macromolecules in complex matrices.
  • Modelling and the use of machine learning/AI for simulation and prediction of the outcome of process unit operations on food and ingredient functionality.
  • Formulation and fluid dynamics of complex emulsions and the mechanisms governing this.
In addition, it is expected that this position will be involved in a significant amount of collaboration with industry, and therefore it is expected that the successful candidate has a documented successful track record in industry collaboration and working with innovation-oriented research. Furthermore, we expect that the successful candidate has a genuine interest in leadership and the wellbeing and development of their group. Tenure-track assistant professor The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations with regards to publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within the Tenure Track Assistant Professorship. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties. The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact. Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered. Associate professor and full professor Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required. In particular, the candidate must actively contribute with research-based teaching on the BSc in Food Science and Nutrition, and the MSc in Food Science and Technology programs, with an emphasis on the specialization in Dairy Science and Technology. Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department. Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship and full professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered. University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor / professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement. Please read more here: For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf For associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdf For professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5c_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-professors.pdf Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here The tenure-track assistant programme The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures. Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields. After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen. Salary and employment conditions The position is open from 1 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff. Employment is either as tenure track assistant professor, associate professor or professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish). This position comes with an opportunity to negotiate a start package that will help leverage the candidate’s scientific deliverables in the initial years of employment. The negotiation for the start package takes place as part of the recruitment process. Please read about the contents of the programme and conditions, as well as UCPH’s extensive support for international researchers, here Start package programme – University of Copenhagen . The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background. The successful candidate will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing. The section has extensive collaborations on research projects with major food industries in both Denmark and abroad. Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk). Filing of application The position may be applied for at the tenure-track assistant professor level, associate professor level or full professor level. Please note that it is possible to apply at more than one level. If applied at more than one level, separate applications must be submitted (see below). The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below. Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include
  • Curriculum vitae including:
    • Please describe and document international network and relations
    • Please describe and document internationally based activities
    • Positions held at universities/research institutions outside Denmark
    • Outreach activities, i.e. popular lectures or other activities in the media
    • Grants held, personal or in part. Career development grants.
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan - description of current and future research plans
  • If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document:
    • Experience with supervision of BSc and MSc students
    • Teaching experience
    • Formal pedagogical training
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers
Applying for the associate professorship or full professorship please include
  • Curriculum vitae including information about external funding
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans
  • Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers
The deadline for applications is 3 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1. After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/ Interviews will be held on 25 February 2027. Please refer to the following no. in future communication in this case: 211-0262/26-2N, Tenure-track Assistant Professor of Food Processing & Technology. 211-0759/26-2E, Associate Professor of Food Processing & Technology. 211-0366/26-2K, Professor of Food Processing & Technology.

jobs.title: Senior ERP Transformation Lead - IFS Cloud
jobs.description:
Our client is seeking a highly experienced Senior ERP Transformation Lead to lead a large-scale business and ERP modernization initiative for a major Nordic enterprise.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

This is a high-impact leadership assignment with direct exposure to executive stakeholders and responsibility for driving a complex transformation from legacy IFS environments to IFS Cloud. The role goes far beyond traditional project management and requires someone who can effectively lead change, influence senior decisionmakers, and build alignment across both business and technology organizations.

Youll take ownership of a strategic transformation program covering several core business functions, including:
 Finance
 Human Resources
 Procurement & Supplier Management
 Enterprise-wide business processes and supporting platforms

The objective is not only to modernize the ERP landscape, but also to transform business processes, governance models, and ways of working across multiple countries and stakeholder groups.

Key Responsibilities:
 Lead a complex ERP transformation program end-to-end
 Drive migration from legacy IFS to IFS Cloud
 Act as the bridge between business and technology teams
 Engage and influence senior stakeholders, including C-level executives
 Establish governance, alignment, and decision-making across the organization
 Lead change management and business transformation activities

Requirements:
 Proven experience leading large-scale ERP transformation programs
Strong IFS / IFS Cloud transformation experience
 Background in business transformation and organizational change
 Experience working directly with executive stakeholders
 Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills
 Experience in multinational and complex business environments

Ideal Profile:
You are a senior transformation leader who combines ERP expertise with strong executive presence and the ability to build alignment, challenge stakeholders, and drive change across business and IT functions.

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Have you led an ERP transformation involving IFS or IFS Cloud?*
- Have you worked directly with CIO, CFO, or other C-level stakeholders?*
- Have you led business transformation alongside technology implementation?*
- Have you managed stakeholders across multiple countries or business units?*

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role. 

Start: ASAP
Location: Finland
Allocation: Full-time 100 %

Languages: English required, Finnish preferred

We offer you: We offer a versatile assignment where every day is different and interesting. We also offer a very competitive salary and good employee benefits.

Are you interested in becoming a part of our dynamic team? The position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found, so please be quick and submit your application! 

Please include your salary expectation in your application. For more information, contact Kimmo Kärsämä, tel. 050 412 7500, kimmo.karsama@lokki.fi 

Explore Lokki, through our blog and website: https://www.lokki.fi/  .
