jobs.title: Autolakerer søges til en hverdag med variation i Vamdrup
jobs.description:
Har du sans for detaljen og erfaring med afdækning, slibning og lakering? Er du stolt, når en bil forlader kabinen med en flot, ensartet og spejlblank finish? Hos Byens bilpleje.com i Vamdrup søger vi en autolakerer, som arbejder selvstændigt, holder overblikket og har lyst til at indgå i et godt fællesskab.

Om Byens Bilpleje

Byens Bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og er i dag en af Danmarks største aktører inden for kosmetisk klargøring, autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse og udskiftning af autoglas. Hos Byensbilpleje.com håndterer vi mere end 200.000 biler om året og har mere end 400 medarbejdere.

Det kommer du til at arbejde med

Din arbejdsdag byder på klargøring og lakering af biler. Du spartler, sliber og afdækker, udbedrer mindre buler og ridser og udfører sprøjtelakering. Undervejs sikrer du, at kvaliteten er i orden, og at hver opgave bliver afsluttet ordentligt. Du planlægger dine opgaver i samspil med resten af teamet og hjælper med afdelingens øvrige arbejde efter behov.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Ordne buler, spartle, slibe og afdækker (sprøjtelakerer), så bilerne står som nye.
  • Bidrage til at kvaliteten altid er i top.
  • Tage ansvar for egne arbejdsopgaver, og hjælpe resten af teamet, når der er brug for det.
  • Håndtere de øvrige opgaver, der naturligt følger med jobbet som autolakerer.

Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • Har uddannelse eller erfaring som autolakerer.
  • Kan strukturere dine opgaver og tilpasse dig dagens arbejdsflow.
  • Arbejder omhyggeligt og har øje for finish.
  • Tager ansvar og hjælper dine kollegaer.
  • Har kørekort til personbil.
  • Du må også gerne have humor og sætte pris på, at der er plads til en god bemærkning i løbet af dagen.

Hos os får du

Vi tilbyder løn efter kvalifikationer, overenskomst og pension. Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor kvalitet og godt håndværk bliver værdsat. Hos os får du adgang til gode redskaber og kvalitetsprodukter samt mulighed for at udvikle dig både personligt og fagligt. Hverdagen byder på dygtige kollegaer, godt humør og en uformel omgangstone.

Lyder jobbet som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning via www.byensbilpleje.com. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler, og ansætter når vi har fundet den rigtige kollega - dog venter vi selvfølgelig gerne på det rette match.

Grundet GDPR-forordningen modtager vi ikke ansøgninger på mail, hvorfor disse ikke tages i betragtning. Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com.

jobs.title: Autolakerer til Odense - har du øje for den gode finish?
jobs.description:
Et flot resultat begynder med grundigt forarbejde. Hos Byens bilpleje.com i Odense søger vi autolakerer, der sætter en ære i sit håndværk og har blik for detaljerne - fra den første slibning til den sidste kvalitetskontrol. 

Byens bilpleje.com er Danmarks førende virksomhed inden for kosmetisk klargøring af biler; herunder autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse samt udskiftning af autoglas - vi er bilbranchens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Byens bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og beskæftiger i dag over 400 medarbejdere. Herudover håndterer virksomheden mere end 200.000 biler om året.

Fra forarbejde til færdigt resultat

Du bliver en del af vores team af lakspecialister, hvor du arbejder med:

  • Klargøring til lakering, herunder spartling, slibning og afdækning.
  • Udbedring af mindre buler og ridser.
  • Sprøjtelakering og kontrol af det færdige resultat.
  • Planlægning af egne opgaver og koordinering med kollegaerne.
  • Øvrige opgaver i afdelingen, hvor vi hjælper hinanden i mål.

Du kender dit håndværk

Vi leder efter dig der:

  • Er uddannet autolakerer eller har erfaring fra faget. 
  • Går op i kvalitet og finish.
  • Arbejder omhyggeligt og struktureret og kan bevare overblikket, når der er flere biler på vej gennem værkstedet.
  • Bidrager til samarbejdet og den gode stemning.
  • Trives i en hverdag, hvor ingen hverdage er ens.
  • Har kørekort (B).

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer.
  • Gode redskaber og kvalitetsprodukter til rådighed samt mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer. 
  • Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads med dygtige kollegaer, humor og plads til en god snak i pauserne.

Skal du med på holdet?

Vi holder samtaler løbende, da vi ønsker den helt rigtige til vores team, men vi venter selvfølgelig gerne på den rette. Tænker du at jobbet lyder som noget for dig? Så send din ansøgning afsted med det samme.

Grundet GDPR-forordningen modtager vi ikke ansøgninger på mail, hvorfor disse ikke tages i betragtning. Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com.

jobs.title: PhD scholarship in Development of High Temperature Heat Pumps with Thermal Energy Storage - DTU Construct
jobs.description:
Do you want to start your research career by making industrial heat clean, flexible and affordable? At DTU Construct you will work at the forefront of technologies key to decarbonizing industries: high-temperature heat pumps and high-temperature thermal energy storage.We invite applications for a fully funded PhD position in the Thermal Energy Section of the Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at the Technical University of Denmark. The position is part of HeatMinds, a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Network funded by Horizon Europe. HeatMinds brings together 6 universities and research institutes and 12 industrial and research partners across Europe to develop industrial high-temperature heat pumps and thermal energy storage. Your project will develop new Carnot Battery technologies: systems that combine heat pumps based on high temperature thermodynamic cycles together with high-temperature thermal energy storage, such as molten salts and dual-media packed beds. These systems will deliver clean process heat while also giving industry flexibility on the electricity market.Supervision: Prof. Adriano Sciacovelli and Prof. Anders Christiansen Erlandsson with industrial secondments. Responsibilities and qualificationsYour overall goal will be to find out how industrial high temperature heat pumps can benefit from integrated thermal energy storage by developing new cost-effective, high-performance hybrid configurations. You will work with fellow doctoral candidates across the network and with industrial partners in Denmark and abroad.Your main tasks will be:
  • Develop and Design new architectures comprising cycles using natural working fluids and thermal energy storage, optimised for efficiency, cost, and fast response to electricity price signals
  • Carry out multi-objective optimisation and dynamic system analysis of alternative layouts
  • Validate results by carrying out experiments and data comparison during industrial secondments, turning the results into innovations with real-world impact (e.g. patents, future commercial solutions)
  • Publish in international journals, present at conferences and take part in HeatMinds network training, summer schools and outreach.
You have:
  • A solid background in engineering thermodynamics, heat transfer and energy technologies, e.g. conversion or storage systems
  • Familiarity with modelling and numerical simulations, for example for MSc thesis or student projects
  • Programming skills, preferably in Python, Matlab, Modelica or similar
  • Excellent written and spoken English, and the motivation to work in an international, goal-oriented environment.
MSCA eligibility: at the time of recruitment, you must not already hold a doctoral degree. You must also not have resided or carried out your main activities (work, studies, etc) in Denmark for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before your recruitment date.You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.Approval and Enrolment The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. We offerDTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.Salary and appointment termsThe appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures. The PhD salary will be based on the Marie S. Curie compensation scheme conditions and according to the grant agreement. Based on seniority the candidate will receive a minimum of DKK 30.264,08 (base salary) and DKK 1580,90 (PhD supplement). In addition, DTU will also pay pension consisting of 18,07%. Finally, it is possible to apply for family allowance. The period of employment is 3 years. The position is a full-time position. Starting date is anticipated as 1 April 2027, or according to mutual agreement. You can read more about career paths at DTU here.Further informationFurther information may be obtained from Prof. Adriano Sciacovelli, adrsc@dtu.dk and Prof. Anders Christiansen Erlandsson, acerl@dtu.dk. You can read more about Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at www.construct.dtu.dk. If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. Application procedure Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 24 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:
  • A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
  • Curriculum vitae
  • Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
  • A copy of thesis (if available) or other publications (if available)
  • A short critical literature review (max. 3 pages) on high-temperature heat pumps combined with thermal energy storage (e.g. Carnot Batteries): select up to 5 relevant publications and explain your choice, compare their methods & findings, identify possible open research questions, explaining how your background would help you address them. Include at least one figure or table of your own making.
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.DTU Civil and Mechanical Engineering develops and utilises science and technical knowledge for the benefit of society and the sustainable development. We undertake research, education, innovation, and scientific advice of the highest quality within building design and processes, building construction and safety, building energy and technical services, solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, coastal and maritime engineering, materials technology, manufacturing engineering, engineering systems design, design for sustainability, and thermal energy.DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.title: MHPSS Advisor
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) professional with a passion for advancing evidence-based MHPSS practice in humanitarian settings? Danish Red Cross (DRC) is looking for a MHPSS Advisor to provide technical expertise, capacity development, and quality assurance to the Red Cross Red Crescent National Societies (RCRC) National Societies delivering community-based MHPSS interventions in humanitarian settings.

About the position and the assignments  

You will be based at the Danish Red Cross HQ in Copenhagen and will be part of the Health Team in the Technical Quality and Impact Unit of the International Department. The Health Team comprises technical advisors within health and mental health and psychosocial support. It ensures the availability of the necessary technical capacities to provide timely and relevant assistance and advice to DRC-supported operations, with a primary focus on the Africa, while also supporting MHPSS interventions in MENA, Europe and Asia regions as needed.

As a member of the Health Team, you will be working under the line management of the Health Team Lead and will also work closely with other colleagues at the DRC HQ and Regional and Country Offices (COs), as well as with NSs staff and volunteers. You will also collaborate with the colleagues from the International Federation of the Red Cross Red Crescent (IFRC) and the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC). The position does not have programme management responsibilities but supports programmes through technical accompaniment, mentoring, and quality assurance.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

  • Strategic planning and direction: Contribute to defining and rollout of DRC’s strategic directions within MHPSS in humanitarian settings. Support development and rollout of strategies, policies, and technical frameworks for MHPSS in humanitarian settings.
  • Technical support and guidance: Provide evidence-based guidance and advice to DRC COs and National Societies on MHPSS priorities, approaches and activities, remotely or through country visits and missions to ensure that MHPSS interventions follow industry standards and good practice. Support development or adaptation and rollout of relevant technical tools and guidelines to meet operational needs.
  • Strengthening of capacities: Support National Societies in assessing technical capacity needs, and in designing and implementing capacity-strengthening plans, including trainings, coaching, mentoring, and technical supervision. 
  • Program monitoring and evaluation:  Support planning and undertaking of assessments, baselines, endlines, reviews and evaluations, and monitoring of MHPSS interventions.
  • Advocacy: In close collaboration with relevant humanitarian diplomacy (HD) colleagues, contribute to DRC’s policy influencing, advocacy and HD efforts on MHPSS in humanitarian settings.
  • Resource mobilisation: Support proposal development by contributing to the design and quality assurance of MHPSS components in the project proposals that align with donor requirements and organisational goals and priorities.
  • Partnerships and collaboration: Foster thematic partnerships and joint MHPSS initiatives within the RCRC Movement and with external stakeholders. 
  • Surge deployments: Undertake MHPSS surge/deployments in support of DRC bi-lateral operations and wider RCRC Movement responses, including multilateral deployments with the ICRC and the IFRC.  

 

Your profile

We are looking for an experienced MHPSS professional with at least five years of experience working on community-based MNHPSS with humanitarian and development organisations, including at least three years in international postings in Africa and MENA regions. You hold a master's degree, or equivalent experience, in MHPSS, social sciences, or another relevant field. You have sound technical, strategy and advisory skills within community-based MHPSS in humanitarian settings and migration. You have proven experience developing and adapting technical guidance, tools and training materials, as well as designing and facilitating capacity-development initiatives for staff and volunteers of partner organisations. 

You have experience supporting assessments, technical reviews, evaluations, and the development of quality assurance processes for community-based MHPSS interventions. You are an excellent facilitator and communicator with strong interpersonal and cross-cultural skills. You work collaboratively, are well organised, and are able to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines. You are willing and able to undertake field missions, including emergency deployments, with travel of up to four months per year. Professional working proficiency in both English and French is required. Experience of working for the International RCRC Movement is considered an asset. 

We offer

A job with an opportunity to improve the lives of the most vulnerable people around the world. We further offer a unique opportunity to influence the strategic development and mainstreaming of MHPSS in humanitarian settings.

The position is a full-time position - 37 working hours per week. The position is 12 months with possibility for extension.

Salary and employment conditions are in accordance with Danish Red Cross’s collective bargaining agreement with HK and AC, depending on experience and qualifications. The position is based at the Danish Red Cross headquarters in Copenhagen and requires on-site presence. As this is a national position based in Denmark, the salary package does not include relocation assistance to Denmark and housing or family-related allowances.

Your future workplace

The International Red Cross and Red Crescent network is the largest humanitarian network in the world, with a presence and activities in almost every country. All Red Cross and Red Crescent activities have one central purpose: to help those who suffer, without discrimination, whether during conflict, in response to natural or man-made disasters, or due to conditions of chronic poverty. Our work is guided by seven fundamental principles: humanity, impartiality, independence, voluntary service, unity, and universality. 

DRC’s international department’s approx. 300 staff supporting RCRC NSs with planning and implementing humanitarian and development interventions in some of the most challenging contexts in 20 countries across Africa, MENA, Asia, and Europe.

We offer a meaningful work at a purpose-driven workplace with truly engaged colleagues. We focus on professional challenges, well-being and a flexible organising of your work life. All of us contribute to a great work environment and colleagueship. 

 

Application and further information

For any specific questions about the position, please contact us at zesd@rodekors.dk subject “MHPSS Advisor 2026”.

Interviews will take place in the second part of November with an expected start date as soon as possible and no later than 01 January 2027. 

We look forward to receiving your application and CV no later than 18 November 2026. Application and CV in English are accepted only through our online recruitment system. Applications made by email will not be reviewed.

jobs.title: Brøndby PPR søger psykologer til en fast stilling og et barselsvikariat
jobs.description:
Brøndby PPR søger psykologer til en fast stilling og et barselsvikariat

I PPR Brøndby søger vi to psykologer – en til en fast stilling og en til et barselsvikariat. Vi har bl.a. fået flere ressourcer til samarbejdet med Heldagstilbuddet Nørregård, som er Brøndby kommunes vidtgående specialiseret skole- og fritidstilbud for børn med autismespektrumsforstyrrelser og betydelige funktionsnedsættelser.

I PPR Brøndby er vi optagede af at bidrage til at skabe afgørende positive forandringer for børn og unge i deres udviklingsmiljøer og fællesskaber. Det gør vi både via vores arbejde med de ”traditionelle” PPR-opgaver og vores nye indsatser, der for psykologgruppens del bl.a. omfatter NUSSA, supervision i dagtilbud/skole og Diamantforløb. Udover dette er det psykologerne i PPR, der varetager en stor del af opgaverne inden for vores lettilgængelige behandlingstilbud. I tillæg til dette er vi vilde med prøvehandlinger, som vi løbende sætter i gang i og på tværs af faggrupperne. I PPR Brøndby er kulturen præget af nysgerrighed, faglige drøftelser og engagement. Hvis du kan se dig selv ind i det, så vil vi elske at byde dig velkommen fra d. 1. januar 2027

Lidt om, hvad du træder ind i

Det er vigtigt for os at være relevante samarbejdspartnere for såvel børn, unge og deres familier som for fagprofessionelle på området. Vi har derfor fokus på at gøre en reel forskel tæt på hverdagen og i praksis. Det gør vi med afsæt i høj faglighed, gode samarbejdsvaner, kreative løsninger samt blik og omsorg for den situation og kompleksitet, som både børn, unge, familier og eksterne kolleger står i.

For at understøtte et højt fagligt niveau har vi bl.a. regelmæssig ekstern supervision for alle psykologer og specialpædagogiske vejledere samt særligt tilrettelagte supervisionsforløb for psykologer under autorisation. Derudover er der løbende muligheder for at deltager på konferencer og kurser. 

Som ny medarbejder kan du forvente et godt introduktionsforløb, så du føler dig klædt på til at træde ud i opgaverne der venter – uanset, om du kommer med meget eller lidt erfaring. Derudover får du også tilknyttet en mentor ifm. din opstart. Derudover er både psykologfaglig koordinator, teamleder og PPR-leder alle psykologer med flere års erfaring fra PPR. 

Hvad ligger der i jobbet?

Du kommer til at indgå i tværfaglige såvel som selvstændige opgaver. Vi har opgaver både på almen- og specialområdet og samarbejder om alle børn dækkende gruppen 0-18-årige i kommunen og der er bl.a. også mulighed for at understøtte samarbejdet omkring meget funktionsnedsatte børn. I alle disse opgaver indgår sparring og rådgivning til pædagoger, lærere og ledelse, inddragelse af forældre, psykologiske undersøgelser (herunder test og observationer), og hvad du ellers fagligt vurderer vil kunne understøtte børn og unges udvikling, læring og trivsel. Der arbejdes i vid udstrækning med at understøtte de voksne i netværket omkring barnet/den unge, ligesom vi har et skærpet fokus på ikke at se barnet/den unge isoleret fra dets kontekst, men rette indsatser mod barnet/den unges undervisnings- og læringsmiljø. 

Brøndby kommunes lettilgængelige behandling varetages primært af psykologer i PPR og psykologerne i PPR også varetager kommunens krisestøtte til børn og unge, hvorfor dette også kan være en af dine opgaver. Det er væsentligt for os at sammensætte en opgaveportefølje, der giver mening både for den enkelte men også for den samlede opgaveløsning. 

Din profil

Vi håber at se din ansøgning, hvis du kan genkende dig selv i profilen:

  • Er uddannet psykolog og gerne autoriseret/med praksisuddannelse.
  • Er nyuddannet psykolog med mod på PPR-området.
  • Har erfaring med PPR eller andre aspekter af børne-/ungeområdet. 
  • Står godt i din psykologfaglighed og forstår at anvende den til at formidle, inspirere og inddrage andre i deres arbejde omkring børn, unge og fællesskaber – til tider med afsæt i psykologiske vurderinger, men langt overvejende i din psykologfaglige sparring og inspiration.
  • Arbejder og samarbejder både fleksibelt og målrettet med afsæt såvel det at være PPR-medarbejder og det at være psykolog. 
  • Forstår at navigere i den kompleksitet, som ofte præger opgaver i PPR. Du holder modet oppe og pulsen nede. 
  • Har gode erfaringer med mødeledelse og blik for positioneringer i kommunikationen – både for dig selv og for andre.
  • Er indstillet på, i en ånd af dialog, at lade dig udfordre både i din praksis og dine tanker/ideer – ligesom du er generøs med din viden og positivt bidragende til den fælles opgave med at skabe høj faglighed, godt kollegaskab og god trivsel.
  • Arbejder samskabende og forebyggende sammen med de voksne, der omgiver børn og unge.
  • Har erfaring for at arbejde med målgruppen for heldagstilbuddet Nørregård.

Kort om PPR Brøndby 

PPR’s arbejde har afsæt i en systemisk, kontekstuel og relationel forståelse af børn og unges adfærd, trivsel, oplevelser og muligheder for udvikling og deltagelse. PPR er en enhed under Børne-, Kultur- og Idrætsforvaltningen i Brøndby kommune. PPR understøtter Brøndby Kommunes Strategi 2030 og Sammenhængende Børne- og Ungepolitik, herunder det fælles børnesyn som lyder:

”Børn og unge gør det bedste, de kan, med de kompetencer, de har. Det er de voksnes ansvar at inddrage børn og unge i positive fællesskaber og læringsmiljøer med lige adgang til at udfolde og udvikle sig og trives”.

PPR Brøndby udgøres aktuelt af 6 sansemotoriske terapeuter, 9 specialpædagogiske vejledere, 14 logopæder, 19 psykologer, 3 administrative medarbejdere, 4 fagkoordinatorer, 2 teamledere og 1 PPR-leder. 

Du kan læse mere om PPR på https://www.brondby.dk/Borger/Familie-og-boern/Skole/Saerlig-stoette/PaedagogiskPsykologiskRaadgivning.aspx

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst.

Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt, eller ned til 32 timer hvis du ønsker det.

 

Yderligere information:

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte os. Teamleder, Trine Bornhøft kan kontaktes på tlf. 23 71 21 92. TR, Christian Lau Godskesen kan kontaktes på tlf. 92 43 25 14.

PPR har til huse på Brøndby Rådhus, Park Alle, 2605 Brøndby samt på distriktskontorer i kommunen, men vores opgaver løses primært ude på Brøndby kommunes skoler og dagtilbud. I forbindelse med ansættelse vil der blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest. I forbindelse med ansættelse vil der blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest.

Her kan du uploade din ansøgning og CV samt evt. relevant dokumentation. Alle interesserede ansøgere uanset alder, køn, handicap, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold opfordres til at søge stillingen.I Brøndby Kommune er der en generel politik om, at nyansatte skal forevise straffeattest. Ved beskæftigelse og direkte kontakt med børn under 15 år, indhentes der også en børneattest.Brøndby Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Brøndby er en centralt beliggende hovedstadskommune med cirka 40.000 indbyggere. jobs.title: Gram Equipment Graduate Program
jobs.description:
Unleash your potential in the Gram Equipment Graduate talent program - Experience hands-on learning in real business settings, open doors to global career opportunities, and join a community of change-makers!

About Us:

Gram Equipment is a global leader in providing innovative solutions for the ice cream and dairy industry. We are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology and driving forward the future of our industry. As part of our commitment to nurturing talent and fostering excellence, we are excited to announce our Graduate Program, designed to provide an immersive experience for aspiring professionals who are passionate about both mechanical engineering and commercial business.

Program Overview:

Our Graduate Program offers a unique opportunity for candidates with diverse backgrounds to gain a well-rounded experience in our organization. The program spans a duration of 24 months, divided into four rotations of six months each. This structure ensures that participants gain a comprehensive understanding of both mechanical engineering and commercial aspects of our business.

Qualifications:

We are seeking candidates who have or will graduate either in 2026 or in 2027, and who meet the following criteria:

  • Mechanical Engineering Background with Commercial Interest:

Candidates with a mechanical engineering background who possess a strong interest in commercial business and project management.

  • Commercial Engineering Background with Mechanical Engineering Interest:

Candidates with a commercial/business-oriented Engineering background who are keen to explore the world of mechanical engineering.

Key Program Highlights:

  • Mentorship: Participants will have the opportunity to work closely with a personal mentor from our global management team, offering valuable insights and guidance throughout the program.
  • Continuous Development: Gram Equipment is committed to fostering the growth and development of its talent. Participants will have access to the Gram Academy, a platform dedicated to ongoing learning and skill development.
  • International Rotation: Possibility for an international 6 month rotation in either our Turkish or US location.
  • Community Building: Join a vibrant and peer -based community of talented individuals within our organization, creating opportunities for networking, knowledge sharing, and collaboration.

How to Apply & Our Recruitment Process:

Our recruitment process is designed to identify and nurture potential talent. We believe in comprehensive evaluation, from video interviews and cognitive assessments to in-depth interviews and real-world business case evaluations during the Assessment Day, ensuring we welcome the best fit for our Graduate Program.

  1. Application and Assessment: Apply before 1st of March 2027, and if shortlisted, you'll complete a video interview and cognitive assessment.
  2. Interview and Evaluation: Promising candidates proceed to a comprehensive evaluation phase, which evaluates their behavioral competencies and business acumen, including a detailed assessment of a business case.
  3. Contract and Start Date: Upon impressing us at every stage, you'll sign a contract and officially begin your journey with the Gram Equipment Graduate Program on 1st of September 2027.

Join Us in Shaping the Future:

At Gram Equipment, we believe that innovation is driven by diverse perspectives and talents. Join our Graduate Program to embark on a journey that will equip you with the skills, knowledge, and experiences needed to excel in both the mechanical engineering and commercial aspects of our dynamic industry.

We look forward to welcoming the next generation of leaders to our team.

“For me, the biggest value being part of the Gram Equipment Graduate Program has been the people I have worked with along the way and the understanding I have gained of how the different parts of the organization come together.”Tommy Bui (ENG Integrated Design - SDU) - Project Manager at Gram Equipment

“The Graduate program gave me a strong network across the entire company and useful insights into many of our internal processes.” / “Contributing to such a significant change as a graduate was both empowering and a clear example of how my work could make a meaningful difference.”Luciana Apachitei (ENG in Global Business Engineering - VIA University College) - Engineering Excellence Project Manager "At Gram Equipment, I have shaped the company's direction and the projects related to it. I have had the chance to choose the projects that interested me. Many of the things I have learned in my studies, I have been able to apply to what I am doing at Gram Equipment, from engineering work to business understanding. I am actively involved in the strategy work, engineering practices and various digitalization tools. I use a lot of theoretical knowledge that I have acquired in my Engineering studies in relation to my daily work. My business background helped me understand how the business is working, and because the company foundation is at the technical aspect, my background has helped me identify its strengths and weaknesses very fast." -Rudy Mandrup Cazelles (ENG Product Development and Innovation - SDU) - Business Developer at Gram Equipment

Gram Equipment is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Store Design Associate
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Associate Store Designer supports our franchise expansion from an own HQ point of view by delivering high-quality, on-brand store designs through structured processes and strong governance. The role ensures all projects meet global design standards, timelines, and approval requirements, while maintaining full documentation and alignment between design intent and final build.

The job is a full-time role. We expect the start date to be 1st of December.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee 3rd party designers and ensure design packages aligned with Design Manual and Design Hardgates.

  • Review and acknowledge project kick-offs.

  • Maintain design timelines and update project trackers.

  • Safeguard design compliance with design manuals, materials, and concept standards.

  • Manage design documentation to internal platforms.

  • Support external designers and franchise partners to ensure correct implementation.

  • Assist with design audits and ensure alignment between design and final store outcome.

  • Contribute to maintaining and improving design manuals, tools, and processes.

WHO YOU ARE

  • An early-career professional ready to apply your developing design and project management skills to franchise store execution.

  • Someone who takes ownership of defined tasks and delivers accurately, on time, and in line with global standards.

  • Comfortable handling straightforward design and coordination challenges independently, and confident escalating more complex issues when needed.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Developing design and project management skills, with an eye for detail and brand consistency.

  • A structured approach to documentation, timelines, and tracking.

  • The ability to collaborate with external designers and franchise partners across markets.

OUR BENEFITS

We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

  • Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

  • Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

  • At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

  • Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

  • As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

jobs.title: Bliv en del af hjemmeplejen som social- og sundhedsassistent eller -hjælper
jobs.description:
Vil du være en del af et fagligt og socialt fællesskab, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe tryghed, kvalitet og gode hverdage for borgerne?Én ansøgning. Flere muligheder. Dit valg. Og det starter med enkle spørgsmål i et ansøgningsskema.En samlet hjemmepleje med fire områderI Fredensborg Kommune er hjemmeplejen samlet på tværs af fire geografiske områder og en fælles aften- og natsygepleje, som ledes af hjemmeplejechef Anne Rønne. Du søger én samlet stilling og kan angive, hvor du helst vil arbejde:
  • Nivå – et område med ca. 58 kollegaer, som ledes af områdelederne Anne Grann og Tanya Pedersen
  • Kokkedal – et område med ca. 39 kollegaer, som ledes af områdeleder Jumana Mahmud
  • Humlebæk – et område med ca. 58 kollegaer, som ledes af områdelederne Agnethe Søgaard og Birgitta Warnke
  • Fredensborg – et område med ca. 66 kollegaer, som ledes af områdelederne Jane Tangholm og Carina Forsberg-Madsen
Har du ikke en klar præference? Så angiver du det blot i ansøgningsskemaet – vi finder sammen det rette match.Vi søger dig, der
  • Er uddannet social og sundhedshjælper eller social- og sundhedsassistent
  • Arbejder selvstændigt og har overblik
  • Har gode samarbejdsevner
  • Har lyst til at bidrage til udvikling og kvalitet
Dine muligheder
  • Dagvagt eller aftenvagt
  • 28–37 timer om ugen
  • Weekendvagt hver 2. eller 3. uge
Din rolle som social- og sundhedsassistentDu har en central faglig rolle i borgerens forløb og arbejder selvstændigt i tæt samarbejde med dit team.Dine opgaver er at:
  • Varetage pleje, behandling og sygeplejefaglige opgaver
  • Observere og handle på ændringer i borgerens tilstand
  • Sikre sammenhæng og kvalitet i borgerforløb
  • Bidrage til triagering, dokumentation og faglig sparring
Hos os udvikler du dig løbende:
  • Du styrker dine faglige og kliniske kompetencer i praksis
  • Du får mulighed for nye opgaver og øget ansvar
  • Du indgår i et miljø med sparring og læring i hverdagen
Vi tilbyder
  • En god introduktion og tryg opstart
  • Faglig og personlig udvikling
  • Dialog om fleksibilitet - så hverdagen kan hænge sammen for dig, teamet og borgerne
  • Et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på kvalitet og samarbejde
  • Medarbejderfordele med fx rabat på træning, motionsforening og sociale arrangementer. Læs mere her.
Et fællesskab du kan mærkeDu bliver en del af en arbejdsplads med stærkt kollegialt samarbejde, videndeling og fokus på trivsel og et godt arbejdsmiljø.“Selv på travle dage er der overskud til grin og smil.”En hverdag med faglighed og udviklingHos os er udvikling en naturlig del af arbejdet:
  • Daglig triagering, koordinering og faglig sparring
  • Tæt tværfagligt samarbejde med bl.a. sygeplejersker og terapeuter
  • Fokus på rehabilitering og borgerens egne ressourcer
  • Mulighed for at bidrage til nye løsninger og arbejdsgange
Vi klæder dig godt på til opgaven med en grundig introduktion og løbende sparring, så du får de bedste forudsætninger for at lykkes i rollen.Du søger stillingen via vores ansøgningsskemaI skemaet angiver du:
  • Hvilket område du foretrækker – eller om du er åben
  • Om du ønsker dag- eller aftenvagt
  • Eventuelle ønsker til timetal
Er du fleksibel, hjælper vi med at finde det rette match, så du lander et sted, hvor faglighed og trivsel passer godt sammen.Hvis du også er interesseret i at arbejde på et plejehjem, kan du oplyse det i skemaet.Vi tager samtaler løbende og glæder os til at møde dig.Hvis du vil vide mere, kan du kontakte os på telefon 30 34 25 19 mellem kl. 08.30 og kl. 15.00.AnsættelsesvilkårVi kan tilbyde uddannede social- og sundhedsassistenter ansættelse hurtigst muligt, når vi har fundet det rette match. Du bliver ansat efter gældende overenskomst, og din løn bliver forhandlet på baggrund af erfaring og kvalifikationer.Søg via linket senest den torsdag 10. december 2026. Vi holder samtaler løbende, men modtager ansøgninger helt frem til fristen.I forbindelses med ansættelsen indhenter vi referencer og straffeattest.I Fredensborg Kommune ser vi mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge stillingen uanset personlig baggrund.

Din baggrund er ikke det vigtigste – din personlighed og indstilling er!

  • Du har flair for tal og god teknisk forståelse.

  • Du interesserer dig oprigtigt for biler.

  • Du kan lide at arbejde praktisk med klargøring af biler.

Vi forestiller os en person i alderen 25–50 år, men det vigtigste er, at du er den rette person.

Du bliver en vigtig del af hele processen fra bilen kommer ind, til den står flot og salgsklar i vores udstilling.

Klargøring og præsentation af biler

Oprettelse af biler til salg

Praktiske og tekniske opgaver omkring bilerne

Kundekontakt og på sigt bilsalg

DET ER IKKE NOGET PROBLEM!

Vi tror på, at den rette personlighed, interesse for biler og lysten til at lykkes er langt vigtigere end en flot titel på et CV.

Et spændende og alsidigt job i et moderne bilhus med masser af muligheder, gode kollegaer og en hverdag, hvor ikke to dage er ens.

Vi søger ikke nødvendigvis en erfaren bilsælger – vi søger den rette person, som vi kan gøre til en dygtig bilsælger!

Sous chef på Bryggens Spisehus

 

 

Erfaringsrig og passioneret souschef søges til Bryggens Spise

Brænder du for gastronomi, højt tempo og god ledelse i køkkenet? Bryggens Spisehus søger en engageret og kvalificeret souschef, der kan være køkkenchefens højre hånd og gå forrest i den daglige drift af vores travle køkken.

 

Om jobbet og dine ansvarsområder:Som vores nye souschef får du en nøglerolle i køkkenet. Du vil indgå aktivt i den daglige madlavning, men også have fokus på struktur og ledelse. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet indebære:

  • Daglig drift og service: Sikre at maden altid leveres i højeste kvalitet – uanset om det gælder hurtig burgerservice, selskabsmad eller den klassiske a la carte.

  • Køkkenledelse: Gå forrest som det gode eksempel, motivere teamet og uddelegere opgaver under service.

  • Kvalitets- og egenkontrol: Medansvar for at køkkenets hygiejnestandarder, egenkontrol og råvarehåndtering altid sidder lige i skabet.

  • Varebestilling: Assistere med lagerstyring og tæt dialog med vores leverandører.

 

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har dokumenteret erfaring fra et lignende koncept med både a la carte, selskaber og burgerservice i højt tempo.

  • Er faglært kok eller har solid, praktisk erfaring på et tilsvarende niveau.

  • Har et skarpt overblik og formår at bevare det gode humør – selv i de mest hektiske timer.

  • Er en holdspiller, der kommunikerer tydeligt, konstruktivt og professionelt med både køkken og tjenere.

 

Vi tilbyder:

  • En attraktiv fuldtidsstilling med opstart hurtigst muligt.

  • En spændende, dynamisk og levende arbejdsplads med fart på og plads til faglige ambitioner.

jobs.title: VP, Communication
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


VP of Communications, Replit

Replit is changing who gets to build software. As an agentic software creation platform, Replit enables anyone, from individual creators to teams inside the world’s largest companies, to turn natural language into applications, internal tools, dashboards, workflows, websites, and software that solves real problems.

We are looking for a Director or VP of Communications to lead Replit’s next chapter of storytelling, trust building, and market leadership.

This is a senior communications role for a creative, strategic, and hands-on leader who can build and scale the communications function as Replit grows from a beloved developer platform into a defining company in AI, software creation, and enterprise transformation. This person will own Replit’s external and internal communications strategy, including strategic positioning and company narrative, media relations, analyst relations, executive communications, internal communications, crisis communications, customer storytelling, flagship thought leadership, policy-related communications, and global awareness.

The role requires someone who can push through the noise, make the Replit story heard, and keep it part of the conversation. The Director / VP of Communications will develop a compelling narrative that evolves with the company, the product, and the market, and deliver it across media, policymakers, partners, customers, prospects, and employees. The role will also support Replit’s international awareness, with a focus on key markets in Europe and Asia.

This person must be both strategic and execution-oriented. They should have built or helped lead a communications function at a fast-growing technology company, or led communications and positioning for a leading institution. This is not a traditional press office role of adopting another company’s playbook in its entirety.

The person must be creative, scrappy, maybe even spiky: able to take what they know works as a foundation and build on it to make Replit a unique player that punches above its weight in a crowded, competitive marketplace.

Role

 - Lead and scale Replit’s communications function, including communications strategy, team structure, agency management, operating rhythms, and execution standards.

 - Build an AI-native communications function, with agents running repeatable work so a lean team focuses on judgment, relationships, and creative leaps.

 - Develop and evolve Replit’s corporate narrative as the company expands across AI, developer tools, enterprise, consumer, education, and global markets.

 - Own Replit’s strategic positioning: the upstream frameworks and intellectual capital that make every launch, stage, and story land better.

jobs.title: Investment Analyst / Investment Manager - Green Energy & Infrastructure
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by making green commercial investments across Africa, Asia, and Latin America?

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark’s largest impact fund and is internationally recognized as a best-in-class impact investor.  We manage our own private equity funds, debt capital, and concessional capital with a focus on creating sustainable businesses that deliver measurable social, economic and climate impact alongside solid financial returns.

We are strengthening our Green Energy and Infrastructure team and are looking for an Investment Professional to join us in our headquarters in Copenhagen. Depending on your experience, you may join us as Investment Analyst or Investment Manager.

Green Energy and Infrastructure invests in businesses and infrastructure that accelerate the green transition in emerging markets. Our investment focus spans renewable energy, circular economy, electric mobility, and water infrastructure. Through equity and debt investments, active ownership and strategic partnerships, we drive impact and value creation aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals. We typically invest between DKK 100-350 million per transaction.

You will be reporting to a Managing Director in Green Energy and Infrastructure and work closely with colleagues in Copenhagen and our regional offices across Europe, Africa, Asia and Latin America on investments throughout the investment lifecycle.

 

Investment Analyst

As an Investment Analyst, you will be a key analytical resource in transaction teams, focusing on commercial and financial analysis of investment opportunities.

You will:

  • Screen and analyse new investment proposals using Impact Fund Denmark’s tools and processes.

  • Assist in preparing investment papers, financial analyses and financial modelling.

  • Support due diligence, valuation and deal structuring.

  • Contribute to preparing and presenting investment recommendations and materials for the investment committee and board.

  • Collect and analyse commercial and financial data for deal teams.

  • Help maintain information systems for pipeline tracking and portfolio data.

  • Participate in networking activities to support investment sourcing and promotion.

  • Support project managers in active ownership and portfolio monitoring.

  • Ensure timely and accurate updates of systems with project documents, and financial and sustainability reporting.

  • Assist in assessing exit timing and support execution.

 

Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in a relevant field, such as finance or economics with strong academic results.

  • 1-2 years of relevant experience from impact investing, private equity, M&A, corporate finance or consulting.

  • Solid understanding of financial analysis and valuation.

  • Skilled user of Excel and with an interest in and aptitude for financial modelling.

  • Detail-oriented with a structured working approach.

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).

  • Curious to broaden your understanding of the world and keen to travel.

 

Investment Manager

As an Investment Manager, you will take the lead on many of the tasks performed by an Investment Analyst. You are thus expected to work independently, drive workstreams, and take ownership of parts of the investment process.

You will:

  • Screen and analyse new investment proposals using Impact Fund Denmark’s tools and processes.

  • Lead preparation of parts of investment papers, financial analyses and financial modelling with guidance from the project manager (Senior Investment Manager or Investment Director).

  • Support and lead due diligence, valuation and deal structuring workstreams.

  • Contribute to preparing and presenting investment recommendations and materials for the investment committee and board.

  • Lead the analysis of commercial and financial data for deal teams.

  • Take part in negotiating terms and drafting legal documentation.

  • Help maintain information systems for pipeline tracking and portfolio data.

  • Participate in networking activities to support investment sourcing and promotion.

  • Support project managers in active ownership and portfolio monitoring.

  • Assist in assessing exit timing and support exit negotiations and execution.

 

Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in a relevant field such as finance or economics with strong academic results.

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience from impact investing, private equity, M&A, corporate finance or consulting.

  • Independent mindset and experienced in owning and managing workstreams.

  • Solid understanding of financial analysis and valuation.

  • Expert user of Excel and with an interest in and aptitude for financial modelling.

  • Detail-oriented with a structured working approach.

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).

  • Strong interpersonal skills and business judgment.

  • Curious to broaden your understanding of the world and keen to travel.

  • Experience in emerging markets and green energy is an advantage but not a prerequisite.

 

Working at Impact Fund Denmark

Learning is an important element of working in Impact Fund Denmark, and we will support your personal development through training, sparring and by ensuring that you get exciting and challenging tasks and new opportunities for growth. When joining Impact Fund Denmark, you will take part in our extensive onboarding program to get the best possible start in your new role.

We have a diverse and inclusive working environment with more than 170 talented individuals from 30+ different nationalities. We work seamlessly together with colleagues around the corner, across the organisation and between offices in Asia, Africa, Latin America and Europe.

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark (IFU – the Investment Fund for Developing Countries) is a Danish impact investor contributing to green, just and inclusive societies as well as supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark provides risk capital to companies operating in developing countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and parts of Europe. Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. Contracted investments total EUR 31 billion, of which Impact Fund Denmark has contributed EUR 3.4 billion. Capital under management will be growing from EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 5.0 billion over the next few years. Read more at Impact Fund Denmark

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
About Lemon.io

Lemon.io is a profitable, growing talent marketplace that connects vetted senior engineers with companies that need them. We’ve been in business for 10 years, have 60 people across Ukraine, Europe, Canada, and the US, and process over $16M in annual GMV. We compress the traditional 2–5 week hiring timeline down to 24–48 hours through a curated, pre-vetted supply of developers.

Hiring is still broken. Recruiters spend weeks building candidate pipelines on traditional platforms, burning energy on unqualified leads. We’re building the product that changes that. Giving recruiters qualified, vetted candidates within 24 hours without the grind. This is a pivotal moment: we’re transitioning from a services-driven marketplace to a technology-driven platform. We need an engineering leader who can drive that transformation.

 

The Role

You will own engineering at Lemon.io. You’ll lead a growing team of engineers, make critical architecture and prioritization decisions, and be directly accountable for the speed and quality of what we ship. This is not a management-layer role. You’ll be hands-on, deeply involved in product decisions, and working side by side with the founder.

 

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the technical roadmap and make sure every engineering effort maps directly to business impact. No features for features’ sake.

  • Lead and grow an engineering team that ships fast, iterates constantly, and treats complexity as a cost.

  • Tackle the hard, multi-layered problem: automated vetting, intelligent matching at scale, demand-side bottlenecks. And figure out where the real leverage is.

  • Make hard prioritization calls. Decide what we build, what we skip, and what we kill.

  • Work directly with the founder and product team to define what success looks like before writing a single line of code.

  • Build the engineering culture: high ownership, high speed, low bureaucracy.

Who You Are:

  • Product-minded, business-first

  • Obsessed with simplicity

  • First principles thinker

  • Fast. Bias toward action

Experience:

  • You’ve led engineering teams (5–30+ people) at a startup or high-growth company.

  • You have hands-on experience with modern stacks and are comfortable with AI/ML tooling.

  • You’ve worked in a distributed, async-first team.

Why Lemon.io:

  • Profitable and growing. No fundraising pressure, real business fundamentals.

  • A pivotal moment: you’re not maintaining an engine, you’re building one. The product roadmap is wide open.

  • Direct access to the founder. No layers. Your decisions ship.

  • A massive, unsolved problem: hiring is still broken. We’re building the product that makes it radically faster for companies to find qualified engineers.

  • A team of 60 people who move fast, care deeply, and have survived the hard years together.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Energy Harvesting and EMI Mitigation in High-Voltage Environments - 4391
jobs.description:
The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics at the University of Southern Denmark invites applications for an Assistant Professor position in Energy Harvesting and EMI Mitigation for Drones and Robots in High-Voltage Environments. The position is open from January 1, 2027, and the starting date will be agreed with the successful candidate.

 

Job Content

The Assistant Professor will conduct research within energy harvesting for drones, robotic systems, and IoT applications, with a particular focus on enhancing power density and enabling long-term autonomous operation. The research will further address electromagnetic interference (EMI) mitigation and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) for electronic and robotic systems operating in extreme high-voltage environments, contributing to improved system reliability, safety, and performance in infrastructure inspection and maintenance applications.

The successful candidate is expected to develop and sustain a research agenda aligned with or complementing the section’s activities, establish an internationally recognized research profile, publish in high-impact journals and leading international conference proceedings, and actively contribute to securing external research funding from national and international sources. The role includes collaboration with academic colleagues and industrial partners and participation in national and international research activities.

The position includes planning, teaching, and developing Bachelor’s and Master’s-level courses in relevant areas of electronics and electrical engineering. The successful candidate will supervise Bachelor’s, Master’s, and PhD students, provide academic guidance, and contribute to a supportive and collaborative research and learning environment. The role also includes academic service at section and department levels and participation in relevant professional activities.

 

Required Qualifications

Applicants must hold a PhD degree in Electronics Engineering, Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field.

Applicants must document the following qualifications and experience:

  • A strong research track record in electromagnetic energy harvesting, power conversion, or power management systems.

  • Research experience in electromagnetic interference (EMI) mitigation and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) for operation in extreme high-voltage environments up to 500 kV.

  • Experience in the design, development, and testing of drone systems.

  • Experience in university teaching, course development, and supervision of engineering students, together with pedagogical and subject-specific skills appropriate to the position.

  • A proven ability to attract external research funding as principal investigator or key contributor.

  • A strong publication record in leading international journals and conferences, including publications resulting from international collaborations.

  • Demonstrated experience in international research projects and collaborative activities with academic and industrial partners.

  • Experience serving as reviewer for leading international journals and conferences in relevant research fields.

International research experience gained in an environment other than the institution where the applicant completed their PhD will be considered an advantage.

 

Workplace description

The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics at the University of Southern Denmark conducts research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communications, using advanced reconfigurable computing and sensing technologies. The section develops next-generation electronics and computing solutions to address technological challenges in autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grids, and healthcare.

The section contributes to the electrical engineering programmes in Odense, including Bachelor’s and Master of Science degrees in Electronics Engineering. Over the next few years, the section is expected to expand to at least 30 staff members, including academic staff, PhD students, and engineers, supporting research, industrial collaboration, and education. This growth will strengthen the section’s contribution to electrical engineering and related fields.

SDU’s Odense campus comprises six faculties, providing opportunities for interdisciplinary research and a vibrant student life. Odense offers a culturally rich environment, a growing robotics community, attractive residential areas, and green spaces along the river through the city centre.

Further Information

For further information about the position, please contact Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, Head of the Section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics, at esme@sdu.dk. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application that clearly explains the applicant’s interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages).

  • Curriculum Vitae, including contact information, research experience, relevant projects, technical skills, and teaching and supervision experience.

  • Research plan outlining the proposed research agenda, its alignment with the position and the section’s activities, and plans for developing a research line and research team.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation). 

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position. 

  • Summary and documentation of teaching qualifications, pedagogical experience, course development, and student supervision. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio. 

  • Names and email addresses of up to three referees who can provide an informed reference at short notice. Reference letters and documentation of other relevant qualifications may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 20, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: PhD Position in Energy Harvesting for Bio-Inspired Flying Robots
jobs.description:
The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics in Odense at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering of the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a PhD position in energy harvesting for bio-inspired flying robots. The position focuses on developing energy-harvesting techniques that use the magnetic fields surrounding high-voltage power lines to support autonomous inspection of power lines. The starting date is 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.  

This is a three-year PhD position based at SDU’s campus in Odense, Denmark.

The section focuses on conducting research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communication, utilizing cutting-edge reconfigurable computing and sensors. The aim is to develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions that solve technology-related challenges in fields such as autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grid, and healthcare.

The section contributes to our educational programmes in electrical engineering in Odense, offering Bachelor’s and Master of Science degrees in Electronics Engineering. Its activities span research, industrial collaboration, and education in electrical engineering and related areas.

The SDU campus in Odense comprises six faculties, bringing together academics and students in an environment that supports interdisciplinary research and a rich student life. Odense offers a vibrant robotics community, cultural activities, attractive residential areas, and green spaces along the river that runs through the city centre.

 

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated PhD candidate to join the FreeFly project, an ambitious research project focused on developing a bird-like flying robot for autonomous inspection of power lines. The PhD research will focus on energy harvesting to enable self-sustaining operation of this bio-inspired robotic platform.

Research Focus – Energy Harvesting for Bio-Inspired Flying Robots

You will investigate, analyse, and design novel energy-harvesting techniques that enable bio-inspired aerial robots to draw energy from the strong magnetic fields surrounding high-voltage power lines. Your research will contribute to the development of self-sustaining flying robotic systems, with the aim of enabling extended autonomous inspection missions.

General Responsibilities

As a PhD student on this project, you will:

  • Conduct research on energy harvesting from the magnetic fields surrounding high-voltage power lines, contributing to the development of a self-sustaining, bird-like autonomous flying robot for inspection of power lines.

  • Participate in teaching activities, including course planning and instruction in relevant subject areas.

  • Collaborate closely with fellow PhD students, postdocs, and other members of the research group in a dynamic, interdisciplinary environment.

We are looking for a detail-oriented, self-driven candidate with a strong interest in energy harvesting and its application to bio-inspired flying robots. If you are motivated to contribute to innovative research in autonomous inspection of power lines, we encourage you to apply.

 

Required Qualifications

  • A completed BSc and MSc in electronics, electrical engineering, physics, mechatronics, or a closely related discipline. Applicants in the final semester of their master’s programme are also encouraged to apply, provided they complete their MSc before the starting date and meet the applicable PhD admission requirements.

  • Strong technical skills relevant to energy harvesting, particularly magnetic-field energy harvesting, electronics, and embedded hardware architectures.

  • Demonstrated ability in academic writing, including preparing scientific reports, documentation, and research publications.

For further information about the position, please contact the Head of Digital and High-frequency Electronics section, Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, e-mail: esme@sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application that clearly explains the applicant’s interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages). 

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information, skills, along with any other relevant information, e.g. teaching experience, computational skills, relevant projects, etc.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). Applicants in the final semester of their master’s programme are requested to submit transcripts from all completed semesters. 

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • Up to three names and emails of researchers who can provide an informed reference letter at short notice. (Reference letters and other relevant qualifications may also be included.)

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 20, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.313 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

The preferred start date is from January 1, 2027. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Opvaskere søges til Ruths Hotel i Gl. Skagen/Dishwashers Wanted at Ruths Hotel in Gl. Skagen
jobs.description:
Opvaskere søges til Ruths Hotel i Gl. Skagen

På Ruths Hotel er opvasken en vigtig del af den samlede gæsteoplevelse. Bag enhver vellykket servering står et stærkt team, hvor alle tager ansvar for, at kvalitet, hygiejne og arbejdsgange fungerer - også når tempoet er højt.

Vi søger opvaskere, som har lyst til at blive en del af et professionelt køkken og et hus, hvor værtskab, samarbejde og ordentlighed er en del af kulturen. Du behøver ikke at have erfaring fra hotel- eller restaurationsbranchen. Det vigtigste er, at du møder stabilt, tager ansvar og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Opvask af service, glas, bestik og køkkenudstyr

  • Holde orden og sikre god hygiejne i opvaskeområdet

  • Hjælpe med rengøring og lettere praktiske opgaver i køkkenet

  • Sørge for, at rent udstyr er klar, når kollegerne har brug for det

  • Samarbejde tæt med køkkenet og resten af hotellets team

Vi leder efter dig, der

  • Er stabil, ansvarsbevidst og møder til tiden

  • Arbejder effektivt og bevarer overblikket, når der er travlt

  • Har sans for orden, renlighed og hygiejne

  • Er en god kollega og hjælper, hvor der er behov

  • Har en positiv indstilling og lyst til at være en del af et fællesskab

  • Kan arbejde på skiftende tidspunkter, herunder aftener og weekender

Vi tilbyder

  • En arbejdsplads på et ikonisk hotel med historie, sjæl og høje ambitioner

  • Et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok

  • En kultur præget af stolthed, nærvær og ordentlighed

  • Grundig oplæring og mulighed for udvikling

  • En varieret hverdag i særlige omgivelser

  • Mulighed for personalebolig

På Ruths Hotel tror vi på, at de bedste gæsteoplevelser skabes i fællesskab. Som opvasker er du en vigtig del af holdet og med til at sikre, at både køkken og restaurant kan levere værtskab på højeste niveau.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@ruths-hotel.dk.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Jack Cramer på samme e-mailadresse.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Dishwashers Wanted at Ruths Hotel in Gl. Skagen

At Ruths Hotel, the dishwashing team plays an important role in the overall guest experience. Behind every successful service is a strong team in which everyone takes responsibility for maintaining quality, hygiene and efficient workflows - even during busy periods.

We are looking for dishwashers who would like to join a professional kitchen and a hotel where hospitality, teamwork and reliability are part of the culture. Previous experience from the hotel or restaurant industry is not required. What matters most is that you are dependable, take responsibility and contribute positively to the team.

Your responsibilities

  • Washing plates, glasses, cutlery and kitchen equipment

  • Maintaining order and high hygiene standards in the dishwashing area

  • Assisting with cleaning and other practical tasks in the kitchen

  • Ensuring that clean equipment is ready when your colleagues need it

  • Working closely with the kitchen team and other hotel departments

We are looking for someone who

  • Is reliable, responsible and punctual

  • Works efficiently and stays organised during busy periods

  • Has a strong focus on cleanliness, order and hygiene

  • Is a supportive colleague who is willing to help where needed

  • Has a positive attitude and enjoys being part of a team

  • Is available for flexible working hours, including evenings and weekends

We offer

  • A workplace at an iconic hotel with history, character and high ambitions

  • A strong team culture in which colleagues support one another

  • A working environment built on pride, care and professionalism

  • Thorough training and opportunities for development

  • A varied working day in unique surroundings

  • The possibility of staff accommodation

At Ruths Hotel, we believe that the best guest experiences are created through teamwork. As a dishwasher, you are an important part of the team and help ensure that our kitchen and restaurant can deliver hospitality at the highest level.

Please send your application and CV to job@ruths-hotel.dk.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Jack Cramer at the same email address.

We look forward to hearing from you.
